Description: 'Cognito identity pools for Lambda and Step Functions testing with unauthenticated access'

Resources:

    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:

      IdentityPoolName: LambdaTestIdentityPool

              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref LambdaTestIdentityPool
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaTestPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem

                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail

  StepFunctionsCognitoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create IAM role and SSM Automation documents for PCI compliance remediations.

Resources:
  # IAM Role with trust policy for SSM, EC2, Events
  PCIAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PCIAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                Resource: "*"

  # Document 1: PCI-RestrictDefaultSecurityGroup
  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-RestrictDefaultSecurityGroup
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: "Revoke all ingress and egress rules from the default security group of a given VPC."
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: "The ID of the VPC containing the default security group."
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeDefaultSGRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: "{{ VpcId }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    vpc_id = event['VpcId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                        Filters=[
                            {'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'group-name', 'Values': ['default']}
                        ]
                    )
                    if not response['SecurityGroups']:
                        raise Exception(f"No default security group found in VPC {vpc_id}")
                    sg = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    sg_id = sg['GroupId']
                    # Revoke ingress rules
                    if sg.get('IpPermissions'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions'])
                    # Revoke egress rules
                    if sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissionsEgress'])
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

  # Document 2: PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: "Delete all security groups that are not associated with any resource (EC2, ENI, etc.) except the default SG."
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters: {}
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteUnusedSGs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups()
                    for sg in response['SecurityGroups']:
                        if sg['GroupName'] == 'default':
                            continue
                        sg_id = sg['GroupId']
                        # Check for associated network interfaces
                        eni_response = ec2.describe_network_interfaces(
                            Filters=[{'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': [sg_id]}]
                        )
                        if eni_response['NetworkInterfaces']:
                            continue
                        # If no associations, delete the security group
                        try:
                            ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=sg_id)
                        except Exception as e:
                            print(f"Could not delete SG {sg_id}: {str(e)}")
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

  # Document 3: PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedEIPs
  ReleaseUnassociatedEIPsDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedEIPs
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: "Release unassociated Elastic IP addresses given their allocation IDs."
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationIds:
            type: StringList
            description: "List of Elastic IP allocation IDs to process."
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseEIPs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AllocationIds: "{{ AllocationIds }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    allocation_ids = event['AllocationIds']
                    for alloc_id in allocation_ids:
                        try:
                            response = ec2.describe_addresses(AllocationIds=[alloc_id])
                            addr = response['Addresses'][0]
                            if 'AssociationId' not in addr:
                                ec2.release_address(AllocationId=alloc_id)
                                print(f"Released EIP {alloc_id}")
                            else:
                                print(f"EIP {alloc_id} is still associated, skipping.")
                        except Exception as e:
                            print(f"Error processing {alloc_id}: {str(e)}")
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

  # Document 4: PCI-UpdateASGHealthCheckELB
  UpdateASGHealthCheckELBDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: PCI-UpdateASGHealthCheckELB
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: "Update an Auto Scaling group's health check type to ELB with a grace period of 300 seconds."
        assumeRole: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: "Name of the Auto Scaling group to update."
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateHealthCheck
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AutoScalingGroupName: "{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}"
              Script: |
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    asg_name = event['AutoScalingGroupName']
                    autoscaling = boto3.client('autoscaling')
                    autoscaling.update_auto_scaling_group(
                        AutoScalingGroupName=asg_name,
                        HealthCheckType='ELB',
                        HealthCheckGracePeriod=300
                    )
                    return {'Success': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap

Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the PCI Automation IAM Role
    Value: !GetAtt PCIAutomationRole.Arn
  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocName:
    Description: Name of the PCI-RestrictDefaultSecurityGroup SSM document
    Value: !Ref RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDoc
  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocName:
    Description: Name of the PCI-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups SSM document
    Value: !Ref DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDoc
  ReleaseUnassociatedEIPsDocName:
    Description: Name of the PCI-ReleaseUnassociatedEIPs SSM document
    Value: !Ref ReleaseUnassociatedEIPsDoc
  UpdateASGHealthCheckELBDocName:
    Description: Name of the PCI-UpdateASGHealthCheckELB SSM document
    Value: !Ref UpdateASGHealthCheckELBDoc

Parameters:
  ReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: AWS region to which the CodeCommit repositories will be replicated.
Resources:
  LogsBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref LogsBucketKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  LogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt CodeBuildProjectRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Join ["", [!GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn, "/*"]]
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Join ["", [!GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn, "/*"]]
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                "s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"
  CodeBuildProjectRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${ReplicaRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Join ["", [!GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn, "/*"]]
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LogsBucketKey.Arn
  EventBridgeRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeStartBuild
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:codebuild:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:project/${CodeBuildProject}"
                  - !GetAtt LogsBucketKey.Arn
  CodeBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: CodeCommitReplicator
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildProjectRole.Arn
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              runtime-versions:
                python: 3.8
              commands:
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  for repo in card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline; do
                    git clone "codecommit::${AWS_REGION}://${repo}"
                    cd "${repo}"
                    git remote add replica "codecommit::${REPLICA_REGION}://${repo}"
                    git push replica mainline
                    cd ..
                  done
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux2-x86_64-standard:4.0
        ImagePullCredentialsType: CODEBUILD
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: REPLICA_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref ReplicaRegion
      LogsConfig:
        S3Logs:
          Status: ENABLED
          Location: !Ref LogsBucket
          EncryptionDisabled: false
  CodeCommitPushRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service"
          - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service"
          - !Sub "arn:aws:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline"
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - refs/heads/mainline
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub "arn:aws:codebuild:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:project/${CodeBuildProject}"
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRuleRole.Arn
          Id: CodeBuildTarget

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: S3 bucket infrastructure for testing with replication, logging, and encryption

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used to name S3 buckets and resources

Resources:
  # SSM Parameter for application name
  AppNameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /test-app/name
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref AppName

  # Primary bucket with replication configuration
  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DependsOn: ReplicationRole
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-primary"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: logs/
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AppName}-replication-role"
        Rules:
          - Id: ReplicationRule
            Status: Enabled
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              StorageClass: STANDARD

  # Bucket policy for primary bucket: deny non-HTTPS and allow logging service
  PrimaryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PrimaryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': false
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub "${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*"

  # Access log bucket
  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-logs"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true

Description: 'Automation infrastructure for Aurora Global Database failover'

    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraWriterEndpoint
      Description: Stores the current writer endpoint of the Aurora Global Database
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"writerEndpoint": "pending"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "placeholder"

  # IAM role for SSM Automation

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:

      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Automation to failover an Aurora Global Database and update ARC routing controls'
        parameters:
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String

          SecondaryRegion:

          GlobalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
          RoutingControlPrimaryArn:
            type: String
          RoutingControlSecondaryArn:

        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                RoutingControlPrimaryArn: '{{ RoutingControlPrimaryArn }}'
                RoutingControlSecondaryArn: '{{ RoutingControlSecondaryArn }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    primary_region = event['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary_region = event['SecondaryRegion']
                    rc_primary = event['RoutingControlPrimaryArn']
                    rc_secondary = event['RoutingControlSecondaryArn']
                    client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=primary_region)
                    try:
                        primary_state = client.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=rc_primary)['RoutingControlState']
                    except Exception as e:
                        raise Exception(f"Failed to get primary routing control state: {e}")
                    try:
                        secondary_state = client.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=rc_secondary)['RoutingControlState']
                    except Exception as e:
                        raise Exception(f"Failed to get secondary routing control state: {e}")
                    if primary_state == 'On':
                        active_region = primary_region
                        inactive_region = secondary_region
                    elif secondary_state == 'On':
                        active_region = secondary_region
                        inactive_region = primary_region
                    else:
                        raise Exception("Neither routing control is On, cannot determine active region")
                    return {'ActiveRegion': active_region, 'InactiveRegion': inactive_region}

              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: InactiveRegion
                Selector: $.Payload.InactiveRegion
                Type: String
            nextStep: PerformFailover

          - name: PerformFailover
            action: 'aws:executeScript'
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
                TargetRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.InactiveRegion }}'

                import boto3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Kinesis stream with Cognito unauthenticated access for testing

Resources:
  MyKinesisStream:
    Type: AWS::Kinesis::Stream
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: my-stream-kinesis
      ShardCount: 1
      RetentionPeriodHours: 24
      StreamEncryption:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KeyId: 'alias/aws/kinesis'

  MyIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      IdentityPoolName: my-test-identity-pool

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref MyIdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KinesisPutPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                Resource: !GetAtt MyKinesisStream.Arn

  MyIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MyIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito Identity Pool ID
    Value: !Ref MyIdentityPool

  StreamName:
    Description: Kinesis Stream Name
    Value: !Ref MyKinesisStream

  StreamArn:
    Description: Kinesis Stream ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MyKinesisStream.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Custom SSM Automation for enabling VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic) with CIS compliance and Change Manager approval.'

Resources:

  # 1. CloudWatch Logs Log Group for Flow Logs
  VPCFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: VPCFlowLogsLogGroup
      RetentionInDays: 3653

  # 2. IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs (service role)
  VPCFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: VPCFlowLogRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowLogsDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: AllowManageFlowLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                Resource: '*'

  # 3. IAM Role for SSM Automation Execution
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AutomationExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AutomationExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowEC2FlowLogsActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AllowPassFlowLogRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogRole.Arn
              - Sid: AllowSSMAutomationOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'

  # 4. Direct SSM Automation Document
  EnableVPCFlowLogsDirect:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: EnableVPCFlowLogsDirect
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Enable VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic) on a given VPC.'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: 'The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.9
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: VPCFlowLogsLogGroup
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    account_id = sts.get_caller_identity()['Account']
                    vpc_id = event['VpcId']
                    log_group = event['LogGroupName']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/VPCFlowLogRole'
                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn
                    )
                    return {'FlowLogId': response['FlowLogIds'][0]}

  # 5. Change Request SSM Automation Document (with approval step)
  EnableVPCFlowLogsWithApproval:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: EnableVPCFlowLogsWithApproval
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'

        parameters:

        mainSteps:
          - name: RequestApproval

            inputs:

          - name: EnableFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.9
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                LogGroupName: VPCFlowLogsLogGroup
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                def handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    account_id = sts.get_caller_identity()['Account']
                    vpc_id = event['VpcId']
                    log_group = event['LogGroupName']
                    role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/VPCFlowLogRole'
                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn

Description: 'Creates a Route53 reusable delegation set via a custom resource Lambda function. The function manages creation, update, and deletion of the delegation set.           def send_response(event, context, response_status, response_data, physical_resource_id=None):

              req = urllib.request.Request(

                  method='PUT'
              )

          def resolve_ips(hostname):
              ipv4 = ''
              ipv6 = ''
              try:
                  results = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None)
                  for res in results:
                      family, _, _, _, sockaddr = res
                      if family == socket.AF_INET and not ipv4:
                          ipv4 = sockaddr[0]
                      elif family == socket.AF_INET6 and not ipv6:
                          ipv6 = sockaddr[0]

              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})

                          response_data[f'IPv6Address{i}'] = ipv6
                      response_data['DelegationSetId'] = delegation_set_id
                      physical_resource_id = delegation_set_id

                  elif request_type == 'Update':

                              response_data[f'IPv4Address{i}'] = ipv4
                              response_data[f'IPv6Address{i}'] = ipv6
                          response_data['DelegationSetId'] = physical_resource_id
                      else:
                          caller_reference = event['RequestId']
                          response = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=caller_reference)
                          delegation_set = response['DelegationSet']
                          delegation_set_id = delegation_set['Id'].split('/')[-1]
                          name_servers = delegation_set['NameServers']
                          for i, ns in enumerate(name_servers[:4], 1):
                              response_data[f'NameServer{i}'] = ns
                              ipv4, ipv6 = resolve_ips(ns)
                              response_data[f'IPv4Address{i}'] = ipv4
                              response_data[f'IPv6Address{i}'] = ipv6
                          response_data['DelegationSetId'] = delegation_set_id
                          physical_resource_id = delegation_set_id

                  elif request_type == 'Delete':

                          try:

                          except route53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              logger.warning(f'Delegation set {physical_resource_id} not found, ignoring.')
                      response_data = {}

                  send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', response_data, physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as e:

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "WebSocketApi-${AWS::StackName}"
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com

        - PolicyName: AllowStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  Integration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationUri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt IntegrationRole.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub |

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route

    DependsOn:
      - Route
      - Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:

      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AllowPostToConnection
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          import os

              connection_id = event['ConnectionId']
              message = event['Message']

              client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=api_endpoint)

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

                    "ApiEndpoint": "${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}",

                    "Message.$": "$.message"
                  }

    Value: !Sub "wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Step Functions state machine"
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

Description: Serverless API for content moderation using Amazon Rekognition

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from urllib.parse import urlparse

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
              except:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON body'})

              url = body.get('url')
              if not url:
                  return response(400, {'error': 'Missing url field'})

              # Validate format
              parsed = urlparse(url)
              path = parsed.path.lower()
              if not (path.endswith('.jpg') or path.endswith('.jpeg') or path.endswith('.png')):
                  return response(400, {'error': 'Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, png allowed.'})

              # Check size via HEAD
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(url, method='HEAD')
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                      content_length = resp.headers.get('Content-Length')
                      if content_length and int(content_length) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
                          return response(413, {'error': 'Image too large. Maximum 5 MB.'})
              except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                  return response(404, {'error': 'Image not found or unreachable.'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return response(500, {'error': 'Error checking image: ' + str(e)})

              # Download image
              try:
                  req = urllib.request.Request(url, method='GET')
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
                      image_bytes = resp.read()
              except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                  return response(404, {'error': 'Image not found or unreachable.'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return response(500, {'error': 'Error downloading image: ' + str(e)})

              # Check size after download
              if len(image_bytes) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
                  return response(413, {'error': 'Image too large. Maximum 5 MB.'})

              # Call Rekognition
              try:
                  rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')
                  result = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=60
                  )
                  labels = result.get('ModerationLabels', [])
                  return response(200, {'ModerationLabels': labels})
              except Exception as e:
                  return response(500, {'error': 'Rekognition error: ' + str(e)})

          def response(status_code, body):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status_code,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps(body)
              }

Description: 'Scheduled workflow to close AWS Organization accounts tagged with key=organizations:account-closure and value=REQUESTED. Includes pagination via Lambda, error handling for throttling, and CloudWatch logging with 365-day retention.'

Resources:
  # CloudWatch Log Group for State Machine execution logs
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: account-closure-workflow-logs
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: Step Functions execution logs for account closure workflow

  # IAM Role for the State Machine execution
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Permissions for Organizations APIs
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: '*'
              # Permissions to invoke the Lambda function for pagination
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt PaginationLambda.Arn
              # Permissions for CloudWatch Logs - required by Step Functions for EXPRESS state machine logging
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  # IAM Role for EventBridge to start the State Machine
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeStartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine

  # Lambda Function to paginate through accounts tagged for closure
  PaginationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: AccountClosurePagination
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('resourcegroupstaggingapi')
              accounts = []
              paginator = client.get_paginator('get_resources')
              page_iterator = paginator.paginate(
                  TagFilters=[{'Key': 'organizations:account-closure', 'Values': ['REQUESTED']}],
                  ResourceTypeList=['organizations:account']
              )
              for page in page_iterator:
                  for resource in page['ResourceTagMappingList']:
                      arn = resource['ResourceARN']
                      # Extract account ID from ARN: arn:aws:organizations::account-id:account/o-orgid/account-id
                      parts = arn.split('/')
                      account_id = parts[-1] if len(parts) >= 2 else None
                      if account_id:
                          accounts.append(account_id)
              return accounts

        - Key: Name
          Value: account-closure-pagination-lambda
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: Paginates through accounts tagged for closure

  # IAM Role for the Lambda function
  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaExecutionPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'

              - Effect: Allow

              - Effect: Allow

                  - logs:CreateLogGroup

    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine

      StateMachineName: AccountClosureWorkflow

        Level: ALL

        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Workflow to close accounts tagged with organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED",
              "StartAt": "GetTaggedAccounts",
              "States": {
                "GetTaggedAccounts": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "FunctionName": "${PaginationLambdaArn}",
                    "Payload.$": "$"

                  "ResultPath": "$.accountIds",
                  "Next": "ProcessAccounts"

                "ProcessAccounts": {
                  "Type": "Map",
                  "ItemsPath": "$.accountIds",
                  "MaxConcurrency": 10,
                  "Iterator": {
                    "StartAt": "DescribeAccount",
                    "States": {
                      "DescribeAccount": {
                        "Type": "Task",
                        "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                        "Parameters": {
                          "AccountId.$": "$$.Map.Item.Value"
                        },
                        "ResultPath": "$.accountDetails",
                        "Next": "CheckActive",
                        "Retry": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                            "MaxAttempts": 3,
                            "BackoffRate": 2
                          }
                        ],
                        "Catch": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "Next": "SkipAccount"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "CheckActive": {
                        "Type": "Choice",
                        "Choices": [
                          {
                            "Variable": "$.accountDetails.Account.Status",
                            "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                            "Next": "CloseAccount"
                          }
                        ],
                        "Default": "SkipAccount"
                      },
                      "CloseAccount": {
                        "Type": "Task",
                        "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount",
                        "Parameters": {
                          "AccountId.$": "$$.Map.Item.Value"
                        },
                        "ResultPath": "$.closeResult",
                        "Next": "TagAcknowledged",
                        "Retry": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                            "MaxAttempts": 3,
                            "BackoffRate": 2
                          }
                        ],
                        "Catch": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "Next": "SkipAccount"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "TagAcknowledged": {
                        "Type": "Task",
                        "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource",
                        "Parameters": {
                          "ResourceId.$": "$$.Map.Item.Value",
                          "Tags": [
                            {
                              "Key": "ACKNOWLEDGED",
                              "Value": "true"
                            }
                          ]
                        },
                        "End": true,
                        "Retry": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                            "MaxAttempts": 3,
                            "BackoffRate": 2
                          }
                        ],
                        "Catch": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                            "Next": "SkipAccount"
                          }

                        "End": true
                      }
                    }
                  },

        - Key: Name
          Value: account-closure-workflow
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: Scheduled account closure state machine

    Type: AWS::Events::Rule

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudFormation stack for StudyBuddy authentication infrastructure.
  Creates a Cognito User Pool with email verification, custom Lambda triggers,
  a frontend app client supporting OAuth2 flows, a Cognito Hosted UI domain,
  Google identity provider integration, and secrets storage for Google OAuth credentials.

Parameters:
  FrontendDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: Fully qualified domain name for the frontend application (e.g., app.studybuddy.com)
    AllowedPattern: '^([a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}$|^localhost(:\d{1,5})?$'
    Default: localhost:3000

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Globally unique prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI domain.
    Default: 'study-buddy-hosted-ui'
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, 3-63 characters.

  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth client ID for sign-in integration.
    Default: 'placeholder-client-id'

  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Google OAuth client secret for sign-in integration.
    Default: 'placeholder-client-secret'

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda functions
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Lambda function: Post-Authentication trigger
  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-auth'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder: log and return event
              print("Post-authentication trigger invoked")
              return event
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Lambda function: Post-Confirmation trigger
  PostConfirmationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-confirmation'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Post-confirmation trigger invoked")
              return event
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Lambda function: Pre-Sign-Up trigger
  PreSignUpLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pre-signup'
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Pre sign-up trigger invoked")
              # Auto-confirm user
              event['response']['autoConfirmUser'] = True
              event['response']['autoVerifyEmail'] = True
              return event
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Permissions for Cognito to invoke Lambda functions
  PostAuthLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambda.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  PreSignUpLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpLambda.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  # Cognito User Pool
  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudyBuddyUserPool
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'StudyBuddy - Verify your email'
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambda.Arn
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpLambda.Arn
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'

  # Cognito Identity Provider for Google
  GoogleIdP:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: 'profile email openid'

  # Cognito App Client – depends on GoogleIdP to avoid ordering issues
  StudyBuddyAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdP
    Properties:
      ClientName: StudyBuddyAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub
          - 'https://${Domain}/callback'
          - {Domain: !Ref FrontendDomain}
        - 'http://localhost:3000/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub
          - 'https://${Domain}/logout'
          - {Domain: !Ref FrontendDomain}
        - 'http://localhost:3000/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google

  # Cognito Hosted UI Domain (Cognito‑provided domain)
  StudyBuddyDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  # Secrets Manager secret for Google OAuth credentials
  GoogleOAuthCredentials:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-google-oauth-credentials'
      Description: Google OAuth client ID and secret for StudyBuddy app
      SecretString: !Sub '{"client_id":"${GoogleClientId}","client_secret":"${GoogleClientSecret}"}'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool

  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the StudyBuddy App Client
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyAppClient

  CognitoDomainUrl:
    Description: Full URL for the Cognito Hosted UI
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  GoogleOAuthSecretArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Resources:
  CMKKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for MCPToolBucket SSE-KMS encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use the key for SSE-KMS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  MCPToolBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref CMKKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt CMKKey.Arn

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Hello from bac-mcp-tool')
              }
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 3008
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14

  BedrockAgentGatewayInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: BedrockAgentGatewayInvocationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockGatewayPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:s3:::${MCPToolBucket}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt CMKKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'EC2 Image Builder pipeline for CIS hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility, daily builds, vulnerability scanning, and lifecycle policy'

Parameters:
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Description: AMI ID of the parent image for the Image Builder recipe. Resolves to the latest Amazon Linux 2023 ARM image.
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-6.1-arm64
  OrganizationArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the AWS Organization to share AMI launch permissions
    Default: 'arn:aws:organizations::123456789012:organization/o-xxxxxxxxxx'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS account ID for development environment
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Default: '111111111111'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS account ID for production environment
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Default: '222222222222'
  ImageBuilderPipelineName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the Image Builder pipeline
    Default: 'cis-eb-arm-pipeline'
  ImageBuilderComponentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the custom Elastic Beanstalk component
    Default: 'elastic-beanstalk-setup'

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/16'
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.1.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.2.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  # NAT Gateway for private subnet internet access
  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.3.0/24'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet

  # Security Groups
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-sg'
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  # VPC Endpoints
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # IAM Roles and Instance Profile
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderS3Logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LogsBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderKMSLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # S3 Bucket for logs
  LogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Suspended
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref S3KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-logs'
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # KMS Key for S3 Encryption
  S3KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for Image Builder log bucket encryption'
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: 'key-default-1'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-s3-kms-key'

  S3KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-logs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3KmsKey

  # Custom Component for Elastic Beanstalk
  ElasticBeanstalkComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderComponentName}-${AWS::StackName}'
      Platform: 'Linux'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: 'Installs Elastic Beanstalk CLI and dependencies for AMI compatibility'
      ChangeDescription: 'Initial version'
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkSetup
        description: Installs EB CLI and required packages
        schemaVersion: 1.0

        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSystem
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - yum update -y
              - name: InstallPythonPip
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - yum install -y python3-pip
              - name: InstallEbCli
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - pip3 install awsebcli
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  # Image Recipe
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-recipe-${AWS::StackName}'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: '/dev/xvda'
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      WorkingDirectory: '/tmp'
      Description: 'CIS hardened AL2023 ARM with Elastic Beanstalk setup'

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-dist-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Distribution to current region with launch permissions'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: 'CIS hardened AL2023 ARM for Elastic Beanstalk'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Ref OrganizationArn
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-infra-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Infrastructure config for Image Builder pipeline'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: 'logs/'
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  # Image Pipeline
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageBuilderPipelineName
      Description: 'Daily build of CIS hardened AL2023 ARM AMI with EB setup'
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: 'EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE'
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true  # Required when vulnerability scanning is enabled
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true

  # IAM Role for Lifecycle Policy
  LifecyclePolicyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:DeleteImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-role'

  # Lifecycle Policy to delete images after 6 months (180 days)
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-lifecycle-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: 'Expire images older than 180 days'
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyRole.Arn
      ResourceType: 'AMI_IMAGE'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: 'DELETE'
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: 1
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          CreatedByImagePipeline: !Ref ImageBuilderPipelineName
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ImageBuilderPipelineName}-lifecycle-policy'

Outputs:
  PipelineName:
    Description: Name of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  PipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the infrastructure configuration
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref LifecyclePolicy
  LogsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for Image Builder logs
    Value: !Ref LogsBucket
