AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless Maths MCP Server with Cognito authentication'

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for API Gateway
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool App Client

Resources:
  # Cognito User Pool
  MathsMCPUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  MathsMCPUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  # IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:GetUser
                Resource: !GetAtt MathsMCPUserPool.Arn

  # Main Lambda Function
  MathsMCPLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Hello from Maths MCP Lambda')
              }

  # Cognito Token Validator Lambda
  CognitoValidatorLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: MathsMCPUserPool
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-validator'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  token = event['headers']['Authorization']
                  client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
                  user_response = client.get_user(AccessToken=token)
                  return {
                      'principalId': user_response['Username'],
                      'policyDocument': {
                          'Version': '2012-10-17',
                          'Statement': [{
                              'Action': 'execute-api:Invoke',
                              'Effect': 'Allow',
                              'Resource': event['methodArn']
                          }]
                      }
                  }
              except Exception:
                  return {
                      'principalId': 'unauthorized',
                      'policyDocument': {
                          'Version': '2012-10-17',
                          'Statement': [{
                              'Action': 'execute-api:Invoke',
                              'Effect': 'Deny',
                              'Resource': event['methodArn']
                          }]
                      }
                  }

  # API Gateway REST API
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: Maths MCP API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  # API Gateway Resource: /mcp (child of root)
  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  # API Gateway Authorizer (Lambda REQUEST type)
  CognitoValidatorAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    DependsOn: MathsMCPUserPool
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-validator'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: REQUEST
      AuthorizerUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CognitoValidatorLambda.Arn}/invocations'
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      AuthorizerResultTtlInSeconds: 300

  # GET method on root (public)
  RootGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  # OPTIONS method on /mcp for CORS (mock integration)
  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

  # POST method on /mcp (secured with Lambda authorizer)
  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: CUSTOM
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoValidatorAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMCPLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  # Lambda Permission for public GET endpoint
  LambdaPermissionRootGet:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMCPLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/'

  # Lambda Permission for secured POST endpoint
  LambdaPermissionMcpPost:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMCPLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/POST/mcp'

  # Lambda Permission for Cognito Validator Authorizer
  LambdaPermissionCognitoValidator:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CognitoValidatorLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*'

  # API Gateway Deployment
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RootGetMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - CognitoValidatorLambda
      - CognitoValidatorAuthorizer
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: API Gateway endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito App Client ID
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPUserPoolClient
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the main Lambda function
    Value: !Ref MathsMCPLambda

Description: "ECS Fargate task definition with ECR repository and IAM roles"

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:

        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const { operator, operands } = event;
            if (!Array.isArray(operands) || operands.length < 2) {
              throw new Error("operands must be an array with at least two numbers");
            }
            const [a, b] = operands;
            switch (operator) {
              case 'add': return { result: a + b };
              case 'subtract': return { result: a - b };
              case 'multiply': return { result: a * b };

            }

    Properties:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

                  {"Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "divide", "Next": "Divide"}

              "Subtract": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${CalculatorArn}", "End": true},
              "Multiply": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${CalculatorArn}", "End": true},
              "Divide": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "${CalculatorArn}", "End": true},

          }

    Type: String
    Default: ami-0e2c8caa4b6378d8c
    Description: Amazon Linux 2023 AMI ID for use as the parent image. Default is for us-east-1; override for other regions.

Resources:
  # VPC and networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPublicSubnet

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPrivateSubnet

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderNAT

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPublicRT

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderPrivateRT

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security group for Image Builder build instance (default egress allows all outbound)
  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance (outbound only)
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderBuildSG

  # IAM role and instance profile
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderRole

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  # KMS key for S3 bucket encryption
  ImageBuilderKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for Image Builder logs bucket
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable root account full access
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderKmsKey

  ImageBuilderKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/imagebuilder-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey

  # S3 bucket for Image Builder logs (auto-generated name to avoid collisions)
  ImageBuilderLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderLogs

  ImageBuilderLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImageBuilderLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ImageBuilderLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  # Image Builder Component - install packages
  ImageBuilderComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-setup-component
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: |
        name: BastionSetup
        description: Installs SSM Agent, MongoDB tools, Python, Synapse client, .NET SDK
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: AddMongoRepo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo <<EOF
                      [mongodb-org-8.0]
                      name=MongoDB Repository
                      baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/
                      gpgcheck=1
                      enabled=1
                      gpgkey=https://www.mongodb.org/static/pgp/server-8.0.asc
                      EOF
              - name: InstallMongoTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y mongodb-database-tools mongosh
              - name: InstallPythonAndSynapse
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - sudo pip3 install synapseclient
              - name: InstallDotNetSDK
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo rpm -Uvh https://packages.microsoft.com/config/rhel/9/packages-microsoft-prod.rpm
                    - sudo dnf install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0
      Tags:
        Name: BastionSetupComponent

  # Image Recipe
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-recipe
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentAmiId
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ImageBuilderComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        Name: BastionImageRecipe

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-infra
      Description: Infrastructure config for bastion image build
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref ImageBuilderLogsBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: imagebuilder-logs/
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        Name: BastionInfraConfig

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-distro
      Description: Distribute AMI to all accounts in organization
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub 'bastion-ami-${ImageVersion}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Bastion AMI with SSM, MongoDB tools, Python, Synapse, .NET SDK
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
                # No additional accounts; sharing with the entire organization
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub 'bastion-ami-${ImageVersion}'
              Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Tags:
        Name: BastionDistroConfig

  # Image Pipeline (manual trigger only)
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: bastion-pipeline
      Description: Pipeline to build bastion AMI on demand
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: false
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: BastionImagePipeline

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID created for Image Builder
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet ID for build instances
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: Public subnet ID (NAT)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  ImageBuilderSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for build instances
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderSecurityGroup
  ImageBuilderInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: Instance profile ARN used by Image Builder
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceProfile.Arn
  ImageBuilderComponentArn:
    Description: Component ARN
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderComponent
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: Image Recipe ARN
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: Infrastructure Configuration ARN
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: Distribution Configuration ARN
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: Image Pipeline ARN
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  S3LogsBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket for Image Builder logs
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderLogsBucket
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: KMS key ID used for S3 bucket encryption
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey
  ParentAmiIdUsed:
    Description: AMI ID used as the parent image
    Value: !Ref ParentAmiId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Plot Palette DynamoDB tables'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name for naming resources

Resources:
  JobsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Jobs-${EnvironmentName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: created_at
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: created_at
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  QueueTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Queue-${EnvironmentName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: status
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: status
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  TemplatesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Templates-${EnvironmentName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: template_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: version
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: template_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: version
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL

  CostTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-CostTracking-${EnvironmentName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true

Outputs:
  JobsTableName:
    Description: Jobs DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref JobsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-JobsTableName'
  JobsTableArn:
    Description: Jobs DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt JobsTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-JobsTableArn'
  QueueTableName:
    Description: Queue DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref QueueTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-QueueTableName'
  QueueTableArn:
    Description: Queue DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt QueueTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-QueueTableArn'
  TemplatesTableName:
    Description: Templates DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref TemplatesTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TemplatesTableName'
  TemplatesTableArn:
    Description: Templates DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt TemplatesTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TemplatesTableArn'
  CostTrackingTableName:
    Description: CostTracking DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref CostTrackingTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CostTrackingTableName'
  CostTrackingTableArn:
    Description: CostTracking DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CostTrackingTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CostTrackingTableArn'
  UserIDIndexName:
    Description: Global secondary index name for user-id-index
    Value: 'user-id-index'

        - Content:
            !Base64 |

              exit 0
      OnStart:
        - Content:
            !Base64 |
              #!/bin/bash
              CONDA_PATH=/home/ec2-user/anaconda3
              export PATH=$CONDA_PATH/bin:$PATH
              # If environment doesn't exist, start install in detached background session
              if ! $CONDA_PATH/bin/conda env list | grep -q '^rapids '; then

                  $CONDA_PATH/bin/conda create -y -n rapids -c rapidsai -c conda-forge \

                  $CONDA_PATH/envs/rapids/bin/python -m ipykernel install \
                    --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS" --force
                ' > /tmp/rapids_install.log 2>&1 &
              fi
              # If environment already exists, just register kernel
              if $CONDA_PATH/bin/conda env list | grep -q '^rapids '; then
                $CONDA_PATH/envs/rapids/bin/python -m ipykernel install \
                  --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS" --force
              fi
              exit 0

    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rapidsai"

      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerNotebookRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for SLO monitoring dashboard and alarms for FSx for ONTAP event-driven pipeline. Creates CloudWatch alarms and dashboard with metric widgets and canary monitoring.

Parameters:
  EnableFlag:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "true"
    Description: Enable or disable the creation of alarms and dashboard.

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    Description: Prefix used for naming alarms and the dashboard.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    Description: CloudWatch namespace for SLO metrics.

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    Description: CloudWatch namespace for synthetic canary metrics.

  SNSTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications.

  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: P99 threshold for event ingestion latency in seconds.

  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    Description: Average threshold for processing success rate in percent.

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Maximum threshold for FPolicy reconnect time in seconds.

  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Maximum threshold for replay completion time in minutes.

Conditions:
  EnableCondition:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref EnableFlag
      - "true"

  SNSTopicCondition:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref SNSTopicArn
          - ""

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Condition: EnableCondition
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency"
      AlarmDescription: "P99 latency for event ingestion exceeds threshold"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If
          - SNSTopicCondition
          - !Ref SNSTopicArn
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Condition: EnableCondition
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate"
      AlarmDescription: "Average success rate below threshold"
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold

      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Description: Cognito User Pool, KMS Key, API Gateway with Cognito Authorizer

  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandUserPool
    Description: Name for the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyWebClient
    Description: Name for the application client
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://example.com/callback'
    Description: Callback URLs for the OAuth client
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://example.com/logout'
    Description: Logout URLs for the OAuth client
  KmsAliasName:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/MyAppKey
    Description: Alias name for the KMS key (must start with 'alias/')
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandAPI
    Description: Name for the API Gateway REST API

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      Schema:
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: email
          Required: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - 'mypool'
          - !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: petstore-api.example.com
      Name: !Sub '${UserPoolName}-ResourceServer'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: domestic.read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to domestic resources

  AppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppClientName}-${ResourceServer}'
      GenerateSecret: true
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for application encryption
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridge
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref KmsAliasName
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !Ref ApiName
          - !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn

  Authorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  ApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: 'https://httpbin.org/post'
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Initial deployment

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      MethodSettings:
        - HttpMethod: POST
          ResourcePath: /
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          MetricsEnabled: true
      TracingEnabled: true

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ApiEndpointUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the deployed API
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  AppClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the application client
    Value: !Ref AppClient
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  UserPoolDomainOAuthTokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for the user pool domain
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}/oauth2/token'

        Version: '2012-10-17'

            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Resource: '*'

              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow AWS Backup IAM role to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AWSBackupServiceRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", ["zendeskvalidation", !Ref DomainName]]
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600

        - !Ref ZendeskDomainValidationCnameValue

  ZendeskDkimCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Join [".", ["ze._domainkey", !Ref DomainName]]
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskDkimCnameValue

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

      Type: TXT

      ResourceRecords:

    Properties:

      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorDkimValue}"'

    Properties:

      Name: !Join [".", [!Ref CampaignMonitorSubdomain, !Ref DomainName]]
      Type: MX
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub "${CampaignMonitorMxPriority} ${CampaignMonitorMxTarget}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'E-commerce serverless IAM roles and managed policies'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: "Deployment environment used in resource names"

Resources:
  # SQS Queue KMS Key
  SQSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for SQS queue POC-Queue-${Environment}"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSQSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true

  SQSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/sqs-key-${Environment}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SQSKey

  # SQS Queue
  POCQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "POC-Queue-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SQSKey

  # DynamoDB Table
  OrdersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "ecommerce-orders-${Environment}"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: orderId
          KeyType: HASH
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # SNS Topic KMS Key
  SNSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for SNS topic POC-Topic-${Environment}"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSNSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true

  SNSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/sns-key-${Environment}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SNSKey

  # SNS Topic
  POCTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "POC-Topic-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SNSKey

  # Managed Policies
  BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "BasicLambdaExecution-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"

  LambdaSQSDynamoDBPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "LambdaSQSDynamoDB-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt POCQueue.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNS-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource:
              Fn::Sub:
                - "${TableArn}/stream/*"
                - TableArn: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref POCTopic

  APIGatewaySQSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "APIGatewaySQS-${Environment}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !GetAtt POCQueue.Arn

  # IAM Roles
  LambdaSQSDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "LambdaSQSDynamoDB-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref LambdaSQSDynamoDBPolicy

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPublisher:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNS-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPolicy

  APIGatewaySQSPublisher:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "APIGatewaySQS-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref APIGatewaySQSPolicy

Outputs:
  LambdaSQSDynamoDBRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda SQS DynamoDB role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaSQSDynamoDBRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LambdaSQSDynamoDBRoleArn"

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPublisherArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda DynamoDB Stream SNS publisher role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPublisher.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPublisherArn"

    Description: ARN of the API Gateway SQS publisher role
    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewaySQSPublisher.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-APIGatewaySQSPublisherArn"

    Properties:

    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet

    Description: "NAT Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template for AppStream 2.0 usage analysis with Athena named queries
Resources:
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: athena.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/AppStreamUsageWorkgroup'
  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/AppStreamUsageKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey
  AppStreamUsageDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: appstream-usage
        Description: Database for AppStream 2.0 usage data analyzed by Athena
  QueryResultsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref EncryptionKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  QueryResultsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref QueryResultsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: athena.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${QueryResultsBucket}'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/AppStreamUsageWorkgroup'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: athena.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${QueryResultsBucket}/athena-results/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:athena:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:workgroup/AppStreamUsageWorkgroup'
  AppStreamUsageWorkgroup:
    Type: AWS::Athena::WorkGroup
    Properties:
      Name: AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      State: ENABLED
      WorkGroupConfiguration:
        ResultConfiguration:
          OutputLocation: !Sub 's3://${QueryResultsBucket}/athena-results/'
          EncryptionConfiguration:
            EncryptionOption: SSE_KMS
            KmsKey: !GetAtt EncryptionKey.Arn
        EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration: true
  AverageSessionLengthPerStackQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AverageSessionLengthPerStack
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          stack_name,
          AVG(CASE
              WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time)
              END) AS avg_current_month_seconds,
          AVG(CASE
              WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' MONTH)
                THEN date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time)
              END) AS avg_previous_month_seconds
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_end_time IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name
  DailySessionCountsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: DailySessionCounts
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          CAST(session_start_time AS DATE) AS session_date,
          COUNT(*) AS session_count
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
        GROUP BY CAST(session_start_time AS DATE)
        ORDER BY session_date
  AllSessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AllSessionDetails
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          session_id,
          user_id,
          stack_name,
          application_name,
          session_start_time,
          session_end_time,
          session_status,
          instance_type,
          connection_protocol
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE session_start_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY
        ORDER BY session_start_time DESC
  StreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: StreamingHoursPerUser
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          user_id,
          SUM(date_diff('second', session_start_time, session_end_time) / 3600.0) AS streaming_hours
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
          AND session_end_time IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: UniqueUsersPerApplication
      Database: !Ref AppStreamUsageDatabase
      WorkGroup: !Ref AppStreamUsageWorkgroup
      QueryString: |
        SELECT
          application_name,
          COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
        GROUP BY application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC

Description: 'Three-tier VPC network foundation with 3 AZs, public, private app, and private database subnets, single NAT gateway.'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NATGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGatewayEIP

  NATGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NATGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ThreeTierNATGW

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az1-public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az2-public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az3-public

  # Private Application Subnets
  PrivateAppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az1-private-app

  PrivateAppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az2-private-app

  PrivateAppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az3-private-app

  # Private Database Subnets
  PrivateDBSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [6, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az1-private-db

  PrivateDBSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [7, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az2-private-db

  PrivateDBSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [8, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCIDR, 9, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: az3-private-db

  # Route Tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: public-rt

  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateDBSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable

  PrivateDBSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet2

  PrivateDBSubnet3Association:

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Comprehensive QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment"
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code"
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket to store Glue ETL scripts"

Resources:
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for S3 encryption
  AdminSuiteKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: admin-suite-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow ConsolidatedRole to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: admin-suite-kms-key

  AdminSuiteKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey

  # Consolidated IAM Role
  ConsolidatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: QuickSightAdminSuiteRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConsolidatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:StopTrigger
                  - glue:GetJobBookmark
                  - glue:BatchGetJobs
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/QuickSightAdminSuiteRole"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StartMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StopMetricStreams
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuiteRole

  # Admin S3 Bucket (data lake)
  AdminS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  AdminBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false

  # Script Bucket
  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucketName
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref AdminSuiteKmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  ScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false

  # Lambda for uploading Glue scripts - line-by-line script builder, no triple quotes
  ScriptUploadLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3,cfnresponse
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
            if event['RequestType'] != 'Create':
              cfnresponse.send(event,context,cfnresponse.SUCCESS,{})
              return
            lines = [
              'import boto3,json,sys',
              'from datetime import datetime',
              'qs=boto3.client(\'quicksight\')',
              'aid=boto3.client(\'sts\').get_caller_identity()[\'Account\']',
              'pipeline=\'assets_access\'',
              'for a in sys.argv[1:]:',
              '  if a.startswith(\'--pipeline_name=\'): pipeline=a.split(\'=\',1)[1];break',
              'c={',
              '\'assets_access\':{\'p\':\'list_users\',\'q\':{\'Namespace\':\'default\'},\'k\':\'UserList\',\'pre\':\'assets_access\'},',
              '\'dataset_metadata\':{\'p\':\'list_data_sets\',\'q\':{},\'k\':\'DataSetSummaries\',\'pre\':\'dataset_metadata\'},',
              '\'folder_assets\':{\'p\':\'list_folders\',\'q\':{},\'k\':\'FolderSummaryList\',\'pre\':\'folder_assets\'},',
              '\'q_metadata\':{\'p\':\'list_topics\',\'q\':{},\'k\':\'TopicsSummaries\',\'pre\':\'q_metadata\'},',
              '\'datasource_properties\':{\'p\':\'list_data_sources\',\'q\':{},\'k\':\'DataSources\',\'pre\':\'datasource_properties\'},',
              '}[pipeline]',
              'pg=qs.get_paginator(c[\'p\'])',
              'data=[]',
              'for p in pg.paginate(AwsAccountId=aid,**c[\'q\']):',
              '  i=p.get(c[\'k\'],[])',
              '  if pipeline==\'folder_assets\':',
              '    for f in i:',
              '      m=[]',
              '      try:',
              '        mp=qs.get_paginator(\'list_folder_members\')',
              '        for pp in mp.paginate(AwsAccountId=aid,FolderId=f[\'FolderId\']): m.extend(pp.get(\'FolderMemberList\',[]))',
              '      except: pass',
              '      data.append({\'folder\':f,\'members\':m})',
              '  else: data.extend(i)',
              's3=boto3.client(\'s3\')',
              's3.put_object(Bucket=\'admin-suite-\'+aid,Key=\'quicksight/\'+c[\'pre\']+\'/\'+datetime.utcnow().strftime(\'%Y/%m/%d/%H%M%S\')+\'.json\',Body=json.dumps(data,default=str))',
            ]
            SCRIPT = '\n'.join(lines)
            s3=boto3.client('s3')
            bucket=event['ResourceProperties']['ScriptBucketName']
            for n in ['assets_access.py','dataset_metadata.py','folder_assets.py','q_metadata.py','datasource_properties.py']:
              s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket,Key='scripts/'+n,Body=SCRIPT.encode())
            cfnresponse.send(event,context,cfnresponse.SUCCESS,{})

  # Custom resource to trigger script upload
  ScriptUpload:
    Type: Custom::ScriptUpload
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptUploadLambda.Arn
      ScriptBucketName: !Ref ScriptBucketName

  # Glue Jobs
  AssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUpload
    Properties:
      Name: assets-access-job
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 360
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/assets_access.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/tmp/"
        "--pipeline_name": "assets_access"

  DatasetMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUpload
    Properties:
      Name: dataset-metadata-job
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/dataset_metadata.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/tmp/"
        "--pipeline_name": "dataset_metadata"

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUpload
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets-job
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/folder_assets.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/tmp/"
        "--pipeline_name": "folder_assets"

  QMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUpload
    Properties:
      Name: q-metadata-job
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/q_metadata.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/tmp/"
        "--pipeline_name": "q_metadata"

  DatasourcePropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptUpload
    Properties:
      Name: datasource-properties-job
      Role: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/datasource_properties.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--TempDir": !Sub "s3://admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/tmp/"
        "--pipeline_name": "datasource_properties"

  # Glue Triggers – staggered daily at 02:00 UTC
  AssetsAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: assets-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      StartOnCreation: true
      Schedule: "cron(0 2 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsAccessJob

  DatasetMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: dataset-metadata-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      StartOnCreation: true
      Schedule: "cron(5 2 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasetMetadataJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      StartOnCreation: true
      Schedule: "cron(10 2 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  QMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: q-metadata-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      StartOnCreation: true
      Schedule: "cron(15 2 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QMetadataJob

  DatasourcePropertiesTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: datasource-properties-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      StartOnCreation: true
      Schedule: "cron(20 2 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasourcePropertiesJob

  # Kinesis Firehose Delivery Streams (DirectPut to admin bucket)
  FirehoseIngestion:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-ingestion-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/ingestion/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "cloudwatch/ingestion-errors/"

  FirehoseDashboard:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-dashboard-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/dashboard/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "cloudwatch/dashboard-errors/"

  FirehoseSpice:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-spice-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/spice/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "cloudwatch/spice-errors/"

  FirehoseQIndex:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-qindex-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/qindex/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "cloudwatch/qindex-errors/"

  FirehoseQAction:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: quicksight-qaction-firehose
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminS3Bucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
        Prefix: "cloudwatch/qaction/"
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 60
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        ErrorOutputPrefix: "cloudwatch/qaction-errors/"

  # CloudWatch Metric Streams (each with specific QuickSight metrics)
  MetricStreamIngestion:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-ingestion-stream
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseIngestion.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - "IngestionSuccess"
            - "IngestionFailure"
            - "IngestionRowsSuccess"
            - "IngestionRowsFailure"
            - "IngestionTime"

  MetricStreamDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-dashboard-stream
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseDashboard.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - "DashboardViewerCount"
            - "DashboardRenderTime"
            - "VisualRenderTime"
            - "DashboardAnonymousViewerCount"

  MetricStreamSpice:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-spice-stream
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseSpice.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - "SpiceCapacityUsage"
            - "SpiceStorageCapacity"
            - "SpiceStorageUsed"

  MetricStreamQIndex:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-qindex-stream
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseQIndex.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - "QSearchIndexDocumentCount"
            - "QSearchIndexTextSize"

  MetricStreamQAction:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-qaction-stream
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ConsolidatedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt FirehoseQAction.Arn
      OutputFormat: json
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - "QActionInvocationCount"
