AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Terraform state backend with S3, DynamoDB, KMS, IAM, CloudTrail, and log archive.

Parameters:
  Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Unique name used in resource names. Defaults to the AWS account ID.

  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional VPC ID to restrict S3 bucket access to.

  EnableCloudTrail:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable CloudTrail to log data events on the state bucket.

  CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of an existing CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail logs. Leave empty to use S3 only.

  AdminPrincipalArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: IAM principal ARN that can assume the state manager role. Defaults to root.

  ExecutionPrincipalArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: IAM principal ARN for execution (e.g., CI/CD) that can assume the state manager role. Defaults to root.

  RepositoryTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Required value for the aws:RequestTag/Repository condition in the trust policy. Defaults to Name parameter value.

  SsoPermissionSetArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of an SSO permission set. If provided, trust policy restricts to this principal.

Conditions:
  IsNameEmpty: !Equals [!Ref Name, '']
  IsAdminEmpty: !Equals [!Ref AdminPrincipalArn, '']
  IsExecEmpty: !Equals [!Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn, '']
  HasVpcId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  EnableCloudTrail: !Equals [!Ref EnableCloudTrail, 'true']
  HasCloudWatchLogs: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn, '']]
  HasTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RepositoryTagValue, '']]
  HasSso: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoPermissionSetArn, '']]
  HasTagAndSso: !And [!Condition HasTag, !Condition HasSso]
  HasTagOnly: !And [!Condition HasTag, !Not [!Condition HasSso]]
  HasSsoOnly: !And [!Not [!Condition HasTag], !Condition HasSso]
  EnableCloudTrailAndLogs: !And [!Condition EnableCloudTrail, !Condition HasCloudWatchLogs]

Resources:
  # ============================================================
  # KMS Key
  # ============================================================
  StateKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for Terraform state backend ${Name}'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  StateKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: "alias/terraform-state-backend-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref StateKmsKey

  # ============================================================
  # State S3 Bucket
  # ============================================================
  StateBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - 'terraform-state-${NameValue}'
          - NameValue: !If [IsNameEmpty, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref Name]
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref StateKmsKey
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrentVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  StateBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref StateBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - !If
            - HasVpcId
            - Sid: VpcRestrictedAccess
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !GetAtt StateManagerRole.Arn
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource:
                - !GetAtt StateBucket.Arn
                - !Sub '${StateBucket.Arn}/*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'aws:SourceVpc': !Ref VpcId
            - Sid: UnrestrictedAccess
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !GetAtt StateManagerRole.Arn
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource:
                - !GetAtt StateBucket.Arn
                - !Sub '${StateBucket.Arn}/*'

  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB Table for State Locking
  # ============================================================
  StateLockTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - 'terraform-state-lock-${NameValue}'
          - NameValue: !If [IsNameEmpty, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref Name]
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: LockID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: LockID
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref StateKmsKey

  # ============================================================
  # Log Archive Bucket
  # ============================================================
  LogArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - 'terraform-log-archive-${NameValue}'
          - NameValue: !If [IsNameEmpty, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref Name]
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref StateKmsKey
      ObjectLockEnabled: true
      ObjectLockConfiguration:
        ObjectLockEnabled: Enabled
        Rule:
          DefaultRetention:
            Mode: GOVERNANCE
            Days: 30
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: GlacierTransition
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 30
          - Id: ExpireAfter365Days
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # ============================================================
  # IAM Role for Managing State
  # ============================================================
  StateManagerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - 'terraform-state-manager-${NameValue}'
          - NameValue: !If [IsNameEmpty, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref Name]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - !If
            - HasTagAndSso
            - Sid: AllowWithBoth
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS:
                  - !If [IsAdminEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref AdminPrincipalArn]
                  - !If [IsExecEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn]
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'aws:RequestTag/Repository': !Ref RepositoryTagValue
                  'aws:PrincipalArn': !Ref SsoPermissionSetArn
            - !If
              - HasTagOnly
              - Sid: AllowWithTag
                Effect: Allow
                Principal:
                  AWS:
                    - !If [IsAdminEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref AdminPrincipalArn]
                    - !If [IsExecEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn]
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:RequestTag/Repository': !Ref RepositoryTagValue
              - !If
                - HasSsoOnly
                - Sid: AllowWithSso
                  Effect: Allow
                  Principal:
                    AWS:
                      - !If [IsAdminEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref AdminPrincipalArn]
                      - !If [IsExecEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn]
                  Action: sts:AssumeRole
                  Condition:
                    StringEquals:
                      'aws:PrincipalArn': !Ref SsoPermissionSetArn
                - Sid: AllowDefault
                  Effect: Allow
                  Principal:
                    AWS:
                      - !If [IsAdminEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref AdminPrincipalArn]
                      - !If [IsExecEmpty, !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root', !Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn]
                  Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateManagerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Access
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StateBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StateBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt StateLockTable.Arn
              - Sid: KMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !Ref StateKmsKey
      MaxSessionDuration: 43200
      Path: /

  # ============================================================
  # CloudTrail (Optional)
  # ============================================================
  CloudTrailRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableCloudTrailAndLogs
    Properties:
      RoleName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - 'terraform-state-cloudtrail-cw-${NameValue}'
          - NameValue: !If [IsNameEmpty, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref Name]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn}:log-stream:*'

  StateTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    Condition: EnableCloudTrail
    Properties:
      TrailName:
        Fn::Sub:
          - 'terraform-state-trail-${NameValue}'
          - NameValue: !If [IsNameEmpty, !Ref 'AWS::AccountId', !Ref Name]
      S3BucketName: !Ref LogArchiveBucket
      S3KeyPrefix: 'cloudtrail'
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: false
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      IsLogging: true
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt StateKmsKey.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !If
        - HasCloudWatchLogs
        - !Ref CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !If
        - HasCloudWatchLogs
        - !GetAtt CloudTrailRole.Arn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      EventSelectors:
        - ReadWriteType: All
          IncludeManagementEvents: true
          DataResources:
            - Type: AWS::S3::Object
              Values:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${StateBucket}/'

Outputs:
  StateBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for Terraform state
    Value: !Ref StateBucket
  StateLockTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table for state locking
    Value: !Ref StateLockTable
  StateManagerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for managing state
    Value: !GetAtt StateManagerRole.Arn
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: KMS key ID used for encryption
    Value: !Ref StateKmsKey
  LogArchiveBucketName:
    Description: Name of the log archive bucket
    Value: !Ref LogArchiveBucket
  CloudTrailName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
    Condition: EnableCloudTrail
    Value: !Ref StateTrail

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained EKS cluster with node groups for EMR on EKS Spark workloads, with required security groups and IAM roles.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-celeborn-demo
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and tagging.

  GeneralInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.xlarge
    AllowedValues:
      - m5.xlarge
      - m5.2xlarge
      - m5.4xlarge
    Description: Instance type for the general system node group.

  SparkInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: r5.2xlarge
    AllowedValues:
      - r5.2xlarge
      - r5.4xlarge
      - r5.8xlarge
    Description: Instance type for the Spark executor node group.

  GeneralMinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Minimum number of nodes in the general node group.

  GeneralMaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Maximum number of nodes in the general node group.

  GeneralDesiredSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired number of nodes in the general node group.

  SparkMinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Minimum number of nodes in the Spark node group.

  SparkMaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: Maximum number of nodes in the Spark node group.

  SparkDesiredSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Desired number of nodes in the Spark node group.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      RouteTableIds: [!Ref PrivateRouteTable1, !Ref PrivateRouteTable2]
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup]
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup]
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-vpc-endpoint-sg"

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-rt-1"

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-rt-2"

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EksEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for EKS cluster secret encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt EksClusterRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-eks-encryption-key"

  EksEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}-eks-encryption-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EksEncryptionKey

  EksClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-eks-cluster-role"

  EksClusterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS cluster control plane
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-eks-cluster-sg"

  EksCluster:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EksClusterRole.Arn
      ResourcesVpcConfig:
        SubnetIds:
          - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
          - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref EksClusterSecurityGroup
        EndpointPublicAccess: false
        EndpointPrivateAccess: true
      EncryptionConfig:
        - Provider:
            KeyArn: !GetAtt EksEncryptionKey.Arn
          Resources:
            - secrets
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  EmrClusterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EMR on EKS cluster communication
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-cluster-sg"

  EmrCelebornAccessSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Celeborn access
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 9097
          ToPort: 9099
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-celeborn-access-sg"

  NodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-nodegroup-role"

  NodeGroupLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}-nodegroup-lt"
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: "{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-6.1-x86_64}}"
        BlockDeviceMappings:
          - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
            Ebs:
              VolumeSize: 50
              VolumeType: gp3
              DeleteOnTermination: true
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref EmrClusterSecurityGroup
          - !Ref EmrCelebornAccessSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-node"
              - Key: Project
                Value: !Ref ProjectName

  GeneralNodeGroup:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Nodegroup
    DependsOn: EksCluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}"
      NodegroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-${AWS::StackName}-general-ng"
      ScalingConfig:
        MinSize: !Ref GeneralMinSize
        MaxSize: !Ref GeneralMaxSize
        DesiredSize: !Ref GeneralDesiredSize
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref GeneralInstanceType
      CapacityType: ON_DEMAND
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Puppet Quick Start VPC infrastructure with Route53 hosted zone and A records."

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16)
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
    Default: "10.0.0.0/19"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/19)
  PuppetIP:
    Type: String
    Description: IP address for puppet.example.com
    Default: "10.0.0.10"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP address (e.g., 10.0.0.10)
  LinuxAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Description: IP address for linuxagent.example.com
    Default: "10.0.0.11"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP address (e.g., 10.0.0.11)
  WindowsAgentIP:
    Type: String
    Description: IP address for windowsagent.example.com
    Default: "10.0.0.12"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP address (e.g., 10.0.0.12)

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet VPC

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Public Subnet

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Puppet Public Route Table

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: example.com.
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Hosted zone for Puppet Quick Start

  PuppetRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetIP

  LinuxAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIP

  WindowsAgentRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: The ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained AWS FIS experiment template for cross-region chaos engineering'

Parameters:
  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1200
    MinValue: 60
    Description: 'Duration (in seconds) for each FIS action (e.g., network disruption)'
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: 'us-east-1'
    AllowedPattern: '[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]'
    Description: 'Target region for cross-region disruptions'
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    Description: 'Retention period (days) for experiment logs in CloudWatch Logs'

Resources:
  # KMS Key for encrypting experiment logs
  ExperimentKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for FIS experiment CloudWatch Logs'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'Enable IAM User Permissions'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptFrom'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptTo'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'Allow FIS service to use the key'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'fis.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptFrom'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptTo'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true

  # CloudWatch Log Group for FIS experiment logs
  ExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}-experiment-logs'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ExperimentKMSKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  # IAM Role for FIS service (all permissions via inline policies)
  FISExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'fis.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FISExperimentNetworkAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:DescribeTransitGateways'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayVpcAttachments'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeSubnets'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeVpcs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeRouteTables'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTags'
                  - 'ec2:StopInstances'
                Resource: '*'

  # Dummy CloudWatch Alarm for FIS stop condition (never triggers)
  ExperimentStopAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fis-stop-alarm'
      AlarmDescription: 'Dummy alarm that never triggers - used to satisfy FIS stop condition requirement'
      Namespace: 'AWS/Logs'
      MetricName: 'IncomingLogEvents'
      Statistic: 'Sum'
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 999999999
      ComparisonOperator: 'GreaterThanThreshold'
      TreatMissingData: 'notBreaching'
      Dimensions:
        - Name: 'LogGroupName'
          Value: !Ref ExperimentLogGroup

  # FIS Experiment Template
  FISExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: 'Chaos experiment - stop EC2 instances tagged ChaosAllowed=true'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: 'aws:cloudwatch:alarm'
          Value: !GetAtt ExperimentStopAlarm.Arn
      ExperimentOptions:
        EmptyTargetResolutionMode: skip
      Targets:
        EC2InstanceTarget:
          ResourceType: 'aws:ec2:instance'
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: 'ALL'
      Actions:
        EC2StopInstances:
          ActionId: 'aws:ec2:stop-instances'
          Description: 'Stop EC2 instances tagged ChaosAllowed=true as chaos experiment'
          Targets:
            Instances: 'EC2InstanceTarget'
      Tags:
        TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
        ExperimentDurationSeconds: !Ref ExperimentDuration
        ExperimentPurpose: 'ChaosEngineering'

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: 'ID of the created FIS experiment template'
    Value: !Ref FISExperimentTemplate
  FISRoleArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the IAM role used by FIS'
    Value: !GetAtt FISExperimentRole.Arn
  ExperimentLogGroupName:
    Description: 'Name of the CloudWatch Log Group for experiment logs'
    Value: !Ref ExperimentLogGroup
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the KMS key used for log encryption'
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentKMSKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map service discovery,
  VPC, NAT gateway, auto scaling, and CloudWatch logging.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name used to tag resources and prefix names.
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+'
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the microservice.
    Default: nginx
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+'
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI (e.g., nginx:latest).
    Default: nginx:latest
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Port the container listens on.
    Default: 80
  Cpu:
    Type: Number
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task (256, 512, 1024, etc.).
    Default: 256
  Memory:
    Type: Number
    Description: Memory for the Fargate task in MB (512, 1024, 2048, etc.).
    Default: 512
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of tasks to run initially.
    Default: 2
  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN for the task to assume (leave empty to omit).
    Default: ""

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, ""]]

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnet (for NAT gateway)
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public"

  # Private subnets (two AZs)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-2"

  # NAT Gateway
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat"

  # Route tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security group for containers
  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg"

  # ECS Cluster
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"

  # CloudWatch Log Group
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # IAM Execution Role
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-exec-role"

  # Task Definition
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${ServiceName}-task"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !Ref ExecutionRole
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomTaskRole, !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref "AWS::Region"
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName

  # Cloud Map Private DNS Namespace
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ServiceName}.local"
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: !Sub "Private namespace for ${ServiceName}"

  # Cloud Map Service
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  # ECS Service
  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn

  # Application Auto Scaling
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${ECSCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10

  # Scale-out alarm
  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scaleout"
      AlarmDescription: "Scale out when CPU >= 70% for 2 minutes"
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Scale-out step scaling policy
  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scaleout"
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 10
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 10
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
        Cooldown: 120
        MetricAggregationType: Average

  # Scale-in alarm
  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scalein"
      AlarmDescription: "Scale in when CPU <= 20% for 15 minutes"
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  # Scale-in step scaling policy
  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scalein"
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - ScalingAdjustment: -1
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: Task definition ARN
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition
  ServiceArn:
    Description: ECS Service ARN
    Value: !Ref ECSService
  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: Cloud Map service ARN for service discovery
    Value: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
  CloudMapNamespaceId:
    Description: Cloud Map namespace ID
    Value: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log group name
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect with OCI"

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.10.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    Description: "CIDR block for the private subnet"

  InternalCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    Description: "Allowed inbound HTTPS source CIDR (internal corporate network)"

  OCIBackboneCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    Description: "CIDR of the OCI backbone for outbound HTTPS and VPN static route"

  CreateVPN:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Set to true to create a customer gateway and VPN connection to OCI"

  OCIVpnEndpointIP:
    Type: String
    Default: "0.0.0.0"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$"
    Description: "Public IP address of the OCI VPN endpoint (required if CreateVPN=true)"

  BgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967294
    Description: "BGP ASN for the customer gateway"

  AmazonSideAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967294
    Description: "Private ASN for the Transit Gateway"

Conditions:
  CreateVPNCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateVPN, "true"]

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Private Subnet (first AZ)
  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet"

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  DefaultRouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref AmazonSideAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: "disable"
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: "disable"
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: "disable"
      DnsSupport: "enable"
      VpnEcmpSupport: "enable"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tgw"

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attach-vpc"

  # Explicit Transit Gateway Route Table
  TGWRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt"

  # Associate the VPC attachment with the explicit route table
  TGWRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable

  # Security Group
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for hybrid interconnect demo"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR
          Description: "HTTPS from internal network"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
          Description: "HTTPS to OCI backbone"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sg"

  # Conditional VPN resources
  CustomerGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: !Ref BgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref OCIVpnEndpointIP
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cgw"

  VpnConnection:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpn"

  VpnConnectionRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VpnConnection

  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VpnConnection
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TGWRouteTable

  # KMS Key for Flow Logs
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "AllowTaggedRoles"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalTag/FlowLogRole: "true"
          - Sid: "AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}"

  FlowLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # CloudWatch Log Group for Flow Logs
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role"
        - Key: FlowLogRole
          Value: "true"

  # VPC Flow Log
  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC

  SubnetId:
    Description: "Private subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref Subnet

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: "Transit Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID"
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: "KMS Key ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: "CloudWatch Log Group name for VPC Flow Logs"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained CloudFormation stack for QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline"

Parameters:
  GroupMembershipScript:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/group_membership.py
    Description: S3 key for the group membership PythonShell script
  ObjectAccessScript:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/object_access.py
    Description: S3 key for the object access PythonShell script
  FolderAssetsScript:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/folder_assets.py
    Description: S3 key for the folder assets PythonShell script
  FolderLookupScript:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/folder_lookup.py
    Description: S3 key for the folder lookup Glue ETL script
  FolderPathScript:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/folder_path.py
    Description: S3 key for the folder path Glue ETL script

Resources:
  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  BucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      Description: "Customer managed KMS key for QuickSight admin pipeline S3 bucket"

  # S3 Bucket with public access block and SSE-KMS
  Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BucketEncryptionKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  # IAM Role for Glue Jobs – S3 permissions restricted to the specific bucket
  GlueJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueJobPipelineAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${Bucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${Bucket}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:*
                  - quicksight:*
                  - glue:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: "*"

  # Glue Jobs (3 PythonShell, 2 Glue ETL)
  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: group-membership
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/${GroupMembershipScript}"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: object-access
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/${ObjectAccessScript}"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/${FolderAssetsScript}"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-lookup
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/${FolderLookupScript}"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: folder-path
      Role: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/${FolderPathScript}"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  # Scheduled Triggers (every 3 hours)
  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: group-membership-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: object-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-lookup-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: folder-path-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob

Outputs:
  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for group membership data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/group-membership/"

  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for object access data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/object-access/"

  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder assets data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/folder-assets/"

  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder lookup data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/folder-lookup/"

  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder path data
    Value: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/folder-path/"

  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log table in Glue Data Catalog
    Value: "cloudtrail_log_table"

  CloudTrailS3Location:
    Description: S3 location for CloudTrail logs
    Value: !Sub "s3://${Bucket}/cloudtrail-logs/"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automated photo analysis system using S3, Lambda, Step Functions, Rekognition, and SNS.

Parameters:
  PhoneNumber:
    Type: String
    Default: '+14070000000'
    Description: Phone number for SMS notifications.

Resources:
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for SNS topic and S3 bucket encryption
  PhotoAnalysisKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SNS topic and S3 bucket encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  # S3 Bucket for image uploads
  PhotoAnalysisBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref PhotoAnalysisKmsKey

  # Bucket policy to explicitly deny all public access
  PhotoAnalysisBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PhotoAnalysisBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${PhotoAnalysisBucket.Arn}'
              - !Sub '${PhotoAnalysisBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': false

  # SNS Topic for SMS
  SnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: PhotoAnalysisSMS
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref PhotoAnalysisKmsKey

  SnsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: sms
      TopicArn: !Ref SnsTopic
      Endpoint: !Ref PhoneNumber

  # IAM role for ImageIngestionHandler Lambda
  ImageIngestionHandlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageIngestionHandlerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/ImageIngestionHandler:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StepFunctionsStateMachine

  # Lambda function: ImageIngestionHandler
  ImageIngestionHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ImageIngestionHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ImageIngestionHandlerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref StepFunctionsStateMachine
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          stepfunctions = boto3.client('stepfunctions')
          state_machine_arn = os.environ['STATE_MACHINE_ARN']

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              records = event.get('Records', [])
              for record in records:
                  bucket = record['s3']['bucket']['name']
                  key = record['s3']['object']['key']
                  input_payload = json.dumps({'bucket': bucket, 'key': key})
                  stepfunctions.start_execution(
                      stateMachineArn=state_machine_arn,
                      input=input_payload
                  )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Executions started'}

  # Lambda permission for S3 to invoke ImageIngestionHandler
  ImageIngestionHandlerPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt ImageIngestionHandler.Arn
      Principal: s3.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt PhotoAnalysisBucket.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # IAM role for RekognitionAnalyzer Lambda

              - Effect: Allow

  # Lambda function: RekognitionAnalyzer
  RekognitionAnalyzer:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: RekognitionAnalyzer
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt RekognitionAnalyzerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3

          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              bucket = event.get('bucket')
              key = event.get('key')
              if not bucket or not key:
                  return {'humanFound': False}
              try:
                  response = rekognition.detect_faces(
                      Image={
                          'S3Object': {
                              'Bucket': bucket,
                              'Name': key
                          }
                      },
                      Attributes=['ALL']
                  )
                  # Return true if at least one face detected
                  return {'humanFound': len(response.get('FaceDetails', [])) > 0}
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error detecting faces: {e}")
                  return {'humanFound': False}

  SnsNotifierRole:

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - PolicyName: SnsNotifierPolicy

                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt PhotoAnalysisKmsKey.Arn

  # Lambda function: SnsNotifier
  SnsNotifier:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: SnsNotifier
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt SnsNotifierRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SnsTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          sns = boto3.client('sns')
          topic_arn = os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN']

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              bucket = event.get('bucket')
              key = event.get('key')
              message = f"Human detected in image: s3://{bucket}/{key}"
              sns.publish(
                  TopicArn=topic_arn,
                  Message=message,
                  Subject='Photo Analysis: Human Found'
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Notification sent'}

  # IAM role for Step Functions state machine
  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsInvokeLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RekognitionAnalyzer.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SnsNotifier.Arn

  # Step Functions state machine
  StepFunctionsStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: PhotoAnalysisStateMachine
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Analyze image for human detection and optionally notify",
          "StartAt": "AnalyzeImage",
          "States": {
            "AnalyzeImage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${RekognitionAnalyzer.Arn}",
              "ResultPath": "$.analysisResult",
              "Next": "CheckHuman"
            },
            "CheckHuman": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.analysisResult.humanFound",
                  "BooleanEquals": true,
                  "Next": "NotifyHuman"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "EndNoHuman"
            },
            "NotifyHuman": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "${SnsNotifier.Arn}",
              "End": true
            },
            "EndNoHuman": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": { "message": "No human detected" },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  # IAM role for custom resource Lambda (bucket notification)
  BucketNotificationCustomResourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BucketNotificationCustomResourcePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/BucketNotificationCustomResourceFunction:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:PutBucketNotification
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoAnalysisBucket.Arn}'

  # Lambda function to handle custom resource lifecycle
  BucketNotificationCustomResourceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: BucketNotificationCustomResourceFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt BucketNotificationCustomResourceRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              response_data = {}
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  properties = event['ResourceProperties']
                  bucket_name = properties['BucketName']
                  lambda_arn = properties['LambdaFunctionArn']
                  event_type = properties['EventType']

                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      notification_config = {
                          'LambdaFunctionConfigurations': [
                              {
                                  'LambdaFunctionArn': lambda_arn,
                                  'Events': [event_type]
                              }
                          ]
                      }
                      s3.put_bucket_notification_configuration(
                          Bucket=bucket_name,
                          NotificationConfiguration=notification_config
                      )
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      # Remove the configuration
                      s3.put_bucket_notification_configuration(
                          Bucket=bucket_name,
                          NotificationConfiguration={}
                      )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error: {e}")
                  response_data['Error'] = str(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, response_data)

  # Custom resource to attach bucket notification, breaking the circular dependency
  PhotoAnalysisBucketNotification:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: ImageIngestionHandlerPermission
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt BucketNotificationCustomResourceFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref PhotoAnalysisBucket
      LambdaFunctionArn: !GetAtt ImageIngestionHandler.Arn
      EventType: s3:ObjectCreated:*

Outputs:
  PhotoAnalysisBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for uploading images.
    Value: !Ref PhotoAnalysisBucket
    Export:
      Name: PhotoAnalysisBucketName
