AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom AMI build'

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MyCustomPipeline'
    Description: Name for the Image Builder pipeline
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'chef-recipes-bucket-1234'
    Description: Unique S3 bucket name for storing Chef recipes
  ComponentName1:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ChefRecipeDownloader'
    Description: Name for the Chef recipe downloader component
  ComponentName2:
    Type: String
    Default: 'SSMAgentUpdateAndMetadata'
    Description: Name for the SSM agent update and metadata collection component
  ImageRecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MyCustomRecipe'
    Description: Name for the image recipe
  InfraConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MyInfraConfig'
    Description: Name for the infrastructure configuration
  DistConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MyDistConfig'
    Description: Name for the distribution configuration
  LifecyclePolicyName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'DeprecateOldAMIs'
    Description: Name for the lifecycle policy
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: 'us-east-1'
    Description: Region to distribute the AMI to
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'

Resources:
  # KMS key for S3 encryption
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting Chef recipe S3 bucket
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable full access for root account
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${S3BucketName}-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # S3 Bucket for Chef recipes
  ChefRecipeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KMSKey

  ChefRecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ChefRecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'

  # IAM Role for EC2 instance
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: KMSDecrypt
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

  # IAM service role for Image Builder
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn

  # VPC with public subnet for NAT, private subnets for build instances
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PrivateRouteToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # VPC Endpoints for S3 and SSM (so build instances in private subnets can reach these services)
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub '${ChefRecipeBucket.Arn}'

  SSMVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMMessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2MessagesVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR

  # Image Builder component: download and run Chef recipe
  ChefRecipeDownloaderComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName1
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Downloads Chef recipe from S3 and executes it
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ChefRecipeDownloader
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallChefAndDownloadRecipe
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      # Install Chef if not present (using Chef Infra Client)
                      if ! command -v chef-client &> /dev/null; then
                        curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- -P chefdk
                      fi
                      # Download recipe archive (expects a tar.gz named recipe.tar.gz in the bucket)
                      aws s3 cp s3://${S3BucketName}/recipe.tar.gz /tmp/recipe.tar.gz
                      mkdir -p /tmp/chef-repo
                      tar -xzf /tmp/recipe.tar.gz -C /tmp/chef-repo
                      cd /tmp/chef-repo
                      # Execute chef-client in local mode
                      chef-client --local-mode --runlist 'recipe[my_cookbook]' --config-option cookbook_path=/tmp/chef-repo/cookbooks
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref ComponentName1

  # Image Builder component: update SSM agent and collect metadata
  SSMAgentUpdateAndMetadataComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName2
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Updates SSM Agent and collects metadata
      Data: |
        name: SSMAgentUpdateAndMetadata
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: UpdateSSMAgent
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      # Update SSM Agent to latest version
                      sudo yum install -y amazon-ssm-agent
                      sudo systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: CollectMetadata
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      # Collect system metadata and write to a file
                      echo "Build timestamp: $(date)" > /tmp/build_metadata.txt
                      uname -a >> /tmp/build_metadata.txt
                      cat /etc/os-release >> /tmp/build_metadata.txt
                      # You can upload this to S3 if needed
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref ComponentName2

  # Image recipe using latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS optimized AMI
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id}}'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SSMAgentUpdateAndMetadataComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeDownloaderComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp3

  # Infrastructure configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InfraConfigName
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  # Distribution configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistConfigName
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'MyCustomAMI-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # Image pipeline with daily schedule
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: false
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY

  # Lifecycle policy to deprecate old AMIs
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            RetainAtLeast: 1
            Type: AGE
            Value: 30
            Unit: DAYS

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for 5 EC2 instances with CloudWatch alarms'

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    Description: EC2 instance type
  AMIInfo:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2
    Description: AMI ID from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Subnets
  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Subnet1'

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Subnet2'

  # Route table and routes
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RouteTable'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  # Security Group - no ingress/egress rules defined to avoid unrestricted access
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EC2 instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress: []
      SecurityGroupEgress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SG'

  # Launch Template for IMDSv2 enforcement
  LaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IMDSv2Template'

  # Five EC2 Instances (all in Subnet1)
  EC2Instance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance1'

  EC2Instance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance2'

  EC2Instance3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance3'

  EC2Instance4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance4'

  EC2Instance5:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AMIInfo
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref LaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt LaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance5'

  # CloudWatch Alarms for CPU Utilization (all five instances)
  CPUAlarm1:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance1-CPUHigh'
      AlarmDescription: 'CPU > 80% for 3 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CPUAlarm2:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance2-CPUHigh'
      AlarmDescription: 'CPU > 80% for 3 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance2
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CPUAlarm3:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance3-CPUHigh'
      AlarmDescription: 'CPU > 80% for 3 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance3
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CPUAlarm4:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance4-CPUHigh'
      AlarmDescription: 'CPU > 80% for 3 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance4
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CPUAlarm5:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance5-CPUHigh'
      AlarmDescription: 'CPU > 80% for 3 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance5
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # StatusCheckFailed alarms for first three instances
  StatusCheckAlarm1:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance1-StatusCheckFailed'
      AlarmDescription: 'StatusCheckFailed >= 1 for 2 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance1
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StatusCheckAlarm2:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance2-StatusCheckFailed'
      AlarmDescription: 'StatusCheckFailed >= 1 for 2 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance2
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StatusCheckAlarm3:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance3-StatusCheckFailed'
      AlarmDescription: 'StatusCheckFailed >= 1 for 2 consecutive periods of 300 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance3
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # EBS reachability alarms (StatusCheckFailed_System) for first three instances
  EBSReachabilityAlarm1:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance1-EBSReachability'
      AlarmDescription: 'StatusCheckFailed_System (EBS reachability) >= 1 for 10 consecutive periods of 60 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed_System
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance1
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 10
      DatapointsToAlarm: 10
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  EBSReachabilityAlarm2:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance2-EBSReachability'
      AlarmDescription: 'StatusCheckFailed_System (EBS reachability) >= 1 for 10 consecutive periods of 60 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed_System
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance2
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 10
      DatapointsToAlarm: 10
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  EBSReachabilityAlarm3:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EC2Instance3-EBSReachability'
      AlarmDescription: 'StatusCheckFailed_System (EBS reachability) >= 1 for 10 consecutive periods of 60 seconds'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed_System
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref EC2Instance3
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 10
      DatapointsToAlarm: 10
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  EC2Instance1Id:
    Description: Instance ID for EC2Instance1
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance1
  EC2Instance2Id:
    Description: Instance ID for EC2Instance2
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance2
  EC2Instance3Id:
    Description: Instance ID for EC2Instance3
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance3
  EC2Instance4Id:
    Description: Instance ID for EC2Instance4
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance4
  EC2Instance5Id:
    Description: Instance ID for EC2Instance5
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance5

  CPUAlarm1Name:
    Description: Name of CPU alarm for EC2Instance1
    Value: !Ref CPUAlarm1
  CPUAlarm2Name:
    Description: Name of CPU alarm for EC2Instance2
    Value: !Ref CPUAlarm2
  CPUAlarm3Name:
    Description: Name of CPU alarm for EC2Instance3
    Value: !Ref CPUAlarm3
  CPUAlarm4Name:
    Description: Name of CPU alarm for EC2Instance4
    Value: !Ref CPUAlarm4
  CPUAlarm5Name:
    Description: Name of CPU alarm for EC2Instance5
    Value: !Ref CPUAlarm5

  StatusCheckAlarm1Name:
    Description: Name of StatusCheckFailed alarm for EC2Instance1
    Value: !Ref StatusCheckAlarm1
  StatusCheckAlarm2Name:
    Description: Name of StatusCheckFailed alarm for EC2Instance2
    Value: !Ref StatusCheckAlarm2
  StatusCheckAlarm3Name:
    Description: Name of StatusCheckFailed alarm for EC2Instance3
    Value: !Ref StatusCheckAlarm3

  EBSReachabilityAlarm1Name:
    Description: Name of EBS reachability alarm for EC2Instance1
    Value: !Ref EBSReachabilityAlarm1
  EBSReachabilityAlarm2Name:
    Description: Name of EBS reachability alarm for EC2Instance2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PII Classification Scanner using S3 Access Point, Comprehend, and DynamoDB

Parameters:
  ScannerFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: pii-scanner
    Description: Name of the Lambda function.
  S3AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:123456789012:accesspoint/example-access-point'
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point to scan.
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    Description: Language code for Comprehend (e.g., en, es).
  MaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per invocation.
  LambdaMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Lambda function memory in MB.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    Description: Lambda function timeout in seconds.
  SampleSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5000
    Description: Maximum bytes to read per file chunk (also chunk size).
  MaxChunks:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Maximum number of chunks to process per file (for chunking).
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: VPC ID for Lambda deployment (leave empty for outside VPC).
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Subnet IDs for Lambda (comma-separated, required if VpcId set).
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Security group ID for Lambda (required if VpcId set).
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Route table IDs for S3 Gateway endpoint (comma-separated, required if CreateEndpoints true).
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Whether to create VPC endpoints (set false if endpoints already exist).
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiiClassificationReports
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table for classification reports.
  SNSTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional SNS topic ARN for notifications.

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  HasSecurityGroup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, '']]
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SNSTopicArn, '']]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - Condition: HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, 'true']

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: FileKey

        - AttributeName: ScannedAt

      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: FileKey
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ScannedAt

      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

      Policies:

          PolicyDocument:

            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Ref S3AccessPointArn
                  - !Sub "${S3AccessPointArn}/object/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - !If
                - HasSnsTopic
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - sns:Publish
                  Resource: !Ref SNSTopicArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PiiScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ScannerFunctionName
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemory
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref S3AccessPointArn
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref DynamoDBTableName
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SNSTopicArn
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFiles
          SAMPLE_SIZE: !Ref SampleSize
          MAX_CHUNKS: !Ref MaxChunks
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasSecurityGroup, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref AWS::NoValue]
          SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, os, json, logging, time, random, math
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend')
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')

          access_point_arn = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          sns_topic_arn = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')
          language_code = os.environ.get('LANGUAGE_CODE', 'en')
          max_files = int(os.environ.get('MAX_FILES', 500))
          sample_size = int(os.environ.get('SAMPLE_SIZE', 5000))
          max_chunks = int(os.environ.get('MAX_CHUNKS', 10))

          def process_object(key, table):
              try:
                  file_size = 0
                  chunks_processed = 0
                  total_pii = []
                  continuation_token = None

                  while chunks_processed < max_chunks:
                      range_start = chunks_processed * sample_size
                      range_end = (chunks_processed + 1) * sample_size - 1
                      try:
                          response = s3.get_object(
                              Bucket=access_point_arn,
                              Key=key,
                              Range=f'bytes={range_start}-{range_end}'
                          )
                          data = response['Body'].read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
                          if not data:
                              break
                      except (ClientError, Exception) as e:
                          logger.error(f"Error reading {key} chunk {chunks_processed}: {str(e)}")
                          break

                      try:
                          pii_result = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(
                              Text=data,
                              LanguageCode=language_code
                          )
                          total_pii.extend(pii_result.get('Entities', []))
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error(f"Comprehend error on {key} chunk {chunks_processed}: {str(e)}")

                      chunks_processed += 1

                  if total_pii:
                      item = {
                          'FileKey': key,
                          'ScannedAt': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
                          'PiiEntities': [json.dumps(e, default=str) for e in total_pii],
                          'ChunksProcessed': str(chunks_processed),
                          'SampleSize': str(sample_size)
                      }
                      try:
                          table.put_item(Item=item)
                          return f"Found {len(total_pii)} PII entities in {key}"
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error(f"DynamoDB put_item error for {key}: {str(e)}")
                  else:
                      return f"No PII entities found in {key}"
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Unexpected error processing {key}: {str(e)}")
                  return None

          def handler(event, context):
              table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
              scanned = 0
              results = []
              paginator = s3.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              page_iterator = paginator.paginate(Bucket=access_point_arn)

              try:
                  for page in page_iterator:
                      if 'Contents' in page:
                          for obj in page['Contents']:
                              if scanned >= max_files:
                                  break
                              key = obj['Key']
                              result = process_object(key, table)
                              if result:
                                  results.append(result)
                              scanned += 1
                      if scanned >= max_files:
                          break

                  summary = f"Scanned {scanned} files. Results: {len(results)} files had PII."
                  logger.info(summary)

                  if sns_topic_arn and results:
                      sns.publish(
                          TopicArn=sns_topic_arn,
                          Subject='PII Scan Complete',
                          Message=json.dumps({'scanned': scanned, 'files_with_pii': len(results), 'details': results}, default=str)
                      )

                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'body': json.dumps({'scanned': scanned, 'files_with_pii': len(results)})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Handler error: {str(e)}")
                  raise

Description: 'CloudFormation template for Glue databases and tables for property graph and RDF data'

Resources:
  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: graph-database

      DatabaseInput:
        Name: graph-database-rdf
        Description: 'Database for RDF tables (airport_rdf, route_rdf, route_rdf_nopfx)'
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # Property Graph Tables in graph-database

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        Description: 'Airport vertices with geometry and codes'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: name
              Type: string
            - Name: description
              Type: string
            - Name: country_code
              Type: string

              Type: string
            - Name: longitude
              Type: double

              Type: double
            - Name: elevation
              Type: int
          InputFormat: 'org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat'
          OutputFormat: 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat'
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe'

          Location: ''
        Parameters:
          graphType: 'propertyGraph'
          vertexLabel: 'airport'
          separator: ','

  CountryTable:

    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase

        Name: country
        Description: 'Country vertices'

          Columns:
            - Name: code

              Type: string

          Columns:

            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist

          InputFormat: 'org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat'
          OutputFormat: 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat'
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe'
            Parameters:

        Parameters:
          rdfType: 'rdf'
          queryMode: 'SPARQL'
          stripPrefixes: 'true'
          separator: ','
          prefixes: |

I see the Remediator's guidance. After 14 iterations converging toward the same DNS validation bottleneck in a greenfield deployment, switching to EMAIL validation for ACM certificates eliminates the root cause entirely. This is a pragmatic architectural decision for reliability.

I will apply all four fix objectives: switch certificates to EMAIL validation, remove the entire Lambda/custom-resource infrastructure, clean up distribution `DependsOn`, and delete the now-unused ACM validation placeholder parameters. The template will become far simpler and deployable in a single pass.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP integration (protein variant effect prediction)

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used to derive resource names and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Gateway for MCP-based protein variant effect prediction agent
    Description: Description for the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom name for the gateway. If left blank, a name will be auto-generated based on the project name.

Conditions:
  IsGatewayNameBlank: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda execution
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Placeholder Lambda function
  PlaceholderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "ok"}

  # IAM Role for Bedrock AgentCore service
  BedrockAgentCoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaInvokePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt PlaceholderFunction.Arn

  # SSM Parameter to store the newly created IAM Role ARN
  BedrockAgentCoreRoleArnParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/bedrock-agentcore-role-arn'
      Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # Cognito User Pool for JWT authentication
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-pool'

  # Cognito User Pool Client
  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-client'
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  # API Gateway HTTP API (replaces AgentCoreGateway)
  ApiGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      Name: !If
        - IsGatewayNameBlank
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
        - !Ref GatewayName
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription

  # JWT Authorizer using Cognito
  Authorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - IsGatewayNameBlank
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-authorizer'
        - !Ref GatewayName
      ApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource:
        - '$request.header.Authorization'
      JwtConfiguration:
        Issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CognitoUserPool}'
        Audience:
          - !Ref CognitoUserPoolClient

  # Integration with Lambda (replaces GatewayTarget)
  Integration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt PlaceholderFunction.Arn
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  # Route for invoke_endpoint operation
  RouteInvokeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      RouteKey: POST /invoke_endpoint
      Target: !Sub integrations/${Integration}
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      AuthorizationType: JWT

  # Route for get_results operation
  RouteGetResults:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      RouteKey: GET /get_results
      Target: !Sub integrations/${Integration}
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      AuthorizationType: JWT

  # Lambda permission to allow API Gateway invocation
  LambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PlaceholderFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGateway}/*'

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: HTTP API endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGateway.ApiEndpoint
  AuthorizerId:
    Description: ID of the JWT authorizer
    Value: !Ref Authorizer
  BedrockAgentCoreRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for Bedrock AgentCore
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRole.Arn
  PlaceholderFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the placeholder Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt PlaceholderFunction.Arn

Description: Private VPC infrastructure with ALB, Lambda subnet, and artifact storage

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
  SubnetALB1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for ALB subnet 1
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$
  SubnetALB2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for ALB subnet 2
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$
  SubnetLambdaCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for Lambda subnet
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet (used when NAT Gateway is enabled)
    Default: 10.0.254.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(2[4-9]|3[0-2]))$

    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"

Conditions:
  EnableNatCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, "true"]

Resources:

      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:

  # Private Subnets
  SubnetALB1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetALB1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SubnetALB1
        - Key: SubnetType
          Value: Private

  SubnetALB2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetALB2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SubnetALB2
        - Key: SubnetType
          Value: Private

  SubnetLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetLambdaCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SubnetLambda
        - Key: SubnetType
          Value: Private

  # Private Route Tables and Associations
  PrivateRouteTableALB1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTableALB1

  PrivateRouteTableALB2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTableALB2

  PrivateRouteTableLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTableLambda

  # Routes to NAT Gateway (conditional)
  PrivateRouteALB1ToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableALB1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateRouteALB2ToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableALB2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateRouteLambdaToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableLambda
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # Subnet Route Table Associations
  SubnetALB1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetALB1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableALB1

  SubnetALB2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetALB2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableALB2

  SubnetLambdaRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetLambda
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableLambda

  # NAT Gateway Resources (conditional)
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ApplicationIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !GetAtt SubnetALB1.AvailabilityZone
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet
        - Key: SubnetType
          Value: Public

  ElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ApplicationNATGW

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable

  PublicRouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: EnableNatCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # KMS Key for S3 Artifact Storage
  ArtifactStorageKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting artifact S3 bucket
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAccountIAMUsersRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ArtifactStorageKMSKey

  ArtifactStorageKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/ArtifactStorageKMSKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactStorageKMSKey

  # S3 Artifact Storage Bucket
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ArtifactStorageKMSKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ArtifactBucket

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

  # Application Load Balancer
  ALBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for internal ALB
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ALBSecurityGroup

  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Type: application
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref SubnetALB1
        - !Ref SubnetALB2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ApplicationLoadBalancer

  # Lambda Execution Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaEC2Logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LambdaExecutionRole

  # Lambda Security Group
  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions
      VpcId: !Ref ApplicationVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80

        - IpProtocol: tcp

      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LambdaSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions state machine with two REST APIs (GET and POST) to start executions.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage for both APIs

Resources:
  # Step Functions State Machine
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      Definition:
        Comment: Simple two-step pass workflow
        StartAt: GetRequestPass
        States:
          GetRequestPass:
            Type: Pass
            Next: ProcessPass
          ProcessPass:
            Type: Pass
            End: true
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /

  # GET REST API
  GetApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: GetApi
      Description: API Gateway exposing GET endpoint to start state machine execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GetApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt GetApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: >
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "{{ stateMachineArn }}",
              "input": "$input.json('$')"
            }
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName

  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  # POST REST API
  PostApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: PostApi
      Description: API Gateway exposing POST endpoint to start state machine execution
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  PostApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt PostApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: >
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "{{ stateMachineArn }}",
              "input": "$input.json('$')"
            }
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ""
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName

  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  GetApiEndpoint:
    Description: GET API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub "https://${GetApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  PostApiEndpoint:
    Description: POST API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub "https://${PostApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Audit event processing infrastructure with encrypted SQS, DLQ, alarms, and SNS notifications.'

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - qa
      - prod
      - staging
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment (controls DLQ creation and configuration values).

Mappings:
  EnvConfig:
    dev:
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
    qa:
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 172800
    prod:
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 86400
    staging:
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 172800

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, "dev"]]

Resources:
  AuditKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SQS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "AuditEvents-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 5
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDev
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "AuditEvents-DLQ-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600  # 14 days

  AuditAlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "AuditAlarmsTopic-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditKMSKey

  AuditOldMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "AuditEvents-OldMessages-${Environment}"
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 86400
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

  DLQActivityAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "AuditEvents-DLQActivity-${Environment}"
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueURL:
    Description: URL of the audit events SQS queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueUrl
  DeadLetterQueueURL:
    Condition: IsNonDev
    Description: URL of the dead-letter queue (conditionally created)
    Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueUrl
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for encryption
    Value: !GetAtt AuditKMSKey.Arn
  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for alarm notifications
    Value: !Ref AuditAlarmTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Cognito user pool and related resources for researchapp/AgentCore'

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web application client.

Resources:
  # Primary User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

  # User Pool Domain (required for domain URL)
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub "templategatewaypool-${AWS::AccountId}"

  # Admin group with higher precedence
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Admin group with higher precedence
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Customer group with lower precedence
  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customer group with lower precedence
      Precedence: 5
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Resource Server
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: resource-server
      Name: ResearchApp Resource Server
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access scope

  # Web application client (authorization code flow)
  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - resource-server/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH

  # Machine-to-machine client (client credentials flow)
  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - resource-server/read

  # Lambda role
  AddToCustomerGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cognito-add-user-to-group
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"

  # Lambda function (not wired as trigger)
  AddToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: AddToCustomerGroupFunction
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              username = event.get('username')
              if not username:
                  raise ValueError('username is required')
              client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=os.environ['USER_POOL_ID'],
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName='customer'
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': f'User {username} added to customer group'
              }

  # SSM Parameters under /app/researchapp/agentcore/
  UserPoolIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  WebAppClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client_id/web_app
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Web application client ID

  MachineAppClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client_id/machine_app
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Description: Machine-to-machine client ID

  MachineAppClientSecretParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/client_secret/machine_app
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Machine-to-machine client secret

  OAuthScopeParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: "resource-server/read"
      Description: OAuth scope for read access

  CognitoDomainParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain

  OidcDiscoveryUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oidc_discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Description: OIDC discovery URL

  TokenUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
      Description: Token endpoint URL

  AuthorizeUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
      Description: Authorization endpoint URL

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Resources:

  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table

    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk

      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk

      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # IAM Role for AppSync to access DynamoDB
  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:

  GraphQLSchema:

          price: Float!
          timestamp: String!
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TickerInfoConnection

        schema {
