AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints, optional live-to-VOD and VOD workflows.'

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: myprefix
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.
    Description: Logical name prefix for all resources.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Desired output type for the origin endpoints.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: Manifest name for the endpoints.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 604800
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the endpoints.
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty.
    Description: Bucket name for live-to-VOD archive storage. If provided, endpoint origination is set to DENY.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty.
    Description: Bucket name for VOD source content. If provided, VOD workflows are created.
  Env:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value.

Conditions:
  IsArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  IsVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  HasS3Buckets: !Or [!Condition IsArchiveBucket, !Condition IsVodSourceBucket]
  OutputTypeIsHls: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]]
  OutputTypeIsDash: !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${Prefix} live channel'
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-channel'
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageHlsEndpoint:
    Condition: OutputTypeIsHls
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub '${Prefix} HLS endpoint'
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-hls-endpoint'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If [IsArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        AdMarkers: NONE
        AdsOnDeliveryRestrictions: NONE
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageDashEndpoint:
    Condition: OutputTypeIsDash
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub '${Prefix} DASH endpoint'
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-dash-endpoint'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If [IsArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        AdsOnDeliveryRestrictions: NONE
        PeriodTriggers: []
        Profile: NONE
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  ArchiveBucketResource:
    Condition: IsArchiveBucket
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  VodSourceBucketResource:
    Condition: IsVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - !If
          - HasS3Buckets
          - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Access
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - !If
                  - IsArchiveBucket
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - s3:GetObject
                      - s3:PutObject
                      - s3:ListBucket
                    Resource:
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
                - !If
                  - IsVodSourceBucket
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - s3:GetObject
                      - s3:PutObject
                      - s3:ListBucket
                    Resource:
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                      - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Condition: IsVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-vod-packaging-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

  VodAsset:
    Condition: IsVodSourceBucket
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Asset
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${Prefix}-vod-asset'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
      SourceRoleArn: !GetAtt MediaPackageRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Env
          Value: !Ref Env

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'ECS Fargate service with public ALB and private subnets'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the ECS service
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: Container image (e.g., nginx, httpd)
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port exposed by the container
  Cpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: CPU units for Fargate task (e.g., 256, 512)
  Memory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory in MB for Fargate task (e.g., 512, 1024)
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Desired number of tasks running
  ListenerRulePriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    Description: Priority for the listener rule (unique for this listener)
  ListenerRulePathPattern:
    Type: String
    Default: '/api/*'
    Description: Path pattern for the listener rule (e.g., /api/*)
  TaskRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom name for the ECS task IAM role. If left empty, a name will be generated.

Conditions:
  IsCustomTaskRoleName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleName, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt"

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"

  ContainerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 7
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  ECSExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !If [IsCustomTaskRoleName, !Ref TaskRoleName, !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role"]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerLogGroup.Arn

  ALBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the Application Load Balancer
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-alb-sg"

  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-alb"
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      Type: application
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-alb"

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tg"
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort
      Protocol: HTTP
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tg"

  ALBListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            StatusCode: HTTP_302
            Protocol: HTTP
            Port: 80
            Host: "#{host}"
            Path: "/api/404"
            Query: "#{query}"

  ListenerRule:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
    Properties:
      ListenerArn: !Ref ALBListener
      Priority: !Ref ListenerRulePriority
      Conditions:
        - Field: path-pattern
          Values:
            - !Ref ListenerRulePathPattern
      Actions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  ECSTasksSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS Fargate tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt ALBSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ecs-tasks-sg"

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSExecutionRole.Arn
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Sub "${ServiceName}-container"
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ContainerLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ECSTasksSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
          ContainerName: !Sub "${ServiceName}-container"
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort

Outputs:
  LoadBalancerDNS:
    Description: DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS Cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create a DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, point-in-time recovery, optional customer-managed KMS encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms for throttling and system errors publishing to an SNS topic."

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyTable"
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table."

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "id"
    Description: "Name of the partition key."

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: "Data type of the partition key (S=String, N=Number, B=Binary)."

  EnableSortKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to include a sort key."

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "sk"
    Description: "Name of the sort key (used only if EnableSortKey is true)."

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: "Data type of the sort key (used only if EnableSortKey is true)."

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: "PROVISIONED"
    AllowedValues: ["PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
    Description: "Billing mode for the table."

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: "Provisioned read capacity units (used only if BillingMode is PROVISIONED)."

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: "Provisioned write capacity units (used only if BillingMode is PROVISIONED)."

  EnablePITR:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable point-in-time recovery for the table."

  EnableSSE:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable server-side encryption using a customer-managed KMS key."

  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttled requests and system errors, publishing to a new SNS topic."

Conditions:
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  HasSortKey: !Equals [!Ref EnableSortKey, "true"]
  EnablePITRCond: !Equals [!Ref EnablePITR, "true"]
  EnableSSECond: !Equals [!Ref EnableSSE, "true"]
  EnableAlarmsCond: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, "true"]

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: !If [IsProvisioned, "PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - EnablePITRCond
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSECond
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: "KMS"
          KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  KmsKey:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Key"
    Condition: EnableSSECond
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB table ${TableName}"
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow DynamoDB to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"

  SnsTopic:
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Topic"
    Condition: EnableAlarmsCond
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub "DynamoDB-${TableName}-Alarms"
      TopicName: !Sub "DynamoDB-${TableName}-Alarms"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Sub "arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/sns"

  AlarmThrottledRequests:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: EnableAlarmsCond
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-ThrottledRequests"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when DynamoDB table experiences throttled requests."
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      MetricName: "ThrottledRequests"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopic

  AlarmSystemErrors:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: EnableAlarmsCond
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-SystemErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when DynamoDB table experiences system errors."
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      MetricName: "SystemErrors"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopic

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table."
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

  TableArn:
    Description: "ARN of the DynamoDB table."
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the customer-managed KMS key (if created)."
    Value: !If [EnableSSECond, !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn, ""]

  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic for alarms (if created)."
    Value: !If [EnableAlarmsCond, !Ref SnsTopic, ""]

        - Key: Name

    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Properties:

  PublicSubnet:

    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet"

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet"

      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sg"

  # IAM Role and Instance Profile
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderLogsAndS3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LoggingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-role"

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderRole

  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  ImageBuilderKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable root account administration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT

  # S3 Bucket for logs
  LoggingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref ImageBuilderKmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-logs"

  LoggingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LoggingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${LoggingBucket.Arn}/*"

  # Components
  SoftwareInstallComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-software-install"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, configures SSM sudo.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstall
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, enable SSM sudo
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf install -y docker
              - name: StartDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo systemctl enable docker
                    - sudo systemctl start docker
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo curl -L "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - pip3 install --upgrade pip
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSSMSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      if ! grep -q "^ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users; then
                        echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                        sudo chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                      fi
              - name: Cleanup
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo dnf clean all

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-test"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Validates Docker Compose and Python imports.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Data: |
        name: Test
        description: Test Docker Compose and Python packages
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker-compose --version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All imports successful')"

  # Image Recipes
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-x86-recipe"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageParamX86
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-arm64-recipe"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageParamArm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareInstallComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref TestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Infrastructure Configuration (uses private subnet)
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-infra-config"
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LoggingBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: logs/
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Distribution Configuration
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dist-config"
      Description: Distribution configuration with public and organization sharing
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref DistributionRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "{{ imagebuilder:outputImageName }}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub "arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}"
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Image Pipelines (one per architecture)
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-x86-pipeline"
      Description: Pipeline to build Amazon Linux 2023 x86 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-arm64-pipeline"
      Description: Pipeline to build Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref Arm64ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  X86ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref X86ImagePipeline
  Arm64ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref Arm64ImagePipeline
  LoggingBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket used for build logs
    Value: !Ref LoggingBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo Cognito resources"

Resources:
  # ---------- Cognito User Pool ----------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
      Schema:
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "64"
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Your AgentOps demo verification code"
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Your verification code is {####}"

  # ---------- App Client ----------
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------- User Pool Groups ----------
  GroupTeamAlpha:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  GroupTeamBeta:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  GroupAdmin:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------- Demo Password Secret ----------
  DemoPasswordSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: agentops-demo-password
      Description: "Shared demo password for seeding users"
      GenerateSecretString:
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
        ExcludeUppercase: false
        ExcludeLowercase: false
        ExcludeNumbers: false
        IncludeSpace: false
        RequireEachIncludedType: true

  # ---------- Lambda Execution Role ----------
  SeederFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SeederFunctionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"

  # ---------- Custom Resource Lambda ----------
  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-user-seeder
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SeederFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
                  user_pool_id = props['UserPoolId']
                  secret_arn = props['SecretArn']
                  users = json.loads(props['Users'])

                  # Get the demo password
                  secrets_client = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                  response = secrets_client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                  password = response['SecretString']

                  cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

                  for user in users:
                      email = user['email']
                      group_name = user['group']
                      role = user['role']

                      # Check if user exists
                      try:
                          cognito.admin_get_user(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email
                          )
                          # User exists – update attributes and password anyway? Assume update scenario.
                      except cognito.exceptions.UserNotFoundException:
                          pass

                      # Create user (or ignore if exists)
                      try:
                          cognito.admin_create_user(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              UserAttributes=[
                                  {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                                  {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                                  {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                              ],
                              MessageAction='SUPPRESS'
                          )
                      except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                          pass

                      # Set permanent password
                      cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          Password=password,
                          Permanent=True
                      )

                      # Update custom:role
                      cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=email,
                          UserAttributes=[
                              {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role}
                          ]
                      )

                      # Add to group
                      try:
                          cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              GroupName=group_name
                          )
                      except Exception as e:
                          # if group does not exist, ignore
                          pass

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Status': 'Users seeded'})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  # ---------- Custom Resource Invocation ----------
  UserSeeder:
    Type: Custom::UserSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - GroupTeamAlpha
      - GroupTeamBeta
      - GroupAdmin
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SecretArn: !Ref DemoPasswordSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to create CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and a dashboard
  for AWS Client VPN usage reporting covering AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, and Mixed Auth.

Parameters:
  FolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+$"
    Description: >
      Folder path to organize queries in the CloudWatch Logs Insights console.
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/aws/client-vpn/prod"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9/_.-]+$"
    Description: >
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for Client VPN logs.
      Must not start with 'aws/' or 'AWS/' as those prefixes are reserved.
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: ClientVPNUsageDashboard
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
    Description: >
      Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard to create.

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  ClientVpnLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 365
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  TotalUsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/TotalUsagePerEndpoint"
      QueryString: >
        fields @timestamp, destination-ip, ingress-bytes, egress-bytes
        | stats count(*) as connections, sum(ingress-bytes) as total_ingress,
                sum(egress-bytes) as total_egress by destination-ip
        | sort total_ingress desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  UsagePerAuthTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/UsagePerAuthType"
      QueryString: >
        fields @timestamp, authentication-method
        | stats count(*) as connections by authentication-method
        | sort connections desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/DistinctUsers"
      QueryString: >
        fields @timestamp, client-common-name
        | stats count(*) as connections by client-common-name
        | sort connections desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${FolderPath}/ConnectionDurations"
      QueryString: >
        fields @timestamp, connection-duration
        | stats avg(connection-duration) as avg_duration,
                max(connection-duration) as max_duration,
                min(connection-duration) as min_duration,
                count(*) as total_connections
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName

  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "start": "-PT24H",
          "periodOverride": "auto",
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, destination-ip, ingress-bytes, egress-bytes | stats count(*) as connections, sum(ingress-bytes) as total_ingress, sum(egress-bytes) as total_egress by destination-ip | sort total_ingress desc",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Usage per Authentication Type",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, authentication-method | stats count(*) as connections by authentication-method | sort connections desc",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Distinct Users",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, client-common-name | stats count(*) as connections by client-common-name | sort connections desc",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Connection Durations",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, connection-duration | stats avg(connection-duration) as avg_duration, max(connection-duration) as max_duration, min(connection-duration) as min_duration, count(*) as total_connections",
                "view": "table"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

    Value: !Ref ClientVpnLogGroup

    Description: "The name of the CloudWatch Dashboard created."
    Value: !Ref DashboardName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Hospitality Insights prod Cognito infrastructure with post-auth Lambda and groups'

Parameters:
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the SAML provider for SSO (leave empty to disable)
  LoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Metadata URL for the SAML identity provider (required if SSOProviderName is set)
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito custom domain (leave empty to disable)

Conditions:
  CreateIdP: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]
  CreateDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, '']]

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Lambda (now without Cognito inline policy to avoid circular dependency)
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: 'arn:aws:logs:*:*:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  # IAM Policy for Cognito update – attached separately to avoid circular dependency
  LambdaCognitoPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LambdaCognitoUpdateAttributes
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool}'

  # Lambda Function for post-authentication
  PostAuthUpdateLastLogin:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: HospitalityInsights-prod-post-auth
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {
                          'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                          'Value': timestamp
                      }
                  ]
              )
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod

  # Permission for Cognito to invoke Lambda
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthUpdateLastLogin
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool.Arn

  # Cognito User Pool (corrected property name for tags)
  HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: HospitalityInsights-prod-user-pool
      AliasAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthUpdateLastLogin.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: HospitalityInsights
        Environment: prod

  # User Pool Client (explicit token units in seconds to fix validity range error)
  HospitalityInsightsProdClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: HospitalityInsights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 86400
      GenerateSecret: true
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: seconds

  # User Groups
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool

  # SAML Identity Provider (conditional)
  CognitoIdP:
    Condition: CreateIdP
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      UserPoolId: !Ref HospitalityInsightsProdUserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for managing client connections and session state

Parameters:
  TTLDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: '3600'
    Description: Time-to-live in seconds for session entries in DynamoDB
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebSocketSessionApi
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true

  ConnectHandlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConnectHandlerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"

  ConnectHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ConnectHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ConnectHandlerRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timedelta

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)
          ttl_duration = int(os.environ.get('TTL_DURATION', '3600'))

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              ttl = int((datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=ttl_duration)).timestamp())
              try:
                  table.put_item(
                      Item={
                          'connectionId': connection_id,
                          'ttl': ttl,
                          'connectedAt': datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
                      }
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': f'Failed to store connection: {str(e)}'}
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
          TTL_DURATION: !Ref TTLDuration

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt ConnectHandler.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${ConnectIntegration}"

  ConnectLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectHandler
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api}/*/$connect"

  DefaultHandlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DefaultHandlerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api}/*/*/connections/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"

  DefaultHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DefaultHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt DefaultHandlerRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              domain_name = event['requestContext']['domainName']
              stage = event['requestContext']['stage']
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              body = event.get('body', '{}')

              client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=f'https://{domain_name}/{stage}')
              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(ConnectionId=connection_id, Data=body)
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'GoneException':
                      return {'statusCode': 410, 'body': 'Connection gone'}
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': f'Failed to send message: {str(e)}'}
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Message sent'}

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt DefaultHandler.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${DefaultIntegration}"

  DefaultLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultHandler
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api}/*/$default"

  DisconnectHandlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DisconnectHandlerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"

  DisconnectHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DisconnectHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt DisconnectHandlerRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              try:
                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': f'Failed to delete connection: {str(e)}'}
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt DisconnectHandler.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PayloadFormatVersion: '1.0'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}"

  DisconnectLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectHandler
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api}/*/$disconnect"

  Api:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: api
      AutoDeploy: true
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      Description: Default stage for WebSocket API

Outputs:
  WebSocketURL:
    Description: WebSocket API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub "wss://${Api}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: "Self-contained ECS Fargate application BestFriends with public ALB, VPC, and CloudWatch Logs."

Metadata:
  cfn-lint:
    config:
      ignore_checks:
        - E8004

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsPublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsPublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsPrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsPrivateSubnet2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsPublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsNATGatewayEIP
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsNATGateway

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsPrivateRouteTable

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Security group for the public ALB
  ALBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the BestFriends ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsALBSG

  # Allow inbound HTTP traffic from the internet on port 80
  ALBSecurityGroupIngressHTTP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 80
      ToPort: 80
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  # Allow inbound HTTPS traffic from the internet on port 443
  ALBSecurityGroupIngressHTTPS:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  # Allow ALB to forward traffic to the app security group on port 8000
  ALBSecurityGroupEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 8000
      ToPort: 8000
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroup

  # Security group for the ECS tasks
  AppSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the BestFriends ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsAppSG

  # Allow inbound traffic only from the ALB security group on port 8000
  AppSecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 8000
      ToPort: 8000
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ALBSecurityGroup

  # Egress rules for the app security group (restricted to VPC CIDR and NAT EIP)
  AppSecurityGroupEgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: -1
      CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  AppSecurityGroupEgressNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 80
      ToPort: 80
      CidrIp: !Join ['', [!GetAtt ElasticIP.PublicIp, '/32']]

  AppSecurityGroupEgressNat443:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Join ['', [!GetAtt ElasticIP.PublicIp, '/32']]

  # Self-signed ACM certificate for the HTTPS listener
  Cert:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Properties:
      DomainName: bestfriends.alb.internal
      ValidationMethod: DNS

  # Internet-facing Application Load Balancer (intentionally public per application requirements)
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: BestFriendsALB
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsALB

  # Target group for the ECS tasks
  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: BestFriendsTG
      Port: 8000
      Protocol: HTTP
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsTG

  # HTTP listener on port 80 redirecting to HTTPS
  ListenerHttp:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            Protocol: HTTPS
            Port: 443
            Host: '#{host}'
            Path: '/#{path}'
            Query: '#{query}'
            StatusCode: HTTP_301
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP

  # HTTPS listener on port 443 forwarding traffic to the target group
  ListenerHttps:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 443
      Protocol: HTTPS
      Certificates:
        - CertificateArn: !Ref Cert

  # CloudWatch Logs log group for container logs
  CloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /ecs/bestfriends
      RetentionInDays: 7
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  # ECS Cluster
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: BestFriendsCluster
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: BestFriendsCluster

  # IAM role for ECS task execution
  ECSExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

Description: "Basic VPC with public subnet for testing purposes. NACL allows all TCP traffic (ports 0-65535); UDP/ICMP are blocked. Public IPs are not auto-assigned for compliance."

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: "Select the VPC CIDR block from the allowed ranges"
    AllowedValues:
      - "172.18.0.0/16"
      - "172.19.0.0/16"
      - "172.20.0.0/16"
      - "172.21.0.0/16"
      - "172.22.0.0/16"
      - "172.23.0.0/16"
    Default: "172.18.0.0/16"

Resources:
  # VPC
  TestVPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "TestVPC"

  # Internet Gateway
  TestIGW:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "TestIGW"

  # Attach Internet Gateway to VPC
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref TestIGW

  # Public Subnet - derive first /22 from the VPC CIDR
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: !Join 
        - ""
        - - !Select [0, !Split [".", !Ref VpcCidr]]
          - "."
          - !Select [1, !Split [".", !Ref VpcCidr]]
          - ".0.0/22"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicSubnet"

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicRouteTable"

  # Default route to Internet Gateway
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref TestIGW

  # Associate route table with subnet
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Network ACL
  PublicNACL:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "PublicNACL"

  # NACL inbound rule - allow all TCP traffic (ports 0-65535)
  NaclInbound:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry"
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNACL
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      RuleAction: "allow"
      Egress: false

  # NACL outbound rule - allow all TCP traffic (ports 0-65535)
  NaclOutbound:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry"
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNACL
      RuleNumber: 200
      Protocol: 6
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
      CidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      RuleAction: "allow"
      Egress: true

  # Associate NACL with subnet
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNACL

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref TestVPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: "Public Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: "Internet Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref TestIGW
  RouteTableId:
    Description: "Public Route Table ID"
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NetworkAclId:
    Description: "Public NACL ID"
    Value: !Ref PublicNACL
