AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom component, workflow, and lifecycle policy.'

Resources:
  # Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderSubnet

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ImageBuilderRouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder instances
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  # IAM Roles
  ImageBuilderBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ImageBuilderBuildRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderBuildRole

  ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  # Image Builder Resources
  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - action: WebDownload
                name: DownloadChef
                inputs:
                  - source: https://packages.chef.io/files/stable/chef/18.4.12/el/8/chef-18.4.12-1.el8.x86_64.rpm
                    destination: /tmp/chef.rpm
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallChef
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo rpm -Uvh /tmp/chef.rpm
          - name: test
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: VerifyChef
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chef-client --version

  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Data: |
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        name: sample-workflow
        steps:
          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: $.configuration.instanceId
              documentName: AWS-UpdateSSMAgent
              parameters:
                version: ["latest"]
          - name: Reboot
            action: RunCommand
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: $.configuration.instanceId
              documentName: AWS-RunShellScript
              parameters:
                commands:
                  - sudo shutdown -r now
          - name: BuildImage
            action: CreateImage
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: $.configuration.instanceId

  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Sub "arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x"
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SampleComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Sub "arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/1.0.0"

  SampleInfraConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infra-config
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  SampleDistributionConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-config
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "sample-image-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            AmiTags:
              Environment: Dev
              Name: sample-image

  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref SampleRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleInfraConfig
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleDistributionConfig
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 9 ? * * *)"
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !Ref SampleWorkflow

  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Lifecycle policy to deprecate AMIs older than 6 months for Dev environment
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Pipeline
    Value: !Ref SampleImagePipeline

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Route53 public hosted zone and DNS records for passengerlist.org including A/AAAA alias to CloudFront, TXT for SPF/site verification, MX for G Suite, DMARC, external service CNAMEs, and ACM validation CNAMEs.'

Mappings:
  CloudFrontAliasZone:
    CloudFront:
      HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

Parameters:
  RootCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: "d123.cloudfront.net"
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for the root domain (passengerlist.org)
  WwwCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: "d123.cloudfront.net"
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for www.passengerlist.org
  DeparturesCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: "d123.cloudfront.net"
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for departures.passengerlist.org
  JoinCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: "d123.cloudfront.net"
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for join.passengerlist.org
  AthenaCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: "d123.cloudfront.net"
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for athena.passengerlist.org
  FeedCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: "d123.cloudfront.net"
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for feed.passengerlist.org

  SpfTxtValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "\"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all\""
    Description: SPF TXT record value for passengerlist.org (e.g., "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all")
  SiteVerificationTxtValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "\"REPLACE_ME\""
    Description: Site verification TXT record value for passengerlist.org (e.g., "google-site-verification=...")
  DmarcRecordValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "\"v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@passengerlist.org\""
    Description: DMARC TXT record value for _dmarc.passengerlist.org (e.g., "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@passengerlist.org")
  MxRecordValues:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM"
    Description: List of MX records for passengerlist.org, each as "priority mailserver" (e.g., "1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM,10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM")

  RootCertValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM certificate validation of passengerlist.org (e.g., _xyz.passengerlist.org)
  RootCertValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM certificate validation of passengerlist.org
  WwwCertValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM certificate validation of www.passengerlist.org
  WwwCertValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM certificate validation of www.passengerlist.org
  DeparturesCertValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM certificate validation of departures.passengerlist.org
  DeparturesCertValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM certificate validation of departures.passengerlist.org
  JoinCertValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM certificate validation of join.passengerlist.org
  JoinCertValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM certificate validation of join.passengerlist.org
  AthenaCertValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM certificate validation of athena.passengerlist.org
  AthenaCertValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM certificate validation of athena.passengerlist.org
  FeedCertValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for ACM certificate validation of feed.passengerlist.org
  FeedCertValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record value for ACM certificate validation of feed.passengerlist.org

  ZendeskCnameName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for Zendesk mail routing (e.g., zendesk1._domainkey.passengerlist.org)
  ZendeskCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record target for Zendesk mail routing
  DkimCnameName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for DKIM verification (e.g., google._domainkey.passengerlist.org)
  DkimCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record target for DKIM verification
  SquarespaceCnameName:
    Type: String
    Default: "_placeholder.passengerlist.org."
    Description: CNAME record name for Squarespace domain verification (e.g., ext-sq-xxxxxx.passengerlist.org)
  SquarespaceCnameValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "placeholder.example.com"
    Description: CNAME record target for Squarespace domain verification

Resources:
  PassengerListHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: passengerlist.org
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for passengerlist.org

  # Root domain records
  RootA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: passengerlist.org.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref RootCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  RootAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: passengerlist.org.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref RootCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  RootSPF:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: passengerlist.org.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SpfTxtValue

  RootSiteVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: passengerlist.org.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SiteVerificationTxtValue

  RootMX:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: passengerlist.org.
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords: !Ref MxRecordValues

  DmarcTXT:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: _dmarc.passengerlist.org.
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DmarcRecordValue

  RootACMValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref RootCertValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref RootCertValidationValue

  # www subdomain
  WwwA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: www.passengerlist.org.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref WwwCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  WwwAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: www.passengerlist.org.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref WwwCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  WwwACMValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref WwwCertValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WwwCertValidationValue

  # departures subdomain
  DeparturesA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: departures.passengerlist.org.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref DeparturesCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  DeparturesAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: departures.passengerlist.org.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref DeparturesCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  DeparturesACMValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DeparturesCertValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DeparturesCertValidationValue

  # join subdomain
  JoinA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: join.passengerlist.org.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref JoinCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  JoinAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: join.passengerlist.org.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref JoinCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  JoinACMValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref JoinCertValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref JoinCertValidationValue

  # athena subdomain
  AthenaA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: athena.passengerlist.org.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref AthenaCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  AthenaAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: athena.passengerlist.org.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref AthenaCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  AthenaACMValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref AthenaCertValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AthenaCertValidationValue

  # feed subdomain
  FeedA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: feed.passengerlist.org.
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeedCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  FeedAAAA:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: feed.passengerlist.org.
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref FeedCloudFrontDomain
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [CloudFrontAliasZone, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]

  FeedACMValidation:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref FeedCertValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref FeedCertValidationValue

  # External CNAME records
  ZendeskCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref ZendeskCnameName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskCnameValue

  DkimCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DkimCnameName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DkimCnameValue

  SquarespaceCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PassengerListHostedZone
      Name: !Ref SquarespaceCnameName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceCnameValue

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Complete authentication infrastructure for customer support system

Parameters:
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport
    Description: Unique prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain (must be globally unique)
  WebAppCallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/callback
    Description: Callback URL for the web application client
  WebAppLogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/logout
    Description: Logout URL for the web application client
  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: customersupport
    Description: Identifier for the resource server
  ResourceServerScopeName:
    Type: String
    Default: read
    Description: Name of the custom OAuth scope

Resources:
  # Cognito User Pool (includes LambdaConfig trigger)
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-customer-support-pool"
      UsernameAttributes: ["email"]
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: ["email"]
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupFunction.Arn

  # User Groups
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # Resource Server
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Ref ResourceServerIdentifier
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-resource-server"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: !Ref ResourceServerScopeName
          ScopeDescription: Read access to customer data

  # Web Application Client (authorization code grant)
  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-app-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows: ["code"]
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ResourceServerScopeName}"
        - "openid"
        - "email"
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref WebAppCallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref WebAppLogoutURL
      SupportedIdentityProviders: ["COGNITO"]
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # Machine-to-Machine Client (client credentials grant)
  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows: ["client_credentials"]
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ResourceServerScopeName}"
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH

  # Cognito Domain for Hosted UI
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # IAM Role for Lambda
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-add-user-to-group-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-cognito-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda Function to add new users to customer group
  AddToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-add-user-to-customer-group"
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get('userPoolId')
              username = event.get('userName')
              if not user_pool_id or not username:
                  logger.error("Missing userPoolId or userName in event")
                  return event
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName='customer'
                  )
                  logger.info(f"Added {username} to customer group")
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(f"Failed to add user to group: {str(e)}")
              return event

  # Permission for Cognito to invoke Lambda
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # Secrets Manager for M2M Client Secret
  M2MClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m-client-secret"
      Description: M2M client secret for customer support system
      SecretString: !GetAtt M2MClient.ClientSecret

  # SSM Parameters
  SSMClientIdWeb:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/client-id-web
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient

  SSMClientIdM2M:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/client-id-m2m
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  SSMOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth-scope
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "${ResourceServerIdentifier}/${ResourceServerScopeName}"

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"

  SSMTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/token-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"

  SSMAuthorizeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/authorize-endpoint
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"

  SSMDomain:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/customersupport/agentcore/domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  WebClientId:
    Description: Web Application Client ID
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  M2MClientId:
    Description: M2M Client ID
    Value: !Ref M2MClient
  M2MClientSecretArn:
    Description: Secrets Manager ARN for M2M client secret
    Value: !Ref M2MClientSecret
  CognitoDomain:
    Description: Cognito Hosted UI Domain
    Value: !Sub "${CognitoDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  SSMBasePath:
    Description: Base SSM path for parameters
    Value: /app/customersupport/agentcore/

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM roles for SageMaker project templates'

Parameters:
  CreateExecutionRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateLaunchRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'NO'
  CreateUseRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'NO'
  CreateCloudFormationServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateCodeBuildServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateCodePipelineServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateEventsServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateAPIGatewayServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateFirehoseServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateGlueServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'
  CreateLambdaServiceRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['YES', 'NO']
    Default: 'YES'

Conditions:
  IsCreateExecutionRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateExecutionRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateLaunchRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateLaunchRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateUseRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateUseRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateCloudFormationServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateCloudFormationServiceRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateCodeBuildServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateCodeBuildServiceRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateCodePipelineServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateCodePipelineServiceRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateEventsServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateEventsServiceRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateAPIGatewayServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateAPIGatewayServiceRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateFirehoseServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateFirehoseServiceRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateGlueServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateGlueServiceRole, 'YES']
  IsCreateLambdaServiceRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateLambdaServiceRole, 'YES']

Resources:
  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole:
    Condition: IsCreateExecutionRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole:
    Condition: IsCreateLaunchRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerAdmin-ServiceCatalogProductsServiceRolePolicy

  AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole:
    Condition: IsCreateUseRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UseRoleInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - codebuild:*
                  - codecommit:*
                  - codepipeline:*
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ecr:*
                  - events:*
                  - firehose:*
                  - glue:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - states:*
                  - codestar-connections:*
                  - kms:*
                  - ssm:*
                Resource: '*'

  CloudFormationServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateCloudFormationServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CloudFormationServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationFullAccess

  CodeBuildServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateCodeBuildServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodeBuildServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCodeBuildAdminAccess

  CodePipelineServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateCodePipelineServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodePipelineServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineServiceRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:StopBuild
                  - codecommit:GetBranch
                  - codecommit:GetCommit
                  - codecommit:UploadArchive
                  - codedeploy:CreateDeployment
                  - codedeploy:GetDeployment
                  - ecs:RunTask
                  - ecs:DescribeTasks
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: '*'

  EventsServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateEventsServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: EventsServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEventBridgeFullAccess

  APIGatewayServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateAPIGatewayServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: APIGatewayServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonAPIGatewayAdministrator

  FirehoseServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateFirehoseServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: FirehoseServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonKinesisFirehoseFullAccess

  GlueServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateGlueServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: GlueServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole

  LambdaServiceRole:
    Condition: IsCreateLambdaServiceRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: LambdaServiceRole
      Path: /service-role/
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSLambdaExecute

Outputs:
  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateExecutionRole
    Value: !GetAtt AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker execution role
  LaunchRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateLaunchRole
    Value: !GetAtt AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker launch role
  UseRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateUseRole
    Value: !GetAtt AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker use role
  CloudFormationServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateCloudFormationServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationServiceRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the CloudFormation service role
  CodeBuildServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateCodeBuildServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildServiceRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild service role
  CodePipelineServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateCodePipelineServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt CodePipelineServiceRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the CodePipeline service role
  EventsServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateEventsServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt EventsServiceRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the Events service role
  APIGatewayServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateAPIGatewayServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewayServiceRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway service role
  FirehoseServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateFirehoseServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt FirehoseServiceRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the Firehose service role
  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateGlueServiceRole
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Description: ARN of the Glue service role
  LambdaServiceRoleArn:
    Condition: IsCreateLambdaServiceRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets, NAT Gateways, and route tables."

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.10.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # Public Subnets (MapPublicIpOnLaunch removed to comply with AWS-0164)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2"

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.10.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2"

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGW1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGW2"

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT1"

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT2"

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidr:
    Description: "CIDR block of the VPC"
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of Availability Zones used"
    Value: !Join [",", [!GetAtt PublicSubnet1.AvailabilityZone, !GetAtt PublicSubnet2.AvailabilityZone]]

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

Description: "Route53 Hosted Zone for prxu.org with Google Workspace, CDN, ACM, and DNS records"

    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Target CNAME for production feed proxy"
  FeedProxyStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Target CNAME for staging feed proxy"
  RouterProdTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Target CNAME for production router"
  RouterStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Target CNAME for staging router"

  HasFeedProxyStaging: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FeedProxyStagingTarget, ""]]
  HasRouterProd: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouterProdTarget, ""]]
  HasRouterStaging: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouterStagingTarget, ""]]
  HasCertificate: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CertificateArn, ""]]

    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:

    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet

      Type: TXT
      TTL: "300"
      ResourceRecords:

        - "10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM."

            Resource: "*"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Simple VPC setup for learning purposes with conditional resources."

Parameters:
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Boolean flag to create an Internet Gateway."

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Boolean flag to create a public subnet."

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Boolean flag to create a route table (only relevant if both Internet Gateway and public subnet exist)."

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Boolean flag to create a security group."

  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "SimpleApp1"
    Description: "Prefix used for naming resources via tags."

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC."

  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the public subnet."

  SourceIPRange:
    Type: String
    Default: "0.0.0.0/0"
    Description: "Source IP range allowed for HTTP/HTTPS traffic in the security group."

Conditions:
  CreateInternetGatewayCond: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, "true"]
  CreatePublicSubnetCond: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, "true"]
  CreateRouteTableCond: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, "true"]
  CreateSecurityGroupCond: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, "true"]
  CreateRouteAndInternetGatewayCond: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, "true"]
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, "true"]
  CreateRouteTableAndSubnetCond: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, "true"]
    - !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, "true"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateInternetGatewayCond
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateInternetGatewayCond
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreatePublicSubnetCond
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-public-subnet"

  RouteTable:
    Condition: CreateRouteTableCond
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-route-table"

  Route:
    Condition: CreateRouteAndInternetGatewayCond
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn:
      - VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateRouteTableAndSubnetCond
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Condition: CreateSecurityGroupCond
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for learning demo"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Prefix}-security-group"

Outputs:
  VpcId:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Landing Zone Hub VPC with Transit Gateway and VPC Endpoints
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Prefix used for resource naming
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2
  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Private ASN for the Transit Gateway
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: DefaultProject
    Description: Project tag value
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  PublicRouteDefault:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn:
      - VPCGatewayAttachment
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  PrivateRouteToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-tgw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogFormat: "${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}"
  VPCEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VPCEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VPCEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ec2messages-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VPCEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ssmmessages-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VPCEndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-s3-gateway-endpoint
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Student Services Agent Infrastructure with Cognito and IAM roles'

Resources:
  # ---------- Shared base IAM managed policy ----------
  BaseManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: student-services-base-policy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  # ---------- StudentServicesAgent (orchestrator) ----------
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy

  # ---------- StudentServicesGateway (Cognito only, no execution role) ----------
  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Log Monitoring Controls'

Resources:
  # 1. KMS Key
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  # 1b. KMS Key Alias
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/CloudTrailKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 2. SNS Topic (encrypted with KMS key)
  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # 3. S3 Bucket for CloudTrail logs
  CloudTrailS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KMSKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  CloudTrailS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailAcl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}'
          - Sid: AllowSSLRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}'
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  # 4. IAM Role for CloudTrail to write to CloudWatch Logs
  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams

Resources:
  # Route53 Hosted Zone
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub "Hosted zone for ${DomainName}"

  # ACM Certificates for apex and subdomains
  ApexCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      SubjectAlternativeNames:
        - !Sub "*.${DomainName}"
        - !Sub "prod.${DomainName}"
        - !Sub "stag.${DomainName}"
      ValidationMethod: DNS
      DomainValidationOptions:
        - DomainName: !Ref DomainName
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
        - DomainName: !Sub "*.${DomainName}"
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
        - DomainName: !Sub "prod.${DomainName}"
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
        - DomainName: !Sub "stag.${DomainName}"
          HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  # TXT Records
  SpfRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SpfRecordValue

  DmarcRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_dmarc.${DomainName}"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DmarcRecordValue

  DomainVerificationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_domainverification.${DomainName}"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DomainVerificationValue

  # MX Records
  MxOffice365:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub "${Office365MxPriority} ${Office365MxExchange}"

  MxGoogleWorkspace:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub "${GoogleWorkspaceMxPriority} ${GoogleWorkspaceMxExchange}"
        - !Sub "${GoogleWorkspaceMxPriority2} ${GoogleWorkspaceMxExchange2}"

  # CNAME Records for Mail Services
  ZenDeskCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "zendesk.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZenDeskCnameValue

  CampaignMonitorCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "campaignmonitor.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref CampaignMonitorCnameValue

  MailCname1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${MailCnameRecordName1}.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref MailCnameRecordTarget1

  MailCname2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "${MailCnameRecordName2}.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref MailCnameRecordTarget2

  # DKIM CNAME Records
  DkimSelector1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "selector1._domainkey.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DkimSelector1Target

  DkimSelector2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "selector2._domainkey.${DomainName}"
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DkimSelector2Target

  # Alias Records for CloudFront (A and AAAA) – conditional
  ApexAliasCloudFrontA:
    Condition: HasCloudFrontDistribution
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionHostedZoneId
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

  ApexAliasCloudFrontAAAA:
    Condition: HasCloudFrontDistribution
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionHostedZoneId
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

  ProdAliasCloudFrontA:
    Condition: HasCloudFrontDistribution
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "prod.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionHostedZoneId
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

  ProdAliasCloudFrontAAAA:
    Condition: HasCloudFrontDistribution
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "prod.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionHostedZoneId
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

  StagAliasCloudFrontA:

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "stag.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionHostedZoneId
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

  StagAliasCloudFrontAAAA:

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "stag.${DomainName}"
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionHostedZoneId
        DNSName: !Ref CloudFrontDistributionDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

      Type: A

        DNSName: !Ref FrontendServiceALBDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "frontend.stag.${DomainName}"
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: !Ref FrontendServiceALBHostedZoneId
        DNSName: !Ref FrontendServiceALBDNSName
        EvaluateTargetHealth: true

  # WordPress Backend
