AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CDK Bootstrap Stack – Self-contained environment for CDK deployments'

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Short string to uniquely identify components (max 10 chars)'
    Default: hn
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,10}'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be 1-10 characters: letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores'

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of trusted AWS account IDs for cross-account publishing/deployment'
    Default: ''

  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Custom asset bucket name (globally unique). If empty, a name is generated.'
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be a valid S3 bucket name or empty'

  KeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Custom KMS key alias (e.g., alias/my-key). If empty, alias is derived from Qualifier.'
    Default: ''

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Version string stored in SSM parameter for bootstrap version tracking'
    Default: '1'

  FilePublishingManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the file publishing role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  ImagePublishingManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the image publishing role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  AccountLookupManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the account lookup role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'

  DeploymentManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the deploy action role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/PowerUserAccess'

  CloudFormationExecutionManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: 'List of managed policy ARNs to attach to the CloudFormation execution role'
    Default: 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

Conditions:
  HasBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BucketName, '']]
  HasCustomAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KeyAlias, '']]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts], '']]

Resources:
  # KMS Key for S3 bucket encryption
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Description: !Sub 'CDK bootstrap file asset encryption key for qualifier ${Qualifier}'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow encryption and decryption for asset publishing
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If [HasCustomAlias, !Ref KeyAlias, !Sub 'alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-assets']
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  # S3 Bucket for file assets
  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasBucketName
        - !Ref BucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ECR Repository for container assets
  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !Ref KmsKey
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowPullPush
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - 'ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer'
              - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
              - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
              - 'ecr:PutImage'
              - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
              - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
              - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
              - 'ecr:DescribeRepositories'
              - 'ecr:ListImages'
              - 'ecr:DescribeImages'
              - 'ecr:StartImageScan'
              - 'ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy'

  # SSM Parameter for bootstrap version
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

  # IAM Roles
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref FilePublishingManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'file-publishing-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref ImagePublishingManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'image-publishing-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:PutImage'
                  - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
                  - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  AccountLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-account-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref AccountLookupManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'account-lookup-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'organizations:DescribeAccount'
                  - 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
                  - 'iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy'
                  - 'iam:GetAccountSummary'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  DeployActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Sub
                    - '${AccountId},${TrustedAccounts}'
                    - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      TrustedAccounts: !Join [',', !Ref TrustedAccounts]
                - - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref DeploymentManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'deploy-action-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:CreateStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:UpdateStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:DeleteStack'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStacks'
                  - 'cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents'
                  - 'cloudformation:GetTemplate'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: 'cdk-bootstrap'
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns: !Ref CloudFormationExecutionManagedPolicyArns
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'cfn-execution-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudformation:*'

      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for NIH Grants Research Assistant backend API'
Parameters:
  TemplateName:
    Type: String
    Default: nih-grants
    Description: Base name for resource naming
Resources:
  # Cognito User Pool
  NihGrantsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
  # User Pool Client
  NihGrantsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-app-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref NihGrantsUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
  # API Gateway REST API
  NihGrantsApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${TemplateName}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Description: 'NIH Grants Research Assistant API'
  # Cognito Authorizer
  NihGrantsAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${TemplateName}-authorizer'
      Type: COGNITO
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt NihGrantsUserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
  # Resources - paths
  GrantsResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt NihGrantsApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: grants
  GrantsSearchResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !Ref GrantsResource
      PathPart: search
  ScrapeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt NihGrantsApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: scrape
  TemplatesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt NihGrantsApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: templates
  TemplatesGenerateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !Ref TemplatesResource
      PathPart: generate
  TemplatesStatusResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !Ref TemplatesResource
      PathPart: status
  ArtifactsResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt NihGrantsApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: artifacts
  ArtifactsListResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !Ref ArtifactsResource
      PathPart: list
  ReporterResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt NihGrantsApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: reporter
  ReporterQueryResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ParentId: !Ref ReporterResource
      PathPart: query
  # Lambda Functions (4) and their roles
  SearchLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  SearchLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-search-grants'
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt SearchLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Search grants endpoint'})
              }
  ScrapeLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  ScrapeLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-scrape'
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScrapeLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Scrape endpoint'})
              }
  StatusLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  StatusLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-check-status'
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt StatusLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Status endpoint'})
              }
  ArtifactsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  ArtifactsLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-list-artifacts'
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ArtifactsLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Artifacts list endpoint'})
              }
  # KMS Key for SQS
  SqsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: 'KMS key for SQS queues'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SQS Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      EnableKeyRotation: true
  SqsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/NihGrantsSqsKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
  # SQS DLQ
  NihGrantsTemplateDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-template-dlq'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
  # SQS Main Queue
  NihGrantsTemplateQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-template-queue'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt NihGrantsTemplateDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
  # SQS Queue Policy - enforce encrypted in transit
  SqsQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref NihGrantsTemplateQueue
        - !Ref NihGrantsTemplateDLQ
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
  # IAM Role for API Gateway to send to SQS
  ApiGatewaySqsSendRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${TemplateName}-api-gw-sqs-send'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SqsSendMessagePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !GetAtt NihGrantsTemplateQueue.Arn
  # IAM Role for CloudWatch Logs (API Gateway account)
  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs
  # API Gateway Account
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn
  # Methods on Resources
  # 1. GET /grants/search with Lambda Proxy (cognito auth)
  GrantsSearchGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GrantsSearchResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO
      AuthorizerId: !Ref NihGrantsAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${SearchLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
  # OPTIONS for /grants/search
  GrantsSearchOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GrantsSearchResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode":200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"

  ScrapePostMethod:

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref NihGrantsApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ScrapeResource
      HttpMethod: POST

    Description: Name of an existing blue environment (leave empty to create a new one)
  ExistingBlueEndpointURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: CNAME of the existing blue environment (required if using existing environment)
  BlueGreenUpdate:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: Set to true to perform a blue/green update (creates green environment and swaps)
  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: "64bit Amazon Linux 2 v5.8.1 running Node.js 18"
    Description: Solution stack for the Elastic Beanstalk environment
  CustomS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Custom S3 bucket containing the application source (leave empty to use sample)
  CustomS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Custom S3 key for the application source (leave empty to use sample)
  CreateSampleSecret:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "false"
    Description: Set to true to create a sample secret in Secrets Manager
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"

Conditions:
  IsNewApp: !Equals [!Ref ExistingApplicationName, ""]
  IsNewBlueEnv: !Equals [!Ref ExistingEnvironmentName, ""]
  IsBlueGreenUpdate: !Equals [!Ref BlueGreenUpdate, "true"]
  UseCustomS3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomS3Bucket, ""]]
  CreateSampleSecretCond: !Equals [!Ref CreateSampleSecret, "true"]
  AppVersionNeeded: !Or [Condition: IsNewBlueEnv, Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate]

Resources:
  # VPC and Networking
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElasticBeanstalkVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElasticBeanstalkSubnet1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ElasticBeanstalkSubnet2

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # IAM Roles
  ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkService

  ElasticBeanstalkWebTierRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ElasticBeanstalkWebTierRole

  # Elastic Beanstalk Application
  Application:
    Condition: IsNewApp
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Application for blue-green deployment

  # Application Version (created when either new blue or green is needed)
  ApplicationVersion:
    Condition: AppVersionNeeded
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApp, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      SourceBundle:
        !If
        - UseCustomS3
        -
          S3Bucket: !Ref CustomS3Bucket
          S3Key: !Ref CustomS3Key
        -
          S3Bucket: !Sub "elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}"
          S3Key: "nodejs-sample.zip"

  # Blue Environment
  BlueEnvironment:
    Condition: IsNewBlueEnv
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApp, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentNameBlue
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref Subnet1, !Ref Subnet2]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: "true"

  # Green Environment (temporary)
  GreenEnvironment:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If [IsNewApp, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentNameGreen
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref ApplicationVersion
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref InstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [",", [!Ref Subnet1, !Ref Subnet2]]
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: "true"

  # Lambda Execution Role
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticBeanstalkActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:SwapEnvironmentCNAMEs
                  - elasticbeanstalk:TerminateEnvironment
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEnvironments
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda Function
  CustomResourceLambda:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          const eb = new AWS.ElasticBeanstalk();
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const send = async (res) => {
              const url = event.ResponseURL;
              const body = JSON.stringify(res);
              const https = require('https');
              return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const req = https.request(url, { method: 'PUT', headers: {'Content-Type':'','Content-Length':Buffer.byteLength(body)} }, resolve);
                req.on('error', reject);
                req.write(body);
                req.end();
              });
            };
            let response = { Status: 'SUCCESS', PhysicalResourceId: event.PhysicalResourceId || event.LogicalResourceId, StackId: event.StackId, RequestId: event.RequestId, LogicalResourceId: event.LogicalResourceId };
            try {
              const props = event.ResourceProperties;
              if (event.LogicalResourceId === 'SwapCNAMECustomResource') {
                if (event.RequestType === 'Create' || event.RequestType === 'Update') {
                  await eb.swapEnvironmentCNAMEs({
                    SourceEnvironmentName: props.BlueEnvName,
                    DestinationEnvironmentName: props.GreenEnvName
                  }).promise();
                }
              } else if (event.LogicalResourceId === 'TerminateGreenCustomResource') {
                if (event.RequestType === 'Create') {
                  await eb.terminateEnvironment({ EnvironmentName: props.GreenEnvName }).promise();
                }
              }
            } catch (e) {
              response.Status = 'FAILED';
              response.Reason = e.message;
            }
            await send(response);
          };

  # Custom Resource to Swap CNAMEs
  SwapCNAMECustomResource:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CustomResourceLambda.Arn
      BlueEnvName: !If [IsNewBlueEnv, !Ref EnvironmentNameBlue, !Ref ExistingEnvironmentName]
      GreenEnvName: !Ref EnvironmentNameGreen

  # Custom Resource to Terminate Green Environment
  TerminateGreenCustomResource:
    Condition: IsBlueGreenUpdate
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CustomResourceLambda.Arn
      GreenEnvName: !Ref EnvironmentNameGreen

  # Optional Sample Secret (for extensibility)
  SampleSecret:
    Condition: CreateSampleSecretCond
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sample-secret"
      Description: Sample secret for extensibility
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"admin"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 16
        ExcludePunctuation: true

Outputs:
  BlueEnvironmentEndpointURL:
    Description: CNAME of the blue environment
    Value: !If
      - IsNewBlueEnv
      - !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL
      - !Ref ExistingBlueEndpointURL
  ApplicationNameOutput:
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application
    Value: !If [IsNewApp, !Ref ApplicationName, !Ref ExistingApplicationName]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Network stack for staging or production environment with dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 VPC

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
    Description: Environment name used to select VPC CIDR and naming

  EnableNATGateway:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: 'When true, provisions a NAT Gateway in the public subnets with an Elastic IP'

  BastionVPNPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    Description: UDP/TCP port used for bastion VPN access

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.64.0.0/16
      DomainName: staging.example.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.128.0.0/16
      DomainName: production.example.internal

  SubnetCIDRs:
    staging:
      PublicSubnet1: 10.64.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2: 10.64.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3: 10.64.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1: 10.64.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2: 10.64.11.0/24
    production:
      PublicSubnet1: 10.128.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2: 10.128.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3: 10.128.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1: 10.128.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2: 10.128.11.0/24

Conditions:
  EnableNAT: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc'

  # IPv6 CIDR block for VPC
  VpcCidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Egress-Only Internet Gateway (for IPv6 egress)
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-eigw'

  # Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetCIDRs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-subnet-3'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained serverless Movies API using DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway'
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+'
    Description: Environment name for stage and resource naming
Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TableName: !Sub "MoviesTable-${Environment}"

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "CreateMovie-${Environment}"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 201,
                      'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST,OPTIONS', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie created'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(e)
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "ReadMovie-${Environment}"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if not item:
                      return {'statusCode': 404, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie not found'})}
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps(item)}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(e)
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "UpdateMovie-${Environment}"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  update_expr = 'SET '
                  expr_attr_values = {}
                  for key, value in body.items():
                      if key != 'title':
                          update_expr += f"#{key} = :{key}, "
                          expr_attr_values[f":{key}"] = value
                  update_expr = update_expr.rstrip(', ')
                  if not expr_attr_values:
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'No attributes to update'})}
                  expr_attr_names = {f"#{k}": k for k in body if k != 'title'}
                  table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression=update_expr,
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=expr_attr_names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=expr_attr_values
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie updated'})}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(e)
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "DeleteMovie-${Environment}"
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os, logging
          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie deleted'})}
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.error(e)
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': {'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'}, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/CreateMovie-${Environment}"
      RetentionInDays: 1

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/ReadMovie-${Environment}"
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/UpdateMovie-${Environment}"
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/DeleteMovie-${Environment}"
      RetentionInDays: 1

  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "MoviesAPI-${Environment}"
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: "Movies"

  TitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: "{title}"

  MoviesPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  MoviesPutMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  MoviesDeleteMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  TitleGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref TitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ReadMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  MoviesOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {"statusCode": 200}
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

  TitleOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref TitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {"statusCode": 200}
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

  CreateMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*/*"

  UpdateMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref UpdateMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*/*"

  DeleteMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DeleteMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*/*"

  ReadMoviePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ReadMovieFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/*/*"

  MoviesApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MoviesPostMethod
      - MoviesPutMethod
      - MoviesDeleteMethod
      - TitleGetMethod
      - MoviesOptionsMethod
      - TitleOptionsMethod
      - CreateMoviePermission
      - UpdateMoviePermission
      - DeleteMoviePermission
      - ReadMoviePermission
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      StageName: !Ref Environment

Outputs:

    Description: "API Gateway endpoint URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://${MoviesApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Environment}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to provision a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona, with self-contained networking and domain creation when no existing domain is provided.
Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional existing SageMaker Studio Domain ID. Leave empty to create a new domain."
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: "Name for the SageMaker Studio user profile."
Conditions:
  CreateNewDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, ""]
Resources:
  # VPC and networking resources (created only when no existing domain is provided)
  SageMakerVPC:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioIGW
  AttachGateway:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioPublicSubnet
  RouteTable:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: SageMakerStudioRouteTable
  DefaultRoute:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  # IAM Execution Role for MLOps engineer persona (always created) with inline policy
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: SageMakerPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB, JS resolvers, and subscriptions.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: TodoAPIwithJs
    Description: Name for the GraphQL API.

Resources:
  # ===== GraphQL API =====
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      AdditionalAuthenticationProviders: []

  # ===== API Key (default 7-day expiration) =====
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      # No Expires property – defaults to 7 days

  # ===== GraphQL Schema =====
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
          createdAt: AWSDateTime
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime
        }
        input CreateTodoInput {
          id: ID
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
        }
        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          listTodosByOwner(owner: String!): TodoConnection
        }
        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }
        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }
        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

  # ===== DynamoDB Table =====
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      TableName: !Sub "${ApiName}-todos"

  # ===== IAM Role for AppSync DataSource =====
  DataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TodoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${TodoTable.Arn}/index/*"

  # ===== AppSync DataSource =====
  TodoDynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ===== JavaScript Functions =====
  FunctionCreateTodo:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: createTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id, owner, title, description } = ctx.arguments.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id: id ? id : util.autoId(),
            owner: owner || null,
            title: title || null,
            description: description || null,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: item.id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(item)
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  FunctionUpdateTodo:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: updateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id, owner, title, description } = ctx.arguments.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const updates = {};
          const exprNames = {};
          const exprValues = {};
          let expr = 'SET ';
          if (owner !== undefined) {
            expr += '#owner = :owner, ';
            exprNames['#owner'] = 'owner';
            exprValues[':owner'] = owner;
          }
          if (title !== undefined) {
            expr += '#title = :title, ';
            exprNames['#title'] = 'title';
            exprValues[':title'] = title;
          }
          if (description !== undefined) {
            expr += '#description = :description, ';
            exprNames['#description'] = 'description';
            exprValues[':description'] = description;
          }
          expr += '#updatedAt = :updatedAt';
          exprNames['#updatedAt'] = 'updatedAt';
          exprValues[':updatedAt'] = now;
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),
            update: {
              expression: expr,
              expressionNames: exprNames,
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(exprValues)
            }
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  FunctionDeleteTodo:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: deleteTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.arguments.id })
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  FunctionGetTodo:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: getTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.arguments.id })
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  FunctionListTodos:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: listTodosFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          let args = { limit: ctx.arguments.limit || 10 };
          if (ctx.arguments.nextToken) {
            args.nextToken = ctx.arguments.nextToken;
          }
          return {
            operation: 'Scan',
            limit: args.limit,
            nextToken: args.nextToken
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  FunctionListTodosByOwner:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: listTodosByOwnerFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt TodoDynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: "1.0.0"
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'Query',
            index: 'owner-index',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ ':owner': ctx.arguments.owner })
            }
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  # ===== Resolvers (Pipeline) =====
  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FunctionCreateTodo.FunctionId
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {} }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result }

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FunctionUpdateTodo.FunctionId
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {} }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result }

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FunctionDeleteTodo.FunctionId
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {} }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result }

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FunctionGetTodo.FunctionId
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {} }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result }

  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FunctionListTodos.FunctionId
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {} }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result }

  ListTodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodosByOwner
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FunctionListTodosByOwner.FunctionId
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) { return {} }
        export function response(ctx) { return ctx.prev.result }

    Description: GraphQL API endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKey:
    Description: API key value

  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref TodoTable
