AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover application monitoring API Gateway, Lambda, and RDS."

Parameters:
  ApiGatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: "Remittance"
    Description: "Name of the existing API Gateway REST API for dimension ApiName."
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: "GetRemittances"
    Description: "Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function."
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CreateRemittance"
    Description: "Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function."
  RDSInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: "dbcluster1-instance1"
    Description: "Identifier of the existing RDS DB instance."

Resources:
  # API Gateway Alarms
  API4XXErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API-4XXErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average 4XX errors > 0 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "4XXError"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName

  API5XXErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API-5XXErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average 5XX errors > 1 over 60 seconds."
      MetricName: "5XXError"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName

  APILatency:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API-Latency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average latency >= 10000 ms over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "Latency"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayName

  # Lambda Alarms for GetRemittances
  GetRemittancesErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances-Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed errors > 0 over 60 seconds for GetRemittances."
      MetricName: "Errors"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesInvocations:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances-Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed invocations > 2 over 60 seconds for GetRemittances."
      MetricName: "Invocations"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  GetRemittancesDuration:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "GetRemittances-Duration"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average duration >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds for GetRemittances."
      MetricName: "Duration"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "missing"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName

  # Lambda Alarms for CreateRemittance
  CreateRemittanceErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance-Errors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed errors > 0 over 60 seconds for CreateRemittance."
      MetricName: "Errors"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceInvocations:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance-Invocations"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed invocations > 2 over 60 seconds for CreateRemittance."
      MetricName: "Invocations"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  CreateRemittanceDuration:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "CreateRemittance-Duration"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average duration >= 10000 ms over 900 seconds for CreateRemittance."
      MetricName: "Duration"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "missing"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName

  # RDS Alarms
  RDSCPUUtilization:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-CPUUtilization"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average CPU >= 70% over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "CPUUtilization"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSDatabaseConnections:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-DatabaseConnections"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average database connections >= 100 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "DatabaseConnections"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSDeadlocks:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-Deadlocks"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average deadlocks >= 10 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "Deadlocks"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSNetworkTransmitThroughput:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-NetworkTransmitThroughput"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average network transmit throughput >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "NetworkTransmitThroughput"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSNetworkReceiveThroughput:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-NetworkReceiveThroughput"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average network receive throughput >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "NetworkReceiveThroughput"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSQueries:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-Queries"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average queries >= 100 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "Queries"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSDiskQueueDepth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-DiskQueueDepth"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average disk queue depth >= 50 over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "DiskQueueDepth"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSReadLatency:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-ReadLatency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average read latency >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "ReadLatency"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  RDSWriteLatency:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS-WriteLatency"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average write latency >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds."
      MetricName: "WriteLatency"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref RDSInstanceIdentifier

  # Composite Alarms
  APIGatewayHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for API Gateway health based on 4XX, 5XX, and latency."
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3})"
        - Alarm1: !GetAtt API4XXErrors.Arn
          Alarm2: !GetAtt API5XXErrors.Arn
          Alarm3: !GetAtt APILatency.Arn

  LambdaHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "Lambda Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for Lambda health based on errors and duration (excluding invocations)."
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3}) OR ALARM(${Alarm4})"
        - Alarm1: !GetAtt GetRemittancesErrors.Arn
          Alarm2: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceErrors.Arn
          Alarm3: !GetAtt GetRemittancesDuration.Arn
          Alarm4: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceDuration.Arn

  RDSHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for RDS health based on all nine metric alarms."
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - "ALARM(${Alarm1}) OR ALARM(${Alarm2}) OR ALARM(${Alarm3}) OR ALARM(${Alarm4}) OR ALARM(${Alarm5}) OR ALARM(${Alarm6}) OR ALARM(${Alarm7}) OR ALARM(${Alarm8}) OR ALARM(${Alarm9})"
        - Alarm1: !GetAtt RDSCPUUtilization.Arn
          Alarm2: !GetAtt RDSDatabaseConnections.Arn
          Alarm3: !GetAtt RDSDeadlocks.Arn
          Alarm4: !GetAtt RDSNetworkTransmitThroughput.Arn
          Alarm5: !GetAtt RDSNetworkReceiveThroughput.Arn
          Alarm6: !GetAtt RDSQueries.Arn
          Alarm7: !GetAtt RDSDiskQueueDepth.Arn
          Alarm8: !GetAtt RDSReadLatency.Arn
          Alarm9: !GetAtt RDSWriteLatency.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Comprehensive QuickSight monitoring and data extraction pipeline using Glue, CloudWatch Metric Streams, and Firehose."
Resources:
  # Customer managed KMS key for S3 encryption
  S3EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Encrypt
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: "*"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
  S3EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/admin-suite-s3-key-${AWS::AccountId}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref S3EncryptionKey
  # Single IAM role for Glue, Firehose, CloudWatch Metric Streams
  AdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
  AdminRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      PolicyName: "admin-suite-policy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref AdminRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - quicksight:List*
              - quicksight:Describe*
              - glue:StartJobRun
              - glue:GetJob*
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
              - firehose:PutRecord
              - firehose:PutRecordBatch
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Encrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt S3EncryptionKey.Arn
  # Output S3 bucket (retain)
  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref S3EncryptionKey
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${OutputBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${OutputBucket.Arn}/*"
  # Scripts S3 bucket (deletable)
  ScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref S3EncryptionKey
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
  ScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ScriptsBucket.Arn}/*"
  # Glue Jobs (5 Python Shell)
  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucket}/jobs/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucket}/jobs/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucket}/jobs/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucket}/jobs/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucket}/jobs/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
  # Glue Jobs (2 ETL)
  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucket}/jobs/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      WorkerType: "G.1X"
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptsBucket}/jobs/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      WorkerType: "G.1X"
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
  # Glue Triggers (one per job)
  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "trigger-${GlueJobAssetsAccess}"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess
          Arguments:
            "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
            "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "trigger-${GlueJobAssetsMetadata}"
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: "cron(0 */3 * * ? *)"
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata
          Arguments:
            "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
            "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
  TriggerFolderAssets:

    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "trigger-${GlueJobFolderAssets}"
      Type: SCHEDULED

      Actions:

          Arguments:
            "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
            "--account-id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
  TriggerQMetadata:

      Actions:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained serverless CRUD API for Kitten service'

Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenCrudFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenCrudFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref KittenTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid
          import boto3
          import os

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def handler(event, context):
              http_method = event['httpMethod']
              path = event['resource']
              headers = {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS",
                  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token"
              }

              try:
                  if http_method == 'POST' and path == '/kitten':
                      body = json.loads(event['body'])
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing name or color'})}
                      kitten_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                      item = {'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color}
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return {'statusCode': 201, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps(item)}

                  elif http_method == 'GET' and path == '/kitten':
                      response = table.scan()
                      items = response.get('Items', [])
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps(items)}

                  elif http_method == 'GET' and path == '/kitten/{id}':
                      kitten_id = event['pathParameters']['id']
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      item = response.get('Item')
                      if not item:
                          return {'statusCode': 404, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})}
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps(item)}

                  elif http_method == 'PUT' and path == '/kitten/{id}':
                      kitten_id = event['pathParameters']['id']
                      body = json.loads(event['body'])
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing name or color'})}
                      # Check if item exists
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      if 'Item' not in response:
                          return {'statusCode': 404, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})}
                      table.put_item(Item={'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color})
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'KittenId': kitten_id, 'name': name, 'color': color})}

                  elif http_method == 'DELETE' and path == '/kitten/{id}':
                      kitten_id = event['pathParameters']['id']
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      if 'Item' not in response:
                          return {'statusCode': 404, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})}
                      table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      return {'statusCode': 204, 'headers': headers, 'body': ''}

                  else:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Unsupported route'})}

              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': headers, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}

  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenAPI
      Description: CRUD API for Kitten service
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  # POST /kitten
  PostKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${KittenCrudFunction.Arn}/invocations

  # GET /kitten
  GetKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${KittenCrudFunction.Arn}/invocations

  # OPTIONS /kitten (CORS preflight)
  OptionsKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode":200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''

  # GET /kitten/{id}
  GetKittenByIdMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Step Functions state machine with alias and multiple event-driven triggers'
Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp
    Description: Prefix for resource names

Resources:
  # Step Functions State Machine
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AppName}-state-machine"
      DefinitionString: '{"Comment":"State machine with single pass state","StartAt":"ReturnOne","States":{"ReturnOne":{"Type":"Pass","Result":1,"End":true}}}'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-state-machine-exec-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  # State Machine Version
  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      Description: "Version 1"

  # State Machine Alias
  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-alias"
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100
      Description: "Alias for active version"

  # API Gateway - REST API
  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-api"
      Description: "API to start Step Functions execution"

  ApiGatewayResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution"
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json:
            Fn::Sub:
              - '{"stateMachineArn": "${AliasArn}","input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params(\"input\"))"}'
              - AliasArn: !GetAtt StateMachineAlias.Arn
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"executionArn": "$input.path(\"$.executionArn\")"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethod
      - ApiGatewayResource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: prod

  # IAM Role for API Gateway
  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-role-api-gateway"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineAlias.Arn

  # EventBridge Rule - Terminated State Changes
  EventBridgeTerminatedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-rule-terminated"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.states
        detail-type:
          - Step Functions Execution Status Change
        detail:
          status:
            - SUCCEEDED
            - FAILED
            - TIMED_OUT
            - ABORTED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: AliasTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeTerminatedRuleRole.Arn

  # IAM Role for Terminated Rule
  EventBridgeTerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-role-eventbridge-terminated"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineAlias.Arn

  # EventBridge Rule - Scheduled (Disabled)
  EventBridgeScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-rule-scheduled-disabled"
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: AliasTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  # IAM Role for Scheduled Rule
  EventBridgeScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-role-eventbridge-scheduled"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineAlias.Arn

  # EventBridge Rule - Tag Events
  EventBridgeTagRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-rule-tag-events"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - TagChange
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          Id: AliasTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeTagRuleRole.Arn

  # IAM Role for Tag Rule
  EventBridgeTagRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-role-eventbridge-tag"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineAlias.Arn

  # EventBridge Scheduler Schedule
  SchedulerSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-scheduler-schedule"
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: "OFF"
      State: ENABLED
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
        Input: '{"description": "Scheduled execution"}'

  # IAM Role for Scheduler
  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-role-scheduler"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionOnAlias
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineAlias.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with managed NAT gateways, flow logs, S3 gateway endpoint, and ECR interface endpoints"

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR block in the format x.x.x.x/16-28"
  TrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: "ALL"
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
    Description: "The type of traffic to capture in VPC flow logs"
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: "Number of days to retain VPC flow logs in CloudWatch Logs"
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetA"
        - Key: Type
          Value: public
  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetB"
        - Key: Type
          Value: public

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetA"
        - Key: Type
          Value: private
  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetB"
        - Key: Type
          Value: private

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  EIPA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-EIP-A"
  EIPB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT-EIP-B"

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGateway-A"
  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIPB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGateway-B"

  # Route Tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Public-RT"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Private-RT-A"
  PrivateRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Private-RT-B"
  PrivateRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  # Subnet Route Table Associations
  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref TrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

  # Gateway VPC Endpoint for S3
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"

  # Security Group for interface endpoints
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECR interface endpoints
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSG"

  # Interface VPC Endpoints for ECR
  ECRApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ECRDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"
  VpcCidr:
    Description: "VPC CIDR block"
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr"
  AvailabilityZoneA:
    Description: "Availability Zone for PublicSubnetA and PrivateSubnetA"
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZoneA"
  AvailabilityZoneB:
    Description: "Availability Zone for PublicSubnetB and PrivateSubnetB"
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AvailabilityZoneB"
  PublicSubnetAId:
    Description: "Public Subnet A ID"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetAId"
  PublicSubnetBId:
    Description: "Public Subnet B ID"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetBId"
  PrivateSubnetAId:
    Description: "Private Subnet A ID"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetAId"
  PrivateSubnetBId:
    Description: "Private Subnet B ID"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetBId"
  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID for VPC endpoints"
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Route 53 Hosted Zone and DNS Records for theworld.org"

Parameters:

  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: theworld.org.
    Description: Root domain name with trailing dot

  ProjectTag:
    Type: String
    Default: MediaPlatform

  ManagedByTag:
    Type: String
    Default: CloudFormation

  DmarcRuaEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc-rua@theworld.org
    Description: DMARC aggregate report email

  DmarcRufEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc-ruf@theworld.org
    Description: DMARC forensic report email

  # MX record parameters
  MxRootExchange:
    Type: String
    Default: mail.theworld.org.
  MxRootPriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10

  MxGsuiteExchange:
    Type: String
    Default: gsuite.smtp.theworld.org.
  MxGsuitePriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10

  MxO365Exchange:
    Type: String
    Default: o365.smtp.theworld.org.
  MxO365Priority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10

  MxBounceExchange:
    Type: String
    Default: bounce.smtp.theworld.org.
  MxBouncePriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10

  # CloudFront alias parameters (each subdomain)
  CfAdminDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d1234admin.cloudfront.net
  CfAdminZoneId:
    Type: String
    Default: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

  CfApiDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d1234api.cloudfront.net
  CfApiZoneId:
    Type: String
    Default: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

  CfProjectsDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d1234projects.cloudfront.net
  CfProjectsZoneId:
    Type: String
    Default: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

  CfSitemapDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d1234sitemap.cloudfront.net
  CfSitemapZoneId:
    Type: String
    Default: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

  # CNAME parameters
  CnameFeedsTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds.external.example.com.
    Description: CNAME target for feeds.theworld.org

  CnameZendeskDomainkeyTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk1._domainkey.zendesk.com.
    Description: Zendesk domain key CNAME target

  # ACM validation CNAME parameters for each subdomain
  AcmAdminValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaaa.admin.theworld.org.
  AcmAdminValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaaa.admin.acm-validation.example.com.
  AcmApiValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaab.api.theworld.org.
  AcmApiValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaab.api.acm-validation.example.com.
  AcmProjectsValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaac.projects.theworld.org.
  AcmProjectsValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaac.projects.acm-validation.example.com.
  AcmSitemapValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaad.sitemap.theworld.org.
  AcmSitemapValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaad.sitemap.acm-validation.example.com.
  AcmWwwValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaae.www.theworld.org.
  AcmWwwValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaae.www.acm-validation.example.com.
  AcmStagingValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaaf.staging.theworld.org.
  AcmStagingValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaaf.staging.acm-validation.example.com.
  AcmFeedsValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaag.feeds.theworld.org.
  AcmFeedsValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _aaaaaaag.feeds.acm-validation.example.com.

Resources:

  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectTag
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: !Ref ManagedByTag

  # Root TXT record (SPF)
  RootSPFRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - "\"v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:spf.createsend.com include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com include:sendergen.com ~all\""

  # DMARC record
  DmarcRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "_dmarc.${DomainName}"
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub 
          - "\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:${Rua}; ruf=mailto:${Ruf};\""
          - Rua: !Ref DmarcRuaEmail
            Ruf: !Ref DmarcRufEmail

  # MX records
  RootMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Join [" ", [!Ref MxRootPriority, !Ref MxRootExchange]]

  GsuiteMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "gsuite.${DomainName}"
      Type: MX
      TTL: 3600
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Join [" ", [!Ref MxGsuitePriority, !Ref MxGsuiteExchange]]

  O365MXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub "o365.${DomainName}"
      Type: MX

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC with Microsoft AD infrastructure support, including flow logs, KMS key, and VPC endpoints.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: VPC CIDR block (must be /24 or larger for subnets)

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    Public1:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.0/26
    Public2:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.64/26
    Private1:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.128/26
    Private2:
      Cidr: 10.0.0.192/26

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPC

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-IGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NATGW1-EIP

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NATGW2-EIP

  # Public Subnets (AZ1 and AZ2)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Public1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Public2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicSubnet2

  # Private Subnets (AZ1 and AZ2)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Private1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, Private2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateSubnet2

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NATGW1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-NATGW2

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PublicRT

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRT1

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-PrivateRT2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # KMS Key for Flow Log Encryption
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow log encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogKey

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogKey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  # CloudWatch Log Group for Flow Logs
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/KerberosEMRonEKS
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn

  IamRoleForFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLogRole

  # VPC Flow Log
  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt IamRoleForFlowLogs.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-FlowLog

  # Security Group for VPC Endpoints
  VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-VPCEndpointsSG

  # VPC Interface Endpoints (Private Subnets)
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSM-Endpoint

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SSMessages-Endpoint

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-EC2Messages-Endpoint

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: KerberosEMRonEKS-SecretsManager-Endpoint

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 (AZ1)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 (AZ2)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 (AZ1)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 (AZ2)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  NatGateway1Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 1 (AZ1)
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1

  NatGateway2Id:
    Description: NAT Gateway 2 (AZ2)
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2

  FlowLogKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS Key ARN for flow log encryption
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogId:
    Description: VPC Flow Log ID
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLog

  VpcEndpointsSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID for VPC endpoints
    Value: !GetAtt VpcEndpointsSecurityGroup.GroupId

  SSMEndpointId:
    Description: SSM VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref SSMEndpoint

  SSMMessagesEndpointId:
    Description: SSM Messages VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref SSMMessagesEndpoint

  EC2MessagesEndpointId:
    Description: EC2 Messages VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref EC2MessagesEndpoint

  SecretsManagerEndpointId:
    Description: Secrets Manager VPC Endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref SecretsManagerEndpoint

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC foundation for Amazon Redshift with 3 AZs, public/private subnets, NAT gateways, and S3 Gateway Endpoint"

Parameters:
  Octet:
    Type: Number
    Description: Second octet for the VPC CIDR (10.x.0.0/16)
    Default: 0

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Sub "10.${Octet}.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-vpc-${Octet}"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-igw-${Octet}"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnets (indices 0,1,2)
  PublicSubnet0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Sub "10.${Octet}.0.0/20"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-public-subnet-0-${Octet}"

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Sub "10.${Octet}.16.0/20"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-public-subnet-1-${Octet}"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Sub "10.${Octet}.32.0/20"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-public-subnet-2-${Octet}"

  # Private subnets (indices 3,4,5)
  PrivateSubnet0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Sub "10.${Octet}.48.0/20"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-private-subnet-0-${Octet}"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Sub "10.${Octet}.64.0/20"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-private-subnet-1-${Octet}"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Sub "10.${Octet}.80.0/20"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-private-subnet-2-${Octet}"

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  EIP0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-nat-eip-0-${Octet}"

  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-nat-eip-1-${Octet}"

  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-nat-eip-2-${Octet}"

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP0.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet0
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-nat-0-${Octet}"

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-nat-1-${Octet}"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-nat-2-${Octet}"

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-public-rt-${Octet}"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: AZ
          Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-private-rt-0-${Octet}"

  PrivateRoute0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway0

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: AZ
          Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-private-rt-1-${Octet}"

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: AZ
          Value: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-private-rt-2-${Octet}"

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # Network ACLs
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-public-nacl-${Octet}"

  PublicNetworkAclInbound:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: false
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  PublicNetworkAclOutbound:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: true
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Redshift
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Private
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "redshift-private-nacl-${Octet}"

  PrivateNetworkAclInbound:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: false
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  PrivateNetworkAclOutbound:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      Egress: true
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

  # Subnet associations for NACLs
  PublicSubnetNetworkAclAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet0
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnetNetworkAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PublicSubnetNetworkAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet0
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PrivateNetworkAcl

  # S3 Gateway Endpoint
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: The CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock

  AvailabilityZone0:
    Description: First availability zone
    Value: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: Second availability zone
    Value: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Third availability zone
    Value: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]

  PublicSubnet0Id:
    Description: Public subnet ID in AZ 0
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet0

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet ID in AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet ID in AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet0Id:
    Description: Private subnet ID in AZ 0
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet0

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet ID in AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet ID in AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the shared public route table
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable0Id:
    Description: Private route table ID for AZ 0
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0

  PrivateRouteTable1Id:
    Description: Private route table ID for AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2Id:
    Description: Private route table ID for AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  S3EndpointId:
    Description: Gateway VPC endpoint ID for S3
    Value: !Ref S3GatewayEndpoint
