AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained SageMaker Domain in VPC Only mode with test user profile'

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the SageMaker Domain
    Default: MyDomain
  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name for the test user profile
    Default: testuser

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-vpc'

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet1'

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-subnet2'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-route-table'

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Domain VPC Only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 1024
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 1024
          ToPort: 65535
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-sg'

  SageMakerApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTable

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for SageMaker default bucket encryption
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${DomainName}-kms-key'

  DefaultBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${DomainName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerFullAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                  - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: S3AccessToDefaultBucket
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DefaultBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DefaultBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: KMSAccessToDefaultBucket
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  Domain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      DefaultSpaceSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

  UserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !Ref Domain
      UserProfileName: !Ref TestUserName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: The ID of the SageMaker Domain
    Value: !Ref Domain
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: The name of the execution role
    Value: !Ref ExecutionRole
  StudioConsoleUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to SageMaker Studio for the new domain
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/studio/${Domain}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for CloudWatch Logs Insights saved queries for Claude Code application metrics.
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: The CloudWatch Logs log group name that contains the Claude Code metrics.
Resources:
  QueryRealTimeTokenAndRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-RealTime-TokenAndRequestRatePerUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats count() as requestCount, sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as totalTokens by user
        | sort requestCount desc
  QueryRealTimeCurrentTPMAverages:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-RealTime-CurrentTPMAverages
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        filter @timestamp > ago(1h)
        | stats avg(tokens_per_minute) as avgTPM, max(tokens_per_minute) as maxTPM by user
        | sort avgTPM desc
  QueryRealTimeRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-RealTime-RateLimitRisk
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        filter rate_limited = 1
        | stats count() as rateLimitEvents by user, bin(1h)
        | sort rateLimitEvents desc
  QueryUserSessionSessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-UserSession-SessionLevelUsage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as totalTokens, count() as requestCount, avg(duration) as avgDuration by session_id
        | sort totalTokens desc
  QueryUserSessionHourlyActivityTimelines:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-UserSession-HourlyActivityTimelines
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats count() as requestCount by bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp asc
  QueryUserSessionErrorThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-UserSession-ErrorThrottlingDetection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        filter status_code >= 400 or error_type like /error|throttle/
        | stats count() as errorCount by error_type, status_code
        | sort errorCount desc
  QueryCostAttributionByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-CostAttribution-ByUser
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as totalTokens, sum(cost) as totalCost by user
        | sort totalCost desc
  QueryCostAttributionByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-CostAttribution-ByModel
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as totalTokens, sum(cost) as totalCost by model
        | sort totalCost desc
  QueryCostAttributionByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-CostAttribution-ByOrganization
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as totalTokens, sum(cost) as totalCost by organization
        | sort totalCost desc
  QueryDebuggingModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-ModelEfficiency
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        filter tokens_input > 0
        | stats avg(tokens_output / tokens_input) as efficiencyRatio, count() as requestCount by model
        | sort efficiencyRatio desc
  QueryDebuggingCacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-CacheHitMissOverall
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(cache_hit) as totalHits, sum(cache_miss) as totalMisses, (sum(cache_hit) / (sum(cache_hit) + sum(cache_miss))) * 100 as hitRate
  QueryDebuggingCacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-CacheHitMissOverTime
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(cache_hit) as hits, sum(cache_miss) as misses by bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp desc
  QueryDebuggingCacheHitMissBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-CacheHitMissBySession
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(cache_hit) as hits, sum(cache_miss) as misses by session_id
        | sort hits desc
  QueryDebuggingPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-PeakUsageWindows
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats count() as requestCount, sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as totalTokens by bin(30m)
        | sort requestCount desc
        | limit 10
  QueryDebuggingDeepDiveSession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-DeepDiveSession
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        filter session_id = "SESSION_ID_GOES_HERE"
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 100
  QueryDebuggingFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-FieldExplorer
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @logGroup
        | limit 20
        | display @timestamp, @message
  QueryDebuggingDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-DailyUsageSummary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as totalTokens, count() as requestCount, sum(cost) as totalCost by bin(1d)
        | sort @timestamp desc
  QueryDebuggingRequestLatencyDistribution:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-RequestLatencyDistribution
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats avg(duration) as avgDuration, min(duration) as minDuration, max(duration) as maxDuration, p50(duration) as p50, p95(duration) as p95 by bin(1h)
        | sort @timestamp desc
  QueryDebuggingConcurrentSessions:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Query-Debugging-ConcurrentSessions
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        stats count_distinct(session_id) as activeSessions, count() as totalRequests by bin(5m)
        | sort @timestamp desc

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB datasource and logging"
Resources:
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: "Table1"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "id"
          AttributeType: "S"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "id"
          KeyType: "HASH"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  AppSyncLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/appsync/SuperCoolAPI-${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 7

  AppSyncLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${AppSyncLogGroup}:*"

  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: "SuperCoolAPI"
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL

  DynamoDBDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBDataSourcePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${Table1}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${Table1}/index/*"

  DynamoDBTableDSByArn:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: "DynamoDBTableDSByArn"
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref Table1

  DynamoDBTableDSByName:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: "DynamoDBTableDSByName"
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        TableName: !Ref Table1

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }
        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String!): Todo
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: "Query"
      FieldName: "getTodo"
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBTableDSByName.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: "Mutation"
      FieldName: "addTodo"
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBTableDSByName.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM identities and permissions for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap with EKS, managed node groups, and Fargate support'

Parameters:
  OIDCThumbprint:
    Type: String
    Default: '9e99a48a9960b14926bb7f3b02e22da2b0ab7280'
    Description: Thumbprint of OIDC provider root CA (default for EKS)

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking – minimal VPC for EKS cluster
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: '10.0.0.0/16'
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.1.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: '10.0.2.0/24'
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: '0.0.0.0/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ClusterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EKS cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-sg'

  ClusterSecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      GroupId: !Ref ClusterSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ClusterSecurityGroup

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS Key for EKS secrets encryption
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
            Resource: '*'
      Description: 'KMS key for EKS cluster secret encryption'
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EKS Cluster (required for OIDC provider)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSCluster:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneServiceRole.Arn
      ResourcesVpcConfig:
        SubnetIds:
          - !Ref PublicSubnet
          - !Ref PrivateSubnet
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref ClusterSecurityGroup
        EndpointPublicAccess: false
        EndpointPrivateAccess: true
      EncryptionConfig:
        - Provider:
            KeyArn: !GetAtt EKSEncryptionKey.Arn
          Resources:
            - secrets
      Version: '1.30'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM OIDC Provider (for IRSA – controller role)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OIDCProvider:
    Type: AWS::IAM::OIDCProvider
    Properties:
      Url: !GetAtt EKSCluster.OpenIdConnectIssuerUrl
      ClientIdList:
        - sts.amazonaws.com
      ThumbprintList:
        - !Ref OIDCThumbprint

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles and Instance Profiles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # 1. Control Plane Role (ec2)
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-control-plane-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # 2. Controllers Role (ec2 and IRSA)
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Ref OIDCProvider
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                oidc-provider:aud: sts.amazonaws.com
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                oidc-provider:sub: system:serviceaccount:*
      Path: '/'

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-controllers-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  # 3. Worker Nodes Role (ec2) with three attached managed policies
  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Path: '/'

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nodes-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  # 4. EKS Control Plane Service Role (eks)
  EKSControlPlaneServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eks-cp-service-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Path: '/'

  # 5. Fargate Execution Role (fargate pods)
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fargate-exec-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy
      Path: '/'

  # 6. Managed Node Group Role (ec2 and eks)
  ManagedNodeGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mng-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Path: '/'

  # Customer Managed Policies

  InTreeCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InTreeCloudProvider'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Configurable multi-tier VPC with up to 3 tiers and up to 3 Availability Zones

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: VPC CIDR block

  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: Number
    AllowedValues: [1, 2, 3]
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of Availability Zones to use

  Tier1Enabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'

  Tier2Enabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'

  Tier3Enabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'

  Tier1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: Public
    Description: Name for Tier1 (first) subnets and resources

  Tier2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: Private
    Description: Name for Tier2 subnets and resources

  Tier3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: Restricted
    Description: Name for Tier3 subnets and resources

  Tier1CIDRA:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier1CIDRB:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier1CIDRC:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier2CIDRA:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier2CIDRB:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.5.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier2CIDRC:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.6.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier3CIDRA:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.7.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier3CIDRB:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.8.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  Tier3CIDRC:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.9.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$

  NatGatewayType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['None', 'Single', 'PerAZ']
    Default: 'Single'
    Description: Choose NAT Gateway deployment type

  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional IAM permissions boundary ARN for the Flow Logs role

Conditions:
  # Tier enabled conditions (used directly by resources such as IGW, route table)
  Tier1EnabledCond: !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']

  # Tier1 subnet conditions
  Tier1AZ1: !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']
  Tier1AZ2: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]
  Tier1AZ3: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]

  # Tier2 subnet conditions
  Tier2AZ1: !Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true']
  Tier2AZ2: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]
  Tier2AZ3: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]

  # Tier3 subnet conditions
  Tier3AZ1: !Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true']
  Tier3AZ2: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]
  Tier3AZ3: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]

  # NAT conditions
  NatSingleAz1: !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]
  NatPerAZAz1: !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]
  NatPerAZAz2: !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]]
  NatPerAZAz3: !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]

  # Tier2 route conditions (each route table and NAT must exist)
  Tier2AZ1NatSingle: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier2AZ2NatSingle: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier2AZ3NatSingle: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier2AZ1NatPerAZ: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier2AZ2NatPerAZ: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]]]
  Tier2AZ3NatPerAZ: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]]

  # Tier3 route conditions (each route table and NAT must exist)
  Tier3AZ1NatSingle: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier3AZ2NatSingle: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier3AZ3NatSingle: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier3AZ1NatPerAZ: !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']]]
  Tier3AZ2NatPerAZ: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Or [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 2], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]]]
  Tier3AZ3NatPerAZ: !And [!And [!Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]], !And [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ'], !And [!Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true'], !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, 3]]]]

  # Permissions boundary condition
  UsePermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPC'
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MultiTierVPC

  # ---------- Subnets ----------
  SubnetTier1AZ1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier1AZ1
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier1CIDRA
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier1Name} AZ1'

  SubnetTier1AZ2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier1AZ2
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier1CIDRB
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier1Name} AZ2'

  SubnetTier1AZ3:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier1AZ3
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier1CIDRC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier1Name} AZ3'

  SubnetTier2AZ1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier2AZ1
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier2CIDRA
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier2Name} AZ1'

  SubnetTier2AZ2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier2AZ2
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier2CIDRB
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier2Name} AZ2'

  SubnetTier2AZ3:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier2AZ3
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier2CIDRC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier2Name} AZ3'

  SubnetTier3AZ1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier3AZ1
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier3CIDRA
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier3Name} AZ1'

  SubnetTier3AZ2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier3AZ2
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier3CIDRB
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier3Name} AZ2'

  SubnetTier3AZ3:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet'
    Condition: Tier3AZ3
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Tier3CIDRC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier3Name} AZ3'

  # ---------- Internet Gateway ----------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::InternetGateway'
    Condition: Tier1EnabledCond
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier1Name} IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment'
    Condition: Tier1EnabledCond
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------- Tier1 Route Table ----------
  Tier1RouteTable:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::RouteTable'
    Condition: Tier1EnabledCond
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier1Name} route table'

  Tier1RouteDefault:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Route'
    Condition: Tier1EnabledCond
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref Tier1RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetTier1AZ1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Condition: Tier1AZ1
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetTier1AZ1
      RouteTableId: !Ref Tier1RouteTable

  SubnetTier1AZ2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'
    Condition: Tier1AZ2
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetTier1AZ2
      RouteTableId: !Ref Tier1RouteTable

  SubnetTier1AZ3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared VPC with EMR on EKS and Celeborn support, including VPC endpoints, flow logs, and NAT gateways.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets (MapPublicIpOnLaunch set to false)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2'
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  # NAT Gateways
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2'

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Private Route Tables
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT1'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT2'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  # Subnet Route Table Associations
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # S3 Gateway Endpoint
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # Security Group for Interface Endpoints
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPC-Endpoints-SG'

  # Interface VPC Endpoints
  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  STSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EMREndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KMSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs (also used for CloudWatch Logs encryption)
  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting VPC Flow Logs and CloudWatch Logs group
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow Delivery Logs Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogKmsKey'

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-log-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogRole'

  # CloudWatch Logs Group for Flow Logs (encrypted with KMS key using ARN)
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Greenfield VPC with private subnets and optional public subnets across three AZs.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name tag for the VPC
    Default: 'MyVPC'
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16)
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to "true" to include three public subnets, Internet Gateway, and public route table.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnets, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Private Subnets (always)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az2'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-az3'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Public resources (conditional)
  InternetGateway:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-az1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-az2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-az3'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-rt'

  PublicRouteIpv4:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIpv6:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteAssociation:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Description: List of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: List of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM identities for Cluster API Provider for AWS (CAPA) bootstrap and operation"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    Description: Environment tag value for all resources

Resources:
  # Control Plane Role
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: ControlPlaneRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA Control Plane"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: ControlPlaneInstanceProfile
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControlPlaneCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ControlPlaneCloudProviderPolicy
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:PutParameter
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # EKS Control Plane Role
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: EKSControlPlaneRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA EKS Control Plane"

  # Controllers Role
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: ControllersRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA Controllers"

  # ClusterAPIControllersPolicy
  ClusterAPIControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ClusterAPIControllersPolicy
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - eks:*
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
              - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
              - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
              - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
              - iam:GetInstanceProfile
              - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
              - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:TagRole
              - iam:UntagRole
              - iam:CreatePolicy
              - iam:DeletePolicy
              - iam:CreatePolicyVersion
              - iam:DeletePolicyVersion
              - iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion
              - iam:CreateOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:DeleteOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:GetOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:ListOpenIDConnectProviders
              - iam:TagOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:UntagOpenIDConnectProvider
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus
              - ecr:*
              - ssm:*
              - secretsmanager:*
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  # Worker Node Role
  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: WorkerNodeRole
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: "CAPA Worker Node"

  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: WorkerNodeInstanceProfile
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # WorkerNodeCloudProviderPolicy
  WorkerNodeCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: WorkerNodeCloudProviderPolicy
      Path: /
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - autoscaling:*
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:PutParameter
            Resource: "*"
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  # IAM Group
  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GroupName: BootstrapperGroup
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllersPolicy

  # IAM User
  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserName: BootstrapperUser
      Path: /
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  WorkerNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA worker node role
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeRole.Arn
  BootstrapperUserName:
    Description: IAM user name for bootstrapper
    Value: !Ref BootstrapperUser

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience with optional NAT Gateway deployment mode'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and resource naming
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 2
  PublicSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.103.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 3
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 3
  NatGatewayType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - PerAZ
    Default: Single
    Description: >
      Select 'Single' for one NAT Gateway in the first AZ (cost-effective) or
      'PerAZ' for one NAT Gateway per AZ (high availability)

Conditions:
  IsSingleNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'Single']
  IsPerAZNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'PerAZ']

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: public

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Type
          Value: private

  # Public Route Table and Routes
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  # Conditional NAT Gateway Resources for Single mode
  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTableSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-single'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteSingle:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3Single:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableSingle
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  # Conditional NAT Gateway Resources for PerAZ mode
  NatGatewayEIP1PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-peraz-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEIP2PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-peraz-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEIP3PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-peraz-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1PerAZ.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-peraz-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2PerAZ.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-peraz-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP3PerAZ.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-peraz-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTablePerAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-peraz-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoutePerAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTablePerAZ1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1PerAZ

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1PerAZ:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsPerAZNat
