AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AI-Powered Customer Support: Isolated VPC with Private Subnets, VPC Endpoints, Flow Logs, and Application Security Groups'

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    '0':
      CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
    '1':
      CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
    '2':
      CIDR: 10.0.3.0/24

Resources:
  # VPC
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: AI-CustomerSupport

  # Private Subnets (3 AZs)
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['0', !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, '0', CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['1', !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, '1', CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-2

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['2', !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, '2', CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-subnet-3

  # Private Route Table
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: private-route-table

  # Subnet to Route Table Associations
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Gateway VPC Endpoints (S3 and DynamoDB)
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Shared Security Group for Interface VPC Endpoints
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: endpoint-sg

  # Interface VPC Endpoints
  BedrockEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  RdsDataEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KMSEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  XRayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  # KMS Key for VPC Flow Logs Encryption
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'

  # CloudWatch Logs Log Group for VPC Flow Logs
  VpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc-flow-logs/ai-customer-support
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # IAM Role for VPC Flow Logs
  VpcFlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # VPC Flow Logs
  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60

  # Application Component Security Groups
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Agent Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: agent-runtime-sg

  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for MCP Runtime component
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: mcp-runtime-sg

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lambda-sg

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR block for the EKS VPC"
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "MyEKSCluster"
    Description: "Name used to tag all resources"
  PublicSubnetCIDR0:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ 0"
  PublicSubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ 1"
  PublicSubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ 2"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR0:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.11.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ 0"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR1:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.12.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ 1"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR2:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.13.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ 2"
  AppGatewayIngressPorts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "80,443,8443,15021"
    Description: "Additional TCP ports to open on the ingress security group"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicRouteTable"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR0
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-0"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  EIP0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-0"
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-1"
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP-2"

  NatGateway0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP0.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGW-0"
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGW-1"
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGW-2"

  PrivateSubnet0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR0
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-0"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR1
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR2
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateRouteTable0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable-0"
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable-1"
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable-2"

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRoute0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway0
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable0
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway0
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway1
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway2
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "EKS Control Plane to worker node communication"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 10250
          ToPort: 10250
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-EKSControlPlaneSG"

  AppGatewaySecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for ingress/mesh gateway"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-AppGatewaySG"

  AppGatewayIngressPort0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [0, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [0, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
  AppGatewayIngressPort1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [1, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [1, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
  AppGatewayIngressPort2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [2, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [2, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
  AppGatewayIngressPort3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Select [3, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      ToPort: !Select [3, !Ref AppGatewayIngressPorts]
      CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "The VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  EksControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security group for EKS control plane"
    Value: !Ref EksControlPlaneSecurityGroup
  AppGatewaySecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security group for ingress/mesh gateway"
    Value: !Ref AppGatewaySecurityGroup
  AllSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of all subnet IDs (public and private)"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet0, !Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet0, !Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-]+$"
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^vpc-[a-f0-9]{8,17}$"
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: ""
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<String>
    Default: ""
  LifecycleScriptsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9\\.\\-]{3,63}$"
  RIGInputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9\\.\\-]{3,63}$"
  RIGOutputBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-z0-9\\.\\-]{3,63}$"
  CreateRIGResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

Conditions:
  CreateRIGResourcesTrue: !Equals [!Ref CreateRIGResources, "true"]
  EnableGatedAccessTrue: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, "true"]
  HasRIGInputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGInputBucketName, ""]]
  HasRIGOutputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGOutputBucketName, ""]]
  CreateRIGWithInput: !And [!Condition CreateRIGResourcesTrue, !Condition HasRIGInputBucket]
  HasLifecycleS3Bucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LifecycleScriptsBucketName, ""]]

Resources:
  SageMakerHyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: ENIManagementAndServiceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ec2:Vpc: !Ref VpcId
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:eks:*:*:cluster/${EKSClusterName}"
              - !If
                - HasLifecycleS3Bucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}"
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucketName}/*"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisite
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"

  RIGInputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRIGWithInput
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIG-Input"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                lambda:FunctionName:
                  - "*SageMaker*"
                  - "*sagemaker*"

  RIGOutputPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasRIGOutputBucket
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-RIG-Output"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGOutputBucketName}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGOutputBucketName}/*"

  GatedAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: EnableGatedAccessTrue
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-GatedAccess"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !If
                - HasRIGInputBucket
                - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasRIGInputBucket
                - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${RIGInputBucketName}/*"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - "arn:aws:s3:*:*:accesspoint/*/object/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                sqs:QueueName:
                  - "*SageMaker*"
                  - "*sagemaker*"

  SubnetENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-SubnetENI"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAllValues:StringLike:
                ec2:Subnet: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds

  SecurityGroupENIPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}-SecurityGroupENI"
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ForAllValues:StringLike:
                ec2:SecurityGroup: !Ref SecurityGroupIds

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !Ref SageMakerHyperPodExecRole
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerHyperPodExecRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "IAM baseline template: groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for common operational personas"

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policies
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: SystemAdministratorPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Action: "iam:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "aws-portal:*"
              - "billing:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "kms:DisableKey"
              - "kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:CancelKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:EnableKey"
              - "kms:DisableKeyRotation"
              - "kms:UpdateKeyDescription"
              - "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                "aws:ResourceTag/KeyType": "logging"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"

  IAMAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: IAMAdministratorPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "aws-portal:*"
              - "billing:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "kms:DisableKey"
              - "kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:CancelKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:EnableKey"
              - "kms:DisableKeyRotation"
              - "kms:UpdateKeyDescription"
              - "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                "aws:ResourceTag/KeyType": "logging"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"

  InstanceOpsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: InstanceOperationsPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "ec2:CreateVpc"
              - "ec2:DeleteVpc"
              - "ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute"
              - "ec2:CreateSubnet"
              - "ec2:DeleteSubnet"
              - "ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute"
              - "ec2:CreateRouteTable"
              - "ec2:DeleteRouteTable"
              - "ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation"
              - "ec2:CreateRoute"
              - "ec2:DeleteRoute"
              - "ec2:ReplaceRoute"
              - "ec2:CreateInternetGateway"
              - "ec2:DeleteInternetGateway"
              - "ec2:AttachInternetGateway"
              - "ec2:DetachInternetGateway"
              - "ec2:CreateNetworkAcl"
              - "ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl"
              - "ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation"
              - "ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry"
              - "ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry"
              - "ec2:ModifyNetworkAclEntry"
              - "ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection"
              - "ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection"
              - "ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection"
              - "ec2:RejectVpcPeeringConnection"
              - "ec2:ModifyVpcPeeringConnectionOptions"
              - "ec2:CreateNatGateway"
              - "ec2:DeleteNatGateway"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "aws-portal:*"
              - "billing:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "kms:DisableKey"
              - "kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:CancelKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:EnableKey"
              - "kms:DisableKeyRotation"
              - "kms:UpdateKeyDescription"
              - "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                "aws:ResourceTag/KeyType": "logging"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ec2:*"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:*"
              - "cloudwatch:*"
              - "autoscaling:*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"

  ReadOnlyAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: ReadOnlyAdministratorPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "aws-portal:*"
              - "billing:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - "kms:DisableKey"
              - "kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:CancelKeyDeletion"
              - "kms:EnableKey"
              - "kms:DisableKeyRotation"
              - "kms:UpdateKeyDescription"
              - "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIgnoreCase:
                "aws:ResourceTag/KeyType": "logging"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "acm:Describe*"
              - "acm:Get*"
              - "acm:List*"
              - "autoscaling:Describe*"
              - "cloudformation:Describe*"
              - "cloudformation:Get*"
              - "cloudformation:List*"
              - "cloudtrail:Describe*"
              - "cloudtrail:Get*"
              - "cloudtrail:List*"
              - "cloudwatch:Describe*"
              - "cloudwatch:Get*"
              - "cloudwatch:List*"
              - "ec2:Describe*"
              - "ec2:Get*"
              - "ec2:List*"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:Describe*"
              - "elasticloadbalancing:Get*"
              - "iam:Get*"
              - "iam:List*"
              - "kms:Describe*"
              - "kms:Get*"
              - "kms:List*"
              - "lambda:Get*"
              - "lambda:List*"
              - "rds:Describe*"
              - "rds:List*"
              - "s3:Get*"
              - "s3:List*"
              - "sns:Get*"
              - "sns:List*"
              - "sqs:Get*"
              - "sqs:List*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent": "true"

  BillingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BillingReadOnlyPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "aws-portal:ViewBilling"
              - "aws-portal:ViewUsage"
              - "billing:Get*"
              - "billing:List*"
              - "account:Get*"
            Resource: "*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Groups
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SystemAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdminPolicy

  IAMAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: IAMAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminPolicy

  InstanceOpsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: InstanceOperations
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: ReadOnlyAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  BillingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BillingViewers
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BillingPolicy

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Roles (user-assumable)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: SystemAdministratorRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SystemAdminPolicy

  IAMAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: IAMAdministratorRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdminPolicy

  InstanceOpsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: InstanceOperationsRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: ReadOnlyAdministratorRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminPolicy

  BillingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: BillingViewerRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BillingPolicy

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EC2-assumable role and instance profile
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  InstanceOpsEC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: InstanceOperationsEC2Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "ec2.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsPolicy

  InstanceOpsEC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: InstanceOperationsEC2Profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsEC2Role

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:
  SystemAdminGroupId:
    Description: "Group ID for System Administrators"
    Value: !Ref SystemAdminGroup

  IAMAdminGroupId:
    Description: "Group ID for IAM Administrators"
    Value: !Ref IAMAdminGroup

  InstanceOpsGroupId:
    Description: "Group ID for Instance Operations"
    Value: !Ref InstanceOpsGroup

  ReadOnlyAdminGroupId:
    Description: "Group ID for Read-Only Administrators"
    Value: !Ref ReadOnlyAdminGroup

  BillingGroupId:
    Description: "Group ID for Billing Viewers"
    Value: !Ref BillingGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with three-tier subnets across three AZs, NAT Gateways, and Internet Gateway."

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyVPC

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: MyIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web Tier Subnets (across 3 AZs)
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet3

  # Application Tier Subnets
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.5.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.6.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet3

  # Database Tier Subnets
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.7.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet1

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.8.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet2

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.9.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbSubnet3

  # Web Route Table and Routes
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebRouteTable

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways in each web subnet
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway2

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NatGateway3

  # Application Tier Route Tables and Routes
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable1

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable2

  AppDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppRouteTable3

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3

  # Database Tier Route Tables and Routes
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTable1

  DbDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTable2

  DbDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2

  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: DbRouteTable3

  DbDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "List of Availability Zones used"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
        - !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of Web Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
        - !Ref WebSubnet3
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of Application Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref AppSubnet1
        - !Ref AppSubnet2
        - !Ref AppSubnet3
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of Database Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref DbSubnet1
        - !Ref DbSubnet2
        - !Ref DbSubnet3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates shared IAM roles, instance profiles, and SSM parameters required by
  the Amazon EKS Quick Start stacks. All roles use the prefix 'eks-quickstart'
  and parameter values are stored under /quickstart/amazon-eks/.

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. General Lambda Execution Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-lambda-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSQuickStartLambdaExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !GetAtt RoleCreationRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. EKS Control Plane Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-eks-control-plane-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSControlPlaneAdditionalPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Fargate Execution Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-fargate-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FargateExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Managed Node Instance Role and Instance Profile
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-managed-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Unmanaged Node Instance Role and Instance Profile
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: eks-quickstart-unmanaged-node-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Role Creation Role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  RoleCreationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-role-creation-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateVpcRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess'
                      - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. SSM Parameters for Role ARNs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/lambda-execution-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role for EKS QuickStart

  EKSControlPlaneRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/eks-control-plane-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the EKS control plane role

  FargateExecutionRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/fargate-execution-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Fargate execution role

  ManagedNodeRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/managed-node-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the managed node instance role

  UnmanagedNodeRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/unmanaged-node-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the unmanaged node instance role

  RoleCreationRoleSSM:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /quickstart/amazon-eks/role-creation-role
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt RoleCreationRole.Arn
      Description: ARN of the role creation role for Lambda to create the VPC IAM role

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Dedicated IAM user and group for SES SMTP sending with automated SMTP credential generation and storage in SSM Parameter Store'
Parameters:
  IamUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: Desired IAM username for the SMTP user.
  RotationVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Version number used as a suffix in the SSM parameter paths to track credential rotations.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period in days for Lambda execution logs.
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) ARN of a customer-managed KMS key to encrypt the SSM parameters. If empty, the default AWS-managed key is used.
Conditions:
  NonEmptyKmsKeyArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
Resources:
  SmtpSendingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: SmtpSendingGroup

  SmtpSendingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: SmtpSendingPolicy
      Groups:
        - !Ref SmtpSendingGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: '*'

  SmtpUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IamUsername

  SmtpUserGroupAttachment:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref SmtpSendingGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref SmtpUser

  SmtpAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SmtpUser
      Status: Active

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmPutParameters
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:*:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/smtp/${IamUsername}/*

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/SmtpCredentialConverter-${IamUsername}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub SmtpCredentialConverter-${IamUsername}
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, base64, hmac, hashlib, logging, urllib3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          http = urllib3.PoolManager()

          def generate_smtp_password(secret_access_key):
              # AWS SES SMTP credential generation algorithm
              # Password = base64(HMAC-SHA256(SecretAccessKey, "SendRawEmail"))
              key = secret_access_key.encode('utf-8')
              msg = b'SendRawEmail'
              digest = hmac.new(key, msg, hashlib.sha256).digest()
              return base64.b64encode(digest).decode('utf-8')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info('Received event: %s', json.dumps(event))
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              username = props['IamUsername']
              access_key = props['AccessKeyId']
              secret_key = props['SecretAccessKey']
              version = props.get('RotationVersion', '1')
              kms_key = props.get('KmsKeyArn', '')

              base_path = f'/smtp/{username}/v{version}'
              username_path = f'{base_path}/smtp-username'
              password_path = f'{base_path}/smtp-password'

              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', f'SMTPCreds-{username}-{version}')

              if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                  smtp_password = generate_smtp_password(secret_key)
                  params = [
                      {'Name': username_path, 'Value': access_key},
                      {'Name': password_path, 'Value': smtp_password},
                  ]

Resources:

    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for CIS benchmark encryption requirements
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: key-default-1
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail to encrypt logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow S3 to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow SNS to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
  CloudTrailS3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref CISBenchmarkKMSKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: GlacierAndExpiration
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 365
  CloudTrailS3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailS3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudTrailWriteAcl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailS3Bucket.Arn}/*'

      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroupName

          - Effect: Allow

              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com

                  - logs:CreateLogStream

                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${CloudTrailLogGroupName}:*'

      - CloudTrailS3BucketPolicy

      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailRole.Arn

      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true

  # 1. Unauthorized API Calls

        - MetricValue: 1

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SNSTopic

Description: >

    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

      Description: KMS key for encrypting Lambda environment variables
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow account to manage key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

                AWS: !Ref AdditionalKmsDecryptRoles
              Action:
