                - "kms:DescribeKey"
              Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

  LambdaEnvKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/lambda-env-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  # ============================================================
  # DynamoDB table for WebSocket connections
  # ============================================================
  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: WebSocketConnections
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  # ============================================================
  # Lambda function execution role
  # ============================================================
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaDynamoDBKMSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # Lambda function (Python 3.12)
  # ============================================================
  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: WebSocketHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE: !Ref ConnectionsTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['CONNECTIONS_TABLE']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('routeKey')
              connection_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('connectionId')
              domain_name = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('domainName')
              stage = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('stage')
              endpoint_url = f'https://{domain_name}/{stage}'

              if route_key == '$connect':
                  table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}
              elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                  table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}
              elif route_key == 'sendStatus':
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Status route acknowledged'}
              else:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Unknown route'}
      Description: Handler for WebSocket events
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSocketHandler

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway WebSocket API
  # ============================================================
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: GrantProcessingWebSocketApi
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"
      Description: WebSocket API for grant processing status updates

  # ============================================================
  # WebSocket Integration (AWS_PROXY)
  # ============================================================
  LambdaIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerFunction.Arn
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH

  # ============================================================
  # Routes
  # ============================================================
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  CustomRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: sendStatus
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${LambdaIntegration}"

  # ============================================================
  # Lambda resource-based policies for API Gateway invocation
  # ============================================================
  LambdaPermissionConnect:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$$connect"

  LambdaPermissionDisconnect:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$$disconnect"

  LambdaPermissionDefault:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$$default"

  LambdaPermissionSendStatus:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebSocketHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/sendStatus"

  # ============================================================
  # Second KMS Key for CloudWatch Logs log group encryption
  # ============================================================
  CloudWatchLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting API Gateway CloudWatch Logs
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow account to manage key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT

  CloudWatchLogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/gateway-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudWatchLogsKmsKey

  # ============================================================
  # CloudWatch Logs log group for API Gateway execution logs
  # ============================================================
  ApiGatewayLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/apigateway/${WebSocketApi}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogsKmsKey.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # IAM role for API Gateway CloudWatch logging
  # ============================================================
  ApiGatewayLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway Account settings (CloudWatch role)
  # ============================================================
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLoggingRole.Arn

  # ============================================================
  # API Gateway Deployment and Stage
  # ============================================================
  WebSocketDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - CustomRoute
      - LambdaIntegration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Initial deployment

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebSocketDeployment
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp",
          "caller":"$context.identity.caller","user":"$context.identity.user",
          "requestTime":"$context.requestTime","eventType":"$context.eventType",
          "routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status",
          "connectionId":"$context.connectionId"}
      RouteSettings:
        $default:
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        LoggingLevel: INFO
        DataTraceEnabled: true
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
      StageVariables: {}
      Tags:
        Name: prod-stage

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM roles and instance profile for CodeDeploy and CodePipeline demo with KMS encryption'

Resources:
  # KMS Customer Managed Key for S3 bucket encryption
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: 'CMK for pipeline artifact bucket'
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdminPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7

  # KMS Alias for easier reference
  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/pipeline-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  # S3 bucket for pipeline artifacts with SSE-KMS
  PipelineArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'pipeline-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # Bucket policy to restrict access to CodePipeline role only
  # No explicit DependsOn needed; !GetAtt creates implicit dependency
  PipelineArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PipelineArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCodePipelineAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt CodePipelineServiceRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:PutObjectAcl
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'

  # EC2 instance role with AdministratorAccess
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: EC2InstanceRole-Demo
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  # Instance profile for EC2
  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: EC2InstanceProfile-Demo
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

  # CodeDeploy service role
  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodeDeployServiceRole-Demo
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:SourceArn:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codedeploy:us-east-1:${AWS::AccountId}:application:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:codedeploy:us-west-2:${AWS::AccountId}:application:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeDeployServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
                  - autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLifecycleHooks
                  - autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook
                Resource: '*'

  # CodePipeline service role
  CodePipelineServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodePipelineServiceRole-Demo
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${PipelineArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - rds:*
                  - sqs:*
                  - ecs:*
                  - codedeploy:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - elasticbeanstalk:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - ec2.amazonaws.com
                      - codedeploy.amazonaws.com
                      - ecs.amazonaws.com
                      - elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for S3 encryption
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: KmsKeyArn

  EC2InstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 instance role
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: EC2InstanceRoleArn

  EC2InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the EC2 instance profile
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: EC2InstanceProfileName

  CodeDeployServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeDeploy service role
    Value: !GetAtt CodeDeployServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: CodeDeployServiceRoleArn

  CodePipelineServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodePipeline service role
    Value: !GetAtt CodePipelineServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: CodePipelineServiceRoleArn

  PipelineArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for pipeline artifacts
    Value: !Ref PipelineArtifactBucket
    Export:
      Name: PipelineArtifactBucketName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless webhook handler for Stripe -> Squarespace -> Slack notifications

Parameters:
  StripeWebhookSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: 'PLACEHOLDER_STRIPE_SECRET'
    Description: Stripe webhook signing secret for payload verification. This placeholder default must be overridden during stack creation with your actual secret value.
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: 'PLACEHOLDER_SQUARESPACE_TOKEN'
    Description: Squarespace Commerce API token for order lookup. This placeholder default must be overridden during stack creation with your actual secret value.

Resources:
  SNSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SNS topic encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootUser
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSNSService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"

  SalesNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DisplayName: StripeSalesNotifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SNSKey

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SNSAndKMSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt SNSKey.Arn

  WebhookHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: StripeSquarespaceWebhookHandler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STRIPE_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSecret
          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime

          STRIPE_SECRET = os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET']
          SQUARESPACE_TOKEN = os.environ['SQUARESPACE_TOKEN']
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN']

          def verify_stripe_signature(payload, sig_header):
              try:
                  parts = {k: v for k, v in (pair.split('=') for pair in sig_header.split(','))}
              except:
                  return False
              timestamp = parts.get('t', '')
              expected_sig = parts.get('v1', '')
              signed_payload = f"{timestamp}.{payload.decode('utf-8')}"
              computed_sig = hmac.new(
                  STRIPE_SECRET.encode('utf-8'),
                  signed_payload.encode('utf-8'),
                  hashlib.sha256
              ).hexdigest()
              return hmac.compare_digest(computed_sig, expected_sig)

          def get_squarespace_order(order_id):
              url = f"https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce/orders/{order_id}"
              req = urllib.request.Request(url)
              req.add_header('Authorization', f'Bearer {SQUARESPACE_TOKEN}')
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                  return json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))

          def format_message(order):
              order_id = order.get('id', 'N/A')
              total = order.get('total', {}).get('value', 0) / 100 if order.get('total', {}).get('currency') else 0
              currency = order.get('total', {}).get('currency', 'USD')
              customer = order.get('customer', {}).get('displayName', 'Unknown') if order.get('customer') else 'Unknown'
              items = order.get('lineItems', [])
              item_list = ', '.join([item.get('name', 'Item') for item in items[:3]])
              timestamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')
              message = (
                  f"🛒 **New Sale!**\n"
                  f"Order ID: {order_id}\n"
                  f"Total: ${total:.2f} {currency}\n"
                  f"Customer: {customer}\n"
                  f"Items: {item_list}\n"
                  f"Time: {timestamp}"
              )
              return message

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  raw_body = event['body'].encode('utf-8')
                  sig_header = event['headers'].get('Stripe-Signature', '')
                  if not verify_stripe_signature(raw_body, sig_header):
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps('Invalid signature')}

                  payload = json.loads(raw_body)
                  event_type = payload.get('type', '')
                  if event_type != 'checkout.session.completed':
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps('Event ignored')}

                  session = payload.get('data', {}).get('object', {})
                  order_id = session.get('metadata', {}).get('order_id')
                  if not order_id:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps('No order_id in metadata')}

                  order = get_squarespace_order(order_id)
                  message = format_message(order)

                  sns = boto3.client('sns')
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN, Message=message, Subject='New Sale Notification')

                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps('Notification sent')}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': json.dumps(str(e))}

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/StripeSquarespaceWebhookHandler
      RetentionInDays: 14

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebhookHandlerFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${StripeSquarespaceWebhookApi}/prod/POST/webhooks"

  StripeSquarespaceWebhookApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:

      Description: API Gateway for Stripe webhook
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  WebhookResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:

      PathPart: webhooks
      RestApiId: !Ref StripeSquarespaceWebhookApi

  WebhookMethod:

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref StripeSquarespaceWebhookApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhookResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookHandlerFunction.Arn}/invocations"

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: WebhookMethod
    Properties:

    Properties:
      AlarmName: StripeWebhookLambdaErrors
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when Lambda function has any errors in a 1-minute period

        - Name: FunctionName

      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained test environment for ElastiCache Redis cluster-mode enabled replication group with Multi-AZ, encryption, and resilience testing support.'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/22'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the VPC'
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the first private subnet'
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the second private subnet'

Resources:
  # VPC with DNS support and hostnames enabled
  TestVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisVPC'

  # Two private subnets in different AZs
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisPrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisPrivateSubnet2'

  # Security group for Redis traffic
  RedisSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: 'Security group for Redis replication group'
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisSecurityGroup'

  # ElastiCache subnet group
  RedisSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: 'Subnet group for Redis replication group'
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # KMS key for encryption (at-rest and in-transit)
  RedisKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'EnableRootAccess'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'AllowElastiCacheService'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'elasticache.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: 'AllowSNSService'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'sns.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisEncryptionKey'

  # KMS alias
  RedisKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: 'alias/test-redis-encryption-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RedisKMSKey

  # ElastiCache Redis replication group with cluster mode enabled
  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: 'Test Redis cluster-mode enabled replication group'
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: '7.1'
      CacheNodeType: 'cache.r6g.large'
      NumNodeGroups: 2
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: 1
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RedisKMSKey
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref RedisSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref RedisSecurityGroup
      SnapshotWindow: '03:00-04:00'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisCluster'

  # SNS topic for CloudWatch alarms
  TestSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: 'TestRedisResilienceAlarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref RedisKMSKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisResilienceAlarms'

  # SNS topic policy to allow CloudWatch to publish
  TestSNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref TestSNSTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: 'AllowCloudWatchPublish'
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'cloudwatch.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'SNS:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref TestSNSTopic

  # IAM role for SSM Automation signals
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'AWS:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'SendAutomationSignalPolicy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: 'AllowSendAutomationSignal'
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:SendAutomationSignal'
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'TestRedisSSMAutomationRole'

    Description: 'SNS topic ARN'
    Value: !Ref TestSNSTopic
  IAMRoleArn:
    Description: 'IAM role ARN for SSM Automation'
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Cognito user pool, REST API with protected and public endpoints

Resources:

  # IAM Role for Lambda execution
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Lambda function backing both endpoints
  UserEndpointFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              if event.get('requestContext') and event['requestContext'].get('authorizer') and event['requestContext']['authorizer'].get('claims'):
                  claims = event['requestContext']['authorizer']['claims']
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'Authenticated',
                          'claims': claims
                      })
                  }
              else:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({
                          'message': 'Unauthenticated',
                          'claims': None
                      })
                  }

  # Cognito User Pool
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: MyUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

  # App Client without secret, enabling USER_PASSWORD and REFRESH_TOKEN auth
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: MyAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      CallbackURLs:
        - https://localhost
      LogoutURLs:
        - https://localhost
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # REST API with OpenAPI body defining paths and inline Cognito authorizer
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: MyAPI
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Body:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "openapi": "3.0.1",
              "info": {
                "title": "MyAPI",
                "version": "1.0"
              },
              "paths": {
                "/me": {
                  "get": {
                    "security": [{"CognitoAuth":[]}],
                    "x-amazon-apigateway-integration": {
                      "type": "aws_proxy",
                      "httpMethod": "POST",
                      "uri": "${LambdaUri}"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "/open": {
                  "get": {
                    "x-amazon-apigateway-integration": {
                      "type": "aws_proxy",
                      "httpMethod": "POST",
                      "uri": "${LambdaUri}"
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "components": {
                "securitySchemes": {
                  "CognitoAuth": {
                    "type": "apiKey",
                    "name": "Authorization",
                    "in": "header",
                    "x-amazon-apigateway-authorizer": {
                      "type": "cognito",
                      "providerARNs": ["${UserPoolArn}"],
                      "identitySource": "method.request.header.Authorization"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          - LambdaUri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UserEndpointFunction.Arn}/invocations"
            UserPoolArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # Deployment for the API (depends on RestApi implicitly)
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Deployment for prod stage

  # Stage "prod"
  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      MethodSettings:
        - HttpMethod: "*"
          ResourcePath: "/*"
          MetricsEnabled: true
          DataTraceEnabled: false

  # Permission for API Gateway to invoke Lambda
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref UserEndpointFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub
        - arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApiId}/*/*/*
        - RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  RestApiId:
    Value: !Ref RestApi
  ProdStageUrl:
    Value: !Sub "https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CloudFormation template to connect an AWS account to marbot.io monitoring service.
  Requires only the MarbotEndpointId parameter; MarbotAccountId defaults to a placeholder
  but should be replaced with the actual marbot AWS account ID provided by marbot.io.

Parameters:
  MarbotEndpointId:
    Type: String
    Default: "YOUR-MARBOT-ENDPOINT-ID"
    Description: >
      The unique endpoint identifier provided by marbot.io. This is the only essential
      user-supplied value. The template derives the API key from this value.
      IMPORTANT: The default value is a placeholder. You MUST supply your actual
      marbot.io endpoint ID at stack creation or update; otherwise all dependent
      resources (Connection, ApiDestination, heartbeat rule, custom resource)
      will be misconfigured and the integration will fail.

  MarbotAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: "000000000000"
    NoEcho: true
    Description: >
      The AWS account ID of marbot.io.
      THIS IS REQUIRED FOR THE CROSS-ACCOUNT ROLE TO FUNCTION.
      The placeholder default ("000000000000") causes the trust policy statement
      to be omitted at stack creation. You MUST update this parameter with marbot's
      real AWS account ID (obtained from marbot.io documentation) before the role
      grants any access.

  AutoMonitoringEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: [Enabled, Disabled]
    Default: Disabled
    Description: Enable automatic CloudWatch alarm and monitoring rule configuration.

  AccountAliasEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: [Enabled, Disabled]
    Default: Disabled
    Description: Enable enriching account IDs with friendly aliases.

  MetricGraphsEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: [Enabled, Disabled]
    Default: Disabled
    Description: Enable embedding metric graphs into CloudWatch alarm notifications.

  ManualApprovalEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: [Enabled, Disabled]
    Default: Disabled
    Description: Enable approval or rejection of CodePipeline manual approval requests.

Conditions:
  AutoMonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref AutoMonitoringEnabled, Enabled]
  AccountAliasEnabled: !Equals [!Ref AccountAliasEnabled, Enabled]
  MetricGraphsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref MetricGraphsEnabled, Enabled]
  ManualApprovalEnabled: !Equals [!Ref ManualApprovalEnabled, Enabled]
  AttachPermissionsBoundary: !Equals [!Ref AutoMonitoringEnabled, Enabled]
  IsMarbotAccountValid: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MarbotAccountId, "000000000000"]]
  IsMarbotEndpointValid: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MarbotEndpointId, "YOUR-MARBOT-ENDPOINT-ID"]]

Resources:
  # EventBridge Connection (API Key authentication)
  MarbotConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: "X-API-Key"
          ApiKeyValue: !Sub '${MarbotEndpointId}-marbot-key'

  # EventBridge API Destination
  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt MarbotConnection.Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 10
      InvocationEndpoint: 'https://events.marbot.io/v1/events'

  # IAM Role for EventBridge to invoke the API Destination
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeApiDestination
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:InvokeApiDestination
                Resource: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn

  # Scheduled Rule every 30 days to keep the heartbeat alive
  HeartbeatRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: "rate(30 days)"
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt MarbotApiDestination.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          Id: HeartbeatTarget
          Input: !Sub |
            {
              "account_id": "${AWS::AccountId}",
              "stack_id": "${AWS::StackId}",
              "endpoint_id": "${MarbotEndpointId}"
            }

  # Permissions boundary policy – denies actions outside a limited set
  PermissionsBoundaryPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Deny
            NotAction:
              - cloudwatch:*
              - logs:*
              - sns:Publish
              - codepipeline:*
              - iam:PassRole
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Resource: "*"

  # Managed policy for automatic monitoring (CloudWatch + monitoring rule configuration)
  AutoMonitorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - events:PutRule
              - events:PutTargets
              - events:DescribeRule
              - events:ListRules
              - events:DeleteRule
              - events:RemoveTargets
            Resource: "*"

  # Managed policy for account alias enrichment
  AccountAliasPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:ListAccountAliases
            Resource: "*"

  # Managed policy for metric graphs
  MetricGraphsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage
            Resource: "*"

  # Managed policy for manual approval actions
  ManualApprovalPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - codepipeline:GetPipeline
              - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
              - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
            Resource: "*"

  # Cross‑account IAM role for marbot
  CrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - !If
            - IsMarbotAccountValid
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${MarbotAccountId}:root'
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  sts:ExternalId: !Ref 'AWS::StackId'
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [AttachPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !If [AutoMonitoringEnabled, !Ref AutoMonitorPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [AccountAliasEnabled, !Ref AccountAliasPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [MetricGraphsEnabled, !Ref MetricGraphsPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !If [ManualApprovalEnabled, !Ref ManualApprovalPolicy, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  # IAM Role for Lambda custom resource handler
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: LambdaTagResources
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: tag:TagResources
                Resource: "*"

  # Lambda function (custom resource handler)
  MarbotRegistrationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  endpoint = props['MarbotEndpointId']
                  account_id = props['AccountId']
                  stack_id = props['StackId']
                  apikey = f"{endpoint}-marbot-key"
                  url = f"https://events.marbot.io/v1/events"

                  payload = {
                      'action': 'register',
                      'endpoint_id': endpoint,
                      'account_id': account_id,
                      'stack_id': stack_id,
                      'request_type': request_type
                  }

                  req = urllib.request.Request(
                      url,
                      data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'),
                      headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-API-Key': apikey},
                      method='POST'
                  )

                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
                  else:
                      urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})

  # Custom Resource to register account with marbot
  MarbotRegistration:
    Condition: IsMarbotEndpointValid
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt MarbotRegistrationFunction.Arn
      MarbotEndpointId: !Ref MarbotEndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      StackId: !Ref 'AWS::StackId'

Outputs:
  MarbotConnectionArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge connection
    Value: !Ref MarbotConnection
  MarbotApiDestinationArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge API destination
    Value: !Ref MarbotApiDestination
  HeartbeatRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scheduled heartbeat rule
    Value: !GetAtt HeartbeatRule.Arn
  CrossAccountRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the cross-account IAM role for marbot
    Value: !GetAtt CrossAccountRole.Arn
  MarbotRegistrationStatus:
    Description: Status of the custom resource registration

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained backend for mobile/web app with DynamoDB, Cognito Identity Pool, and IAM role for unauthenticated access."

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "id"
          AttributeType: "N"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "id"
          KeyType: "HASH"
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: "id-index"
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: "id"
              KeyType: "HASH"
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: "ALL"
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  IdentityPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool"
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      IdentityPoolName: "AppGuestIdentityPool"

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "GuestAppPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "mobileanalytics:PutEvents"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "cognito-sync:*"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${IdentityPool}/*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "sns:Publish"
                Resource: "arn:aws:sns:*:*:*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem"
                  - "dynamodb:DeleteItem"
                  - "dynamodb:PutItem"
                  - "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: "ID of the Cognito Identity Pool"
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table"
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: "ARN of the DynamoDB table"
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Glue Data Catalog database, optional crawler, and optional Spark ETL job'

Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 'my-data-lake'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev
  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: 'arn:aws:s3:::.*'
    Default: 'arn:aws:s3:::my-source-bucket'
  SourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 'data'
  CrawlerScheduleCron:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 0 * * ? *)
  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    Default: Standard
  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2880
  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  ScriptS3Location:
    Type: String
    Default: 's3://my-scripts-bucket/scripts/etl-job.py'
  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
  CrawlerEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: true
  JobEnabled:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false

Conditions:
  IsCrawlerEnabled: !Equals [!Ref CrawlerEnabled, 'true']
  IsJobEnabled: !Equals [!Ref JobEnabled, 'true']
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, '']]

Resources:
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-database'
        Description: !Sub 'Glue Data Catalog database for ${Prefix}-${Environment} data lake'

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueDataLakePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SourceBucketReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${SourceBucketArn}'
                  - !Sub '${SourceBucketArn}/${SourcePrefix}/*'
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Sid: TargetBucketWriteAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref TargetBucketArn
                    - !Sub '${TargetBucketArn}/${TargetPrefix}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  GlueLogGroup:
    Condition: IsJobEnabled
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-glue-job'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  GlueCrawler:
    Condition: IsCrawlerEnabled
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-crawler'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Join
              - ''
              - - 's3://'
                - !Select
                  - 5
                  - !Split
                    - ':'
                    - !Ref SourceBucketArn
                - '/'
                - !Ref SourcePrefix
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerScheduleCron
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0}'

  GlueJob:
    Condition: IsJobEnabled
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-job'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref ScriptS3Location
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-enable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}-glue-job'
        '--continuous-log-logStreamPrefix': !Sub '${Prefix}-${Environment}'
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref NumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns

Outputs:
  DatabaseName:
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
  RoleArn:
    Description: IAM Role ARN shared by crawler and job
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
  CrawlerName:
    Condition: IsCrawlerEnabled
    Value: !Ref GlueCrawler
  JobName:
    Condition: IsJobEnabled
    Value: !Ref GlueJob
  LogGroupName:
    Condition: IsJobEnabled
    Value: !Ref GlueLogGroup
